### src/pages/api/live-status.ts
```ts
﻿/**
 * /api/live-status – Verifică dacă Live Input-ul Cloudflare Stream este în direct acum.
 * ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * Apelează Cloudflare Stream API (`/accounts/{ACCT}/stream/live_inputs/{ID}/videos?limit=1`)
 * și returnează:
 *   {
 *     isLive: boolean,
 *     videoId: string | null,        // UID-ul sesiunii live curente (Cloudflare videoUID)
 *     replayId: string | null,       // UID-ul video-ului de replay (fallback când nu e live)
 *     customerCode: string | null,   // codul subdomain Cloudflare Stream pentru iframe URL
 *     source: 'cloudflare'
 *   }
 *
 * Frontend-ul construiește URL-ul iframe astfel:
 *   https://customer-{customerCode}.cloudflarestream.com/{videoId|replayId}/iframe
 *
 * Cache-Control: public, max-age=30, stale-while-revalidate=300 — pentru a evita
 * apariția endpoint-ului în „Critical Request Chain” (Lighthouse / LCP).
 */

import type { APIRoute } from 'astro';
import { checkOrigin } from '../../lib/cors.js';
import { secureLogger } from '../../lib/secure-logger.js';

export const prerender = false;

const LIVE_STATUS_CACHE_TTL_MS = 25_000;
const CLOUDFLARE_FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS = 1_800;

type LiveStatusPayload = {
    isLive: boolean;
    videoId: string | null;
    replayId: string | null;
    customerCode: string | null;
    source: 'cloudflare';
};

type CloudflareVideo = {
    uid: string;
    status?: { state?: string };
    liveInput?: string;
};

type CloudflareLiveVideosResponse = {
    success?: boolean;
    result?: CloudflareVideo[];
    errors?: Array<{ code: number; message: string }>;
};

let cachedLiveStatus: LiveStatusPayload | null = null;
let cachedAt = 0;
let inFlightRequest: Promise<LiveStatusPayload> | null = null;

const isCacheFresh = () => {
    return cachedLiveStatus && Date.now() - cachedAt < LIVE_STATUS_CACHE_TTL_MS;
};

const buildOfflinePayload = (replayId: string | null, customerCode: string | null): LiveStatusPayload => ({
    isLive: false,
    videoId: null,
    replayId,
    customerCode,
    source: 'cloudflare',
});

const getFallbackPayload = (replayId: string | null, customerCode: string | null): LiveStatusPayload => {
    return cachedLiveStatus ?? buildOfflinePayload(replayId, customerCode);
};

const fetchLiveStatusFromCloudflare = async (
    accountId: string,
    liveInputId: string,
    apiToken: string,
    replayId: string | null,
    customerCode: string | null
): Promise<LiveStatusPayload> => {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), CLOUDFLARE_FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS);

    try {
        // Endpoint 1: Verifica statusul live input-ului (mai important)
        const statusUrl = `https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/${encodeURIComponent(accountId)}/stream/live_inputs/${encodeURIComponent(liveInputId)}`;

        const statusRes = await fetch(statusUrl, {
            signal: controller.signal,
            cache: 'no-store',
            headers: {
                Authorization: `Bearer ${apiToken}`,
                Accept: 'application/json',
            },
        });

        if (!statusRes.ok) {
            secureLogger.error(
                `[api/live-status] Cloudflare live_inputs endpoint error: status=${statusRes.status}`
            );
        } else {
            const statusData = await statusRes.json() as any;

            if (statusData?.success && statusData.result) {
                const liveInput = statusData.result;
                // Cloudflare returnează `status` ca obiect: { current: { state: 'connected' | 'idle' | ... } }
                // În unele variante mai vechi era un string. Acoperim ambele formate.
                const statusObj = liveInput?.status;
                const currentState =
                    (typeof statusObj === 'object' && statusObj?.current?.state) ||
                    (typeof statusObj === 'string' ? statusObj : null);
                const isLiveActive =
                    currentState === 'connected' ||
                    currentState === 'live-inprogress' ||
                    currentState === 'active' ||
                    liveInput?.meta?.live === true;

                if (isLiveActive) {

                    // Dacă e active, obținem video UID din endpoint-ul de videos
                    const videosUrl = `https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/${encodeURIComponent(accountId)}/stream/live_inputs/${encodeURIComponent(liveInputId)}/videos?limit=1`;
                    const videosRes = await fetch(videosUrl, {
                        signal: controller.signal,
                        cache: 'no-store',
                        headers: {
                            Authorization: `Bearer ${apiToken}`,
                            Accept: 'application/json',
                        },
                    });

                    if (videosRes.ok) {
                        const videosData = (await videosRes.json()) as CloudflareLiveVideosResponse;
                        const currentVideo = videosData?.result?.[0];

                        if (currentVideo?.uid) {
                            return {
                                isLive: true,
                                videoId: currentVideo.uid,
                                replayId,
                                customerCode,
                                source: 'cloudflare',
                            };
                        }
                    } else {
                        secureLogger.error(`[api/live-status] Failed to fetch videos: status=${videosRes.status}`);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Fallback: Caută video cu state 'live-inprogress' din endpoint /videos
        const fallbackUrl = `https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/${encodeURIComponent(accountId)}/stream/live_inputs/${encodeURIComponent(liveInputId)}/videos?limit=1`;
        const fallbackRes = await fetch(fallbackUrl, {
            signal: controller.signal,
            cache: 'no-store',
            headers: {
                Authorization: `Bearer ${apiToken}`,
                Accept: 'application/json',
            },
        });

        if (fallbackRes.ok) {
            const fallbackData = (await fallbackRes.json()) as CloudflareLiveVideosResponse;

            if (fallbackData?.success && Array.isArray(fallbackData.result)) {
                const liveVideo = fallbackData.result.find((video) => video?.status?.state === 'live-inprogress');
                if (liveVideo?.uid) {
                    return {
                        isLive: true,
                        videoId: liveVideo.uid,
                        replayId,
                        customerCode,
                        source: 'cloudflare',
                    };
                }
            }
        }

        return buildOfflinePayload(replayId, customerCode);
    } catch (error) {
        if (error instanceof DOMException && error.name === 'AbortError') {
            secureLogger.error(`[api/live-status] Cloudflare Stream API timeout after ${CLOUDFLARE_FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS}ms`);
        } else {
            const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'unknown error';
            secureLogger.error(`[api/live-status] Cloudflare Stream API request failed: ${message}`);
        }
        return getFallbackPayload(replayId, customerCode);
    } finally {
        clearTimeout(timeoutId);
    }
};

const getLiveStatus = async (
    accountId: string,
    liveInputId: string,
    apiToken: string,
    replayId: string | null,
    customerCode: string | null
): Promise<LiveStatusPayload> => {
    if (isCacheFresh()) {
        return cachedLiveStatus as LiveStatusPayload;
    }

    if (!inFlightRequest) {
        inFlightRequest = fetchLiveStatusFromCloudflare(accountId, liveInputId, apiToken, replayId, customerCode)
            .then((payload) => {
                cachedLiveStatus = payload;
                cachedAt = Date.now();
                return payload;
            })
            .finally(() => {
                inFlightRequest = null;
            });
    }

    return inFlightRequest;
};

const readEnv = (key: string): string | null => {
    const fromProcess = typeof process !== 'undefined' ? process.env?.[key]?.trim() : '';
    if (fromProcess) return fromProcess;
    const fromImport = (import.meta.env as Record<string, string | undefined>)[key]?.trim();
    return fromImport ? fromImport : null;
};

export const GET: APIRoute = async ({ request }) => {
    const originCheck = checkOrigin(request);

    if (!originCheck.allowed) {
        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Forbidden' }), { status: 403 });
    }

    const headers: Record<string, string> = {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        'Cache-Control': 'public, max-age=30, stale-while-revalidate=300',
        Vary: 'Origin',
        ...(originCheck.origin ? { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': originCheck.origin } : {}),
    };

    const accountId = readEnv('CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID');
    const liveInputId = readEnv('CLOUDFLARE_LIVE_INPUT_ID');
    const apiToken = readEnv('CLOUDFLARE_STREAM_TOKEN');
    const customerCode = readEnv('CLOUDFLARE_STREAM_CUSTOMER_CODE');
    const replayId = readEnv('CLOUDFLARE_REPLAY_VIDEO_UID');

    if (!accountId || !liveInputId || !apiToken) {
        // Configurare incompletă — răspundem fallback fără a mai apela Cloudflare.
        return new Response(
            JSON.stringify(buildOfflinePayload(replayId, customerCode)),
            { status: 200, headers }
        );
    }

    try {
        const payload = await getLiveStatus(accountId, liveInputId, apiToken, replayId, customerCode);
        return new Response(JSON.stringify(payload), { status: 200, headers });
    } catch {
        return new Response(
            JSON.stringify(getFallbackPayload(replayId, customerCode)),
            { status: 200, headers }
        );
    }
};
```

### src/pages/api/rezervare.ts
```ts
/**
 * POST /api/rezervare
 * ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * Endpoint pentru procesarea formularului de rezervare.
 * Înlocuiește data-netlify="true" — funcționează pe Railway (Node standalone).
 *
 * Securitate:
 *   • Honeypot anti-spam (câmp bot-field ascuns)
 *   • Validare GDPR consent obligatoriu (Art. 7 RGPD)
 *   • Validare și sanitizare pentru toate câmpurile
 *   • Rate limiting per IP (5 cereri/minut)
 *   • Parametrizare SQL (fără SQL injection)
 *   • Validare regex telefon și dată
 */

import type { APIRoute } from 'astro';
import { query } from '../../lib/db.js';
import { secureLogger } from '../../lib/secure-logger.js';

export const prerender = false;

// ── Rate limiting ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const RATE_WINDOW_MS = 60_000; // 1 minut
const RATE_LIMIT = 5;      // max 5 rezervări/minut/IP

const rateMap = new Map<string, number[]>();

function getClientIp(request: Request): string {
    return (
        request.headers.get('cf-connecting-ip') ??
        request.headers.get('x-forwarded-for')?.split(',')[0]?.trim() ??
        request.headers.get('x-real-ip') ??
        'unknown'
    );
}

function isRateLimited(ip: string): boolean {
    const now = Date.now();
    const timestamps = (rateMap.get(ip) ?? []).filter(t => now - t < RATE_WINDOW_MS);
    if (timestamps.length >= RATE_LIMIT) return true;
    timestamps.push(now);
    rateMap.set(ip, timestamps);
    return false;
}

// ── Sanitizare ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function san(val: FormDataEntryValue | null, maxLen = 255): string {
    if (!val || typeof val !== 'string') return '';
    return val
        .trim()
        // Elimină control chars, normalizează spațiile și taie orice markup HTML.
        .replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F]/g, ' ')
        .replace(/<[^>]*>/g, '')
        .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
        .slice(0, maxLen);
}

function jsonErr(msg: string, status: number): Response {
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: msg }), {
        status,
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json; charset=utf-8' },
    });
}

// ── Handler ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export const POST: APIRoute = async ({ request }) => {
    const ip = getClientIp(request);

    if (isRateLimited(ip)) {
        return jsonErr('Prea multe cereri. Încearcă din nou în câteva minute.', 429);
    }

    let formData: FormData;
    try {
        formData = await request.formData();
    } catch {
        return jsonErr('Date invalide.', 400);
    }

    // Honeypot — bots completează acest câmp, utilizatorii reali nu
    if (formData.get('bot-field')) {
        // Răspundem cu 200 pentru a nu dezvălui mecanismul anti-spam
        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ ok: true }), {
            status: 200,
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json; charset=utf-8' },
        });
    }

    // Validare consimțământ GDPR — obligatoriu (Art. 7 alin. 2 RGPD)
    if (formData.get('gdpr-consent') !== 'da') {
        return jsonErr('Consimțământul GDPR este obligatoriu.', 400);
    }

    // Sanitizare câmpuri
    const nume = san(formData.get('Nume'), 90);
    const telefon = san(formData.get('Telefon'), 20);
    const eveniment = san(formData.get('Eveniment'), 50);
    const data = san(formData.get('Data'), 20);
    const buget = san(formData.get('Buget'), 30);
    const mesaj = san(formData.get('Mesaj'), 1000);

    // Validare câmpuri obligatorii
    if (!nume || !telefon || !eveniment || !data) {
        return jsonErr('Câmpurile obligatorii lipsesc.', 400);
    }

    // Validare format telefon românesc
    if (!/^(0[0-9]{9}|\+40[0-9]{9})$/.test(telefon)) {
        return jsonErr('Număr de telefon invalid (ex: 07xxxxxxxx sau +407xxxxxxxx).', 400);
    }

    // Validare format dată (YYYY-MM-DD)
    if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(data)) {
        return jsonErr('Data evenimentului este invalidă.', 400);
    }

    // Verifică că data nu este în trecut
    const dataEveniment = new Date(data);
    if (isNaN(dataEveniment.getTime()) || dataEveniment < new Date()) {
        return jsonErr('Data evenimentului nu poate fi în trecut.', 400);
    }

    // Salvare în baza de date
    try {
        const mesajSalvat = [
            buget ? `Buget alocat pentru eveniment: ${buget}.` : '',
            mesaj,
        ].filter(Boolean).join('\n');

        await query(
            `INSERT INTO rezervari
         (nume, telefon, eveniment, data_eveniment, mesaj, gdpr_consent, creat_la)
       VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 1, NOW())`,
            [nume, telefon, eveniment, data, mesajSalvat || null],
        );
    } catch (err) {
        secureLogger.error('[/api/rezervare] DB error:', err);
        return jsonErr('Eroare server. Încearcă din nou sau contactează-ne direct la +40767369658.', 500);
    }

    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ ok: true }), {
        status: 200,
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json; charset=utf-8' },
    });
};
```

### src/pages/api/upload-photo.ts
```ts
import type { APIRoute } from 'astro';
import { mkdir, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import path from 'node:path';
import sharp from 'sharp';
import { nanoid } from 'nanoid';
import DOMPurify from 'isomorphic-dompurify';
import { query } from '../../lib/db.js';
import { checkOrigin } from '../../lib/cors.js';
import { secureLogger } from '../../lib/secure-logger.js';

export const prerender = false;

const UPLOAD_WINDOW_MS = 60_000;
const lastUploadByIp = new Map<string, number>();

function resolveClientIp(request: Request): string {
  const cfIp = request.headers.get('cf-connecting-ip');
  if (cfIp) return cfIp;

  const forwarded = request.headers.get('x-forwarded-for');
  if (forwarded) {
    const [firstIp] = forwarded.split(',');
    return firstIp.trim();
  }

  const realIp = request.headers.get('x-real-ip');
  if (realIp) return realIp;

  return 'unknown';
}

function isRateLimited(ip: string): boolean {
  const now = Date.now();

  for (const [key, value] of lastUploadByIp.entries()) {
    if (now - value > UPLOAD_WINDOW_MS) {
      lastUploadByIp.delete(key);
    }
  }

  const lastUploadAt = lastUploadByIp.get(ip) ?? 0;
  if (now - lastUploadAt < UPLOAD_WINDOW_MS) {
    return true;
  }

  lastUploadByIp.set(ip, now);
  return false;
}

const MAX_FILE_SIZE_BYTES = 5 * 1024 * 1024;
const ALLOWED_MIME_TYPES = new Set(['image/jpeg', 'image/jpg', 'image/png', 'image/webp']);
const MAX_AUDIO_FILE_SIZE_BYTES = 4 * 1024 * 1024;
const ALLOWED_AUDIO_MIME_TYPES = new Set(['audio/mpeg', 'audio/mp3']);

function jsonResponse(data: unknown, status = 200, corsOrigin: string | null = null): Response {
  const corsHeaders: Record<string, string> = corsOrigin !== null
    ? { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': corsOrigin, 'Vary': 'Origin' }
    : {};
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(data), {
    status,
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json; charset=utf-8',
      'X-Frame-Options': 'DENY',
      'X-Content-Type-Options': 'nosniff',
      'Referrer-Policy': 'no-referrer',
      'Content-Security-Policy': "default-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'none'",
      ...corsHeaders,
    },
  });
}

export const OPTIONS: APIRoute = ({ request }) => {
  const cors = checkOrigin(request);
  if (!cors.allowed) {
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Origin not allowed' }), {
      status: 403,
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json; charset=utf-8' },
    });
  }
  return new Response(null, {
    status: 204,
    headers: {
      'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': cors.origin ?? '',
      'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'GET,POST,OPTIONS',
      'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type',
      'Access-Control-Max-Age': '86400',
      'Vary': 'Origin',
    },
  });
};

export const POST: APIRoute = async ({ request }) => {
  const cors = checkOrigin(request);
  if (!cors.allowed) {
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Origin not allowed' }), {
      status: 403,
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json; charset=utf-8' },
    });
  }

  const clientIp = resolveClientIp(request);
  if (isRateLimited(clientIp)) {
    return jsonResponse({ error: 'Prea multe cereri. Încearcă din nou în 60 de secunde.' }, 429, cors.origin);
  }

  let formData: FormData;

  try {
    formData = await request.formData();
  } catch {
    return jsonResponse({ error: 'Form data invalid.' }, 400, cors.origin);
  }

  const file = formData.get('photo');
  const audioFile = formData.get('audio');
  const rawTitle = typeof formData.get('title') === 'string' ? String(formData.get('title')) : '';
  const cleanedTitle = DOMPurify.sanitize(rawTitle, { ALLOWED_TAGS: [], ALLOWED_ATTR: [] }).trim();

  if (!(file instanceof File)) {
    return jsonResponse({ error: 'Fisierul photo este obligatoriu.' }, 400, cors.origin);
  }

  const fallbackTitle = file.name.replace(/\.[^/.]+$/, '').trim();
  const title = cleanedTitle || fallbackTitle;

  if (!title || title.length < 2 || title.length > 180) {
    return jsonResponse({ error: 'Titlul este obligatoriu si trebuie sa aiba intre 2 si 180 de caractere.' }, 400, cors.origin);
  }

  if (!ALLOWED_MIME_TYPES.has(file.type.toLowerCase())) {
    return jsonResponse({ error: 'Tip de fisier invalid. Sunt permise doar JPG, PNG sau WebP.' }, 400, cors.origin);
  }

  if (file.size > MAX_FILE_SIZE_BYTES) {
    return jsonResponse({ error: 'Fisierul depaseste limita de 5MB.' }, 400, cors.origin);
  }

  if (audioFile instanceof File) {
    const audioMime = audioFile.type.toLowerCase();
    const audioExtension = audioFile.name.toLowerCase().split('.').pop() ?? '';
    const isMp3ByExtension = audioExtension === 'mp3';

    if (!ALLOWED_AUDIO_MIME_TYPES.has(audioMime) && !isMp3ByExtension) {
      return jsonResponse({ error: 'Fisierul audio trebuie sa fie MP3.' }, 400, cors.origin);
    }

    if (audioFile.size > MAX_AUDIO_FILE_SIZE_BYTES) {
      return jsonResponse({ error: 'Fisierul audio depaseste limita de 4MB.' }, 400, cors.origin);
    }
  }

  try {
    const arrayBuffer = await file.arrayBuffer();
    const buffer = Buffer.from(arrayBuffer);

    const optimized = await sharp(buffer)
      .rotate()
      .flatten({ background: '#0b1024' })
      .resize({
        width: 1200,
        withoutEnlargement: true,
        fit: 'inside',
      })
      .webp({ quality: 82 })
      .toBuffer();

    const uploadsDir = path.join(process.cwd(), 'public', 'uploads', 'community');
    await mkdir(uploadsDir, { recursive: true });

    const fileName = `${nanoid(12)}.webp`;
    const filePath = path.join(uploadsDir, fileName);

    await writeFile(filePath, optimized);

    const publicUrl = `/uploads/community/${fileName}`;
    if (!publicUrl.startsWith('/uploads/community/')) {
      return jsonResponse({ error: 'Cale imagine invalidă.' }, 500, cors.origin);
    }

    await query(
      'INSERT INTO gallery (titlu, imagine_url) VALUES (?, ?)',
      [title, publicUrl],
    );

    let audioUrl = '';
    if (audioFile instanceof File) {
      const audioBuffer = Buffer.from(await audioFile.arrayBuffer());
      const audioDir = path.join(process.cwd(), 'public', 'uploads', 'audio');
      await mkdir(audioDir, { recursive: true });

      const audioFileName = `${fileName.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, '')}.mp3`;
      const audioPath = path.join(audioDir, audioFileName);
      await writeFile(audioPath, audioBuffer);
      audioUrl = `/uploads/audio/${audioFileName}`;
    }

    return jsonResponse({ success: true, url: publicUrl, title, audioUrl }, 201, cors.origin);
  } catch (error) {
    secureLogger.error('Eroare upload photo:', error);
    return jsonResponse({ error: 'Eroare la procesarea imaginii.' }, 500, cors.origin);
  }
};
```

```astro
import BaseLayout from '../layouts/BaseLayout.astro';
import BackButton from '../components/BackButton.astro';

const pageDescription = 'Vezi video reale, repertoriu și cere o ofertă în funcție de bugetul alocat. Formația Florentina Pană răspunde rapid pentru nunți și botezuri.';

const slugify = (value: string) =>
  value
    .toLowerCase()
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')
    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '');

const videoSlug = (video: { title: string; youtubeId: string }) => `${slugify(video.title)}-${video.youtubeId.toLowerCase()}`;

const featuredVideo = videos[0];
const ogImage = '/images/og-cauti-formatie-custom.webp';
const whatsappBudgetOfferHref = 'https://wa.me/40767369658?text=Buna%21%20Spune-ne%20ce%20buget%20ai%20si%20noi%20iti%20facem%20o%20oferta%20pentru%20eveniment.';
const secondaryVideos = videos.slice(1, 9).map((video) => ({
  ...video,
  slug: videoSlug(video),
  thumbWebp: `https://i.ytimg.com/vi_webp/${video.youtubeId}/hqdefault.webp`,
  thumbJpg: `https://img.youtube.com/vi/${video.youtubeId}/hqdefault.jpg`,
}));

const processCards = [
  {
    title: 'Personalizăm Experiența',
    text: 'Playlist dedicat, momente speciale, detalii tehnice impecabile.',
  },
  {
    title: 'Plan Clar Al Serii',
    text: 'Construim ritmul evenimentului cu accentele voastre preferate.',
  },
  {
    title: 'Coordonare Live',
    text: 'Ne sincronizăm cu organizatorii pentru tranziții fără blocaje.',
  },
  {
    title: 'Energie Controlată',
    text: 'Alternăm inteligent momentele tari cu secvențe elegante.',
  },
  {
    title: 'Final Memorabil',
    text: 'Închidem seara în forță, pe piesele care rămân în minte.',
  },
];

const visibleProcessCards = processCards.slice(0, 4);

const shortRepertoire = [
  'Muzică populară de petrecere',
  'Muzică internațională: grecească, arăbească, machedonească',
  'Manele mai vechi și noi',
];

const splitRepertoireItem = (item: string) => {
  const [main, ...rest] = item.split(':');
  return {
    main: main.trim(),
    detail: rest.join(':').trim(),
  };
};

const quickFaq = [
  ...faq,
  {
    question: 'Aveți oferte și pentru buget redus?',
    answer: 'Da. Avem pachete flexibile și putem configura un program adaptat bugetului vostru, fără compromis la energie și profesionalism.',
  },
  {
    question: 'Asigurați și obiceiurile de zi?',
    answer: 'Da, asigurăm și obiceiurile de zi, alături de sonorizare și coordonare, pentru un program complet cap-coadă.',
  },
  {
    question: 'Cântați și manele?',
    answer: 'Da. La cerere, includem manele vechi și noi în repertoriu, dozate corect în funcție de invitați și de dinamica petrecerii.',
  },
];

const topTickerText = 'Dacă ești în căutarea unei Formații de nuntă care știe să facă atmosferă, iată ce îți oferim pentru o seară memorabilă: Show Live 100% cu energie pură, voci remarcabile și conexiune autentică; repertoriu pentru toți, de la cafe-concert elegant și hituri internaționale moderne până la folclor autentic și muzică de petrecere; sunet premium cu echipamente de top pentru claritate impecabilă, adaptată perfect sălii. Hai să scriem împreună soundtrack-ul nunții tale! Contactează-ne și hai să transformăm petrecerea voastră într-o amintire de neuitat.';

      animation-delay: var(--rep-delay, 0ms);

    }

    .response-repertoire-list li:nth-child(6n + 1) { --rep-neon: rgba(0, 224, 255, 0.9); --rep-neon-soft: rgba(0, 224, 255, 0.45); }
    .response-repertoire-list li:nth-child(6n + 2) { --rep-neon: rgba(255, 210, 74, 0.9); --rep-neon-soft: rgba(255, 210, 74, 0.45); }
    .response-repertoire-list li:nth-child(6n + 3) { --rep-neon: rgba(255, 106, 186, 0.9); --rep-neon-soft: rgba(255, 106, 186, 0.45); }
    .response-repertoire-list li:nth-child(6n + 4) { --rep-neon: rgba(167, 112, 255, 0.9); --rep-neon-soft: rgba(167, 112, 255, 0.45); }
    .response-repertoire-list li:nth-child(6n + 5) { --rep-neon: rgba(82, 255, 166, 0.9); --rep-neon-soft: rgba(82, 255, 166, 0.45); }
    .response-repertoire-list li:nth-child(6n + 6) { --rep-neon: rgba(255, 134, 66, 0.9); --rep-neon-soft: rgba(255, 134, 66, 0.45); }

    @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
      .response-repertoire-list li:hover {
        border-color: var(--rep-neon);
        box-shadow:
          0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14),
          0 0 34px var(--rep-neon),
          0 12px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.24);
      }

      .response-repertoire-list li:hover::before {
        filter: blur(20px) saturate(1.36);
        opacity: 1;
      }

      .response-repertoire-list li.is-center {
        border-color: var(--rep-neon);
        box-shadow:
          0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16),
          0 0 40px var(--rep-neon),
          0 0 84px var(--rep-neon-soft),
          0 14px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.24);
        transform: none;
      }

      .response-repertoire-list li.is-center::before {
        filter: blur(22px) saturate(1.42);
        opacity: 1;
      }
    }

    .response-repertoire-main {
      display: block;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #f1f6ff;
      letter-spacing: 0.01em;
      line-height: 1.4;
      text-wrap: balance;
    }

    .response-repertoire-sub {
      display: block;
      color: rgba(209, 224, 248, 0.86);
      font-size: 0.93em;
      line-height: 1.45;
      text-wrap: pretty;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .response-title {
      margin: 0;
      font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
      font-size: clamp(2.15rem, 6.6vw, 4.35rem);
      line-height: 0.92;
      letter-spacing: 0.01em;
      text-transform: none;
      color: #f6f8fc;
      text-wrap: balance;
      max-width: 14ch;
      margin-inline: auto;
    }

    .response-title span {
      color: #ff5a1e;
      text-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(255, 90, 30, 0.2);
    }

    .response-top-announcement-wrap {
      margin: 0 0 1rem;
      position: relative;
      width: 100%;
      overflow: hidden;
      border-radius: 999px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.45);
      background: linear-gradient(140deg, rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.18), rgba(8, 20, 44, 0.92));
      box-shadow:
        inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0, 216, 255, 0.12),
        0 0 26px rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.2);
    }

    .response-top-announcement-wrap::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      width: 3.4rem;
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: 2;
    }

    .response-top-announcement-wrap::before {
      left: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(to right, rgba(7, 17, 37, 0.98), rgba(7, 17, 37, 0));
    }

    .response-top-announcement-track {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      overflow: hidden;
      will-change: transform;
    }

    .response-top-announcement {
      margin: 0;
      display: inline-block;
      color: #f5fbff;
      font-weight: 700;
      line-height: 1.2;
      white-space: nowrap;
      padding: 0.62rem 1.2rem;
      letter-spacing: 0.01em;
      text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.16), 0 1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
      will-change: transform;
    }

    .response-lead,
    .response-section-head p,
    .response-faq-item p,
    .response-footer-cta p {
      color: rgba(235, 244, 255, 0.84);
      line-height: 1.55;
      font-size: 0.98rem;
    }

    .response-pills {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    .response-offer-highlight {
      width: min(100%, 44rem);
      margin-inline: auto;
      padding: 0.75rem 0.95rem;
      border-radius: 1rem;
      border: 1px solid rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.42);
      background: linear-gradient(150deg, rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.16), rgba(10, 24, 52, 0.82));
      box-shadow:
        inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0, 224, 255, 0.14),
        0 0 24px rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.2);
      text-align: center;
    }

    .response-offer-highlight__genres,
    .response-offer-highlight__price {
      margin: 0;
      color: rgba(242, 248, 255, 0.94);
      font-size: 0.92rem;
      line-height: 1.48;
    }

    .response-offer-highlight__genres {
      margin-bottom: 0.28rem;
    }

    .response-offer-highlight__price span {
      color: #ffd16e;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: 0.02em;
      text-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.2);
    }

    .response-pills span {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      padding: 0.36rem 0.75rem;
      border-radius: 999px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
      color: #f8fdff;
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      animation: rise-fade 700ms ease both;
    }

    .response-actions,
    .response-inline-actions,
    .response-footer-actions {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 0.65rem;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    .response-actions {
      width: min(100%, 33rem);
      margin-inline: auto;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 0.55rem;
      background: rgba(5, 10, 20, 0.78);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
      border-radius: 0.95rem;
      padding: 0.45rem;
    }

    .response-actions > a {
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      text-align: center;
      text-wrap: balance;
      animation: rise-fade 620ms ease both;
      min-height: 3.25rem;
    }

    .response-actions > a:nth-child(1) { animation-delay: 40ms; }
    .response-actions > a:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 110ms; }
    .response-actions > a:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 180ms; }
    .response-actions > a:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: 250ms; }

    .response-members-cta {
      margin-top: 0.75rem;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    .response-members-link {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 0.35rem;
      min-height: 2.8rem;
      padding: 0.68rem 1rem;
      border-radius: 999px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.28), rgba(255, 209, 102, 0.18));
      color: #fff7df;
      text-decoration: none;
      font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
      font-size: 0.88rem;
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      animation: rise-fade 700ms ease both;
      animation-delay: 320ms;
      box-shadow: 0 8px 22px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18);
    }

    .btn-ghost {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      min-height: 2.8rem;
      padding: 0.68rem 1.25rem;
      border-radius: 999px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28);
      color: #f8fbff;
      text-decoration: none;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.02em;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
      transition: transform 180ms ease, border-color 180ms ease, background-color 180ms ease;
    }

    .btn-call,
    .btn-wa {
      display: grid;
      grid-auto-flow: column;
      place-items: center;
      min-height: 2.58rem;
      padding: 0.64rem 0.74rem;
      border-radius: 0.82rem;
      text-decoration: none;
      font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
      letter-spacing: 0.02em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.24);
      color: #eff6ff;
      font-size: 0.97rem;
      gap: 0.34rem;
    }

    .btn-call {
      background: rgba(10, 36, 86, 0.68);
    }

    .btn-wa {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(22, 212, 125, 0.98), rgba(89, 255, 170, 0.88));
      color: #02140e;
      border-color: rgba(89, 255, 170, 0.5);
    }

    .btn-call span:first-child,
    .btn-wa span:first-child,
    .btn-solid span:first-child {
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      line-height: 1;
    }

    .btn-solid {
      display: grid;
      grid-auto-flow: column;
      place-items: center;
      gap: 0.34rem;
      min-height: 2.58rem;
      border-radius: 0.82rem;
      font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.02em;
      font-size: 0.97rem;
      padding: 0.64rem 0.74rem;
    }

    .btn-call span:last-child,
    .btn-wa span:last-child,
    .btn-solid span:last-child {
      display: block;
      text-align: center;
      line-height: 1.12;
      max-width: 100%;
      white-space: normal;
    }

    .btn-ghost:hover {
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      border-color: rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.5);
      background: rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.09);
    }

    .response-section-head {
      max-width: 56rem;
      margin: 0 auto 0.8rem;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .response-section-head h2 {
      margin: 0.2rem 0 0;
      font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
      color: #fff;
      font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 3vw, 2.3rem);
      letter-spacing: 0.03em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .response-video-feature {
      margin: 0 auto;
      max-width: 62rem;
    }

    .response-featured-embed {
      border-radius: 1.25rem;
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
      box-shadow: 0 18px 42px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28);
    }

    .response-video-grid {
      margin-top: 0.1rem;
      display: flex;
      gap: 0.9rem;
      overflow-x: auto;
      overflow-y: hidden;
      overscroll-behavior-x: contain;
      scroll-snap-type: x proximity;
      padding-top: 0.55rem;
      padding-bottom: 0.7rem;
      padding-inline: 0.65rem;
      scroll-padding-inline: 0.65rem;
      border-radius: 1.55rem;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
      background: linear-gradient(170deg, rgba(7, 16, 34, 0.88), rgba(4, 10, 24, 0.94));
      box-shadow:
        inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(109, 173, 255, 0.08),
        0 10px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22);
      scrollbar-width: thin;
      scrollbar-color: rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.55) rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    }

    .response-video-card {
      flex: 0 0 clamp(14.5rem, 42vw, 19rem);
      scroll-snap-align: start;
      display: grid;
      gap: 0.55rem;
      position: relative;
      isolation: isolate;
      --card-neon: rgba(0, 224, 255, 0.92);
      --card-neon-soft: rgba(0, 224, 255, 0.5);
      text-decoration: none;
      border-radius: 1.45rem;
      border: 1px solid var(--card-neon-soft);
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(6, 10, 19, 0.96), rgba(3, 7, 14, 0.99));
      padding: 0.68rem;
      transition: transform 180ms ease, border-color 180ms ease, box-shadow 180ms ease;
      animation: rise-fade 500ms ease both;
      animation-delay: var(--card-delay, 0ms);
      box-shadow:
        0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1),
        0 0 28px var(--card-neon-soft),
        0 14px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
    }

    .response-video-card::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: -16px;
      border-radius: 1.75rem;
      z-index: -1;
      pointer-events: none;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 50% 15%, var(--card-neon) 0%, transparent 48%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 50% 90%, var(--card-neon-soft) 0%, transparent 66%);
      filter: blur(18px) saturate(1.24);
      opacity: 0.95;
      transform: translateY(2px) scale(1);
      transition: filter 180ms ease, opacity 180ms ease, transform 180ms ease;
      animation: neon-pulse-strong 2.4s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    .response-video-card::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      border-radius: inherit;
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: 1;
      background:
        linear-gradient(115deg, transparent 0%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16) 46%, transparent 58%);
      transform: translateX(-125%);
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity 220ms ease, transform 420ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
    }

    .response-video-card:nth-child(6n + 1) { --card-neon: rgba(0, 224, 255, 0.92); --card-neon-soft: rgba(0, 224, 255, 0.5); }
    .response-video-card:nth-child(6n + 2) { --card-neon: rgba(255, 210, 74, 0.92); --card-neon-soft: rgba(255, 210, 74, 0.5); }
    .response-video-card:nth-child(6n + 3) { --card-neon: rgba(255, 106, 186, 0.92); --card-neon-soft: rgba(255, 106, 186, 0.5); }
    .response-video-card:nth-child(6n + 4) { --card-neon: rgba(167, 112, 255, 0.92); --card-neon-soft: rgba(167, 112, 255, 0.5); }
    .response-video-card:nth-child(6n + 5) { --card-neon: rgba(82, 255, 166, 0.92); --card-neon-soft: rgba(82, 255, 166, 0.5); }
    .response-video-card:nth-child(6n + 6) { --card-neon: rgba(255, 134, 66, 0.92); --card-neon-soft: rgba(255, 134, 66, 0.5); }

    .response-video-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-3px);
      border-color: var(--card-neon);
      box-shadow:
        0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14),
        0 0 34px var(--card-neon),
        0 0 70px var(--card-neon-soft),
        0 16px 34px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.26);
    }

    .response-video-card:hover::before {
      filter: blur(22px) saturate(1.38);
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translateY(0) scale(1.02);
    }

    .response-video-card.is-center {
      border-color: var(--card-neon);
      box-shadow:
        0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16),
        0 0 44px var(--card-neon),
        0 0 92px var(--card-neon-soft),
        0 18px 38px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
      transform: scale(1.015);
    }

    .response-video-card.is-center::before {
      filter: blur(26px) saturate(1.48);
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translateY(0) scale(1.04);
    }

    .response-video-card:hover::after {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translateX(125%);
    }

    .response-video-thumb {
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      border-radius: 1.05rem;
      aspect-ratio: 4 / 5;
      background: #0b1220;
    }

    .response-video-thumb::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(4, 8, 16, 0.1) 35%, rgba(4, 8, 16, 0.78) 100%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .response-video-index {
      position: absolute;
      top: 0.4rem;
      left: 0.5rem;
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.78);
      font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
      font-size: clamp(2.6rem, 8vw, 3.6rem);
      line-height: 1;
      letter-spacing: 0.03em;
      text-shadow: 0 4px 18px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .response-video-thumb img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
      display: block;
    }

    .response-video-image {
      opacity: 1;
    }

    .response-video-play {
      position: absolute;
      inset: auto 0.65rem 0.65rem auto;
      transform: none;
      display: inline-grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 2.4rem;
      height: 2.4rem;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: rgba(5, 13, 29, 0.78);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
      color: #fff;
      font-size: 1rem;
      box-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(11, 188, 214, 0.2);
      z-index: 2;
    }

    .response-video-card p {
      margin: 0;
      color: #ff6a1a;
      font-size: 1.02rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.45;
      overflow-wrap: anywhere;
      word-break: break-word;
      display: -webkit-box;
      -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
      -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
      overflow: hidden;
      min-height: 2.65em;
    }

    .response-video-copy {
      color: rgba(238, 245, 255, 0.92);
      font-size: 0.89rem;
      line-height: 1.55;
      overflow-wrap: anywhere;
      word-break: break-word;
      min-height: 3.1em;
      display: block;
    }

    .response-inline-actions {
      margin-top: 1rem;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    .response-scroll-shell {
      position: relative;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      margin-top: 0.9rem;
    }

    .response-scroll-btn {
      width: 2.2rem;
      height: 2.2rem;
      border-radius: 999px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.24);
      background: rgba(5, 13, 29, 0.82);
      color: #fff;
      font-size: 1.55rem;
      line-height: 1;
      display: inline-grid;
      place-items: center;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: transform 180ms ease, border-color 180ms ease;
    }

    .response-scroll-btn:hover {
      transform: translateY(-1px);
      border-color: rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.62);
    }

    .response-video-grid::-webkit-scrollbar,
    .response-repertoire-list::-webkit-scrollbar {
      height: 0.48rem;
    }

    .response-video-grid::-webkit-scrollbar-track,
    .response-repertoire-list::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      border-radius: 999px;
    }

    .response-video-grid::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb,
    .response-repertoire-list::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(11, 188, 214, 0.9), rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.92));
      border-radius: 999px;
    }

    .response-faq-list {
      display: grid;
      gap: 0.55rem;
      max-width: 62rem;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .response-faq-item {
      position: relative;
      isolation: isolate;
      --faq-neon: rgba(111, 197, 255, 0.76);
      border-radius: 0.95rem;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18);
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(12, 20, 46, 0.78), rgba(10, 18, 40, 0.84));
      box-shadow:
        inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(126, 155, 255, 0.08),
        0 0 20px rgba(126, 155, 255, 0.24);
      padding: 0.08rem 0.9rem;
    }

    .response-faq-item::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: -10px;
      border-radius: 1rem;
      z-index: -1;
      pointer-events: none;
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, var(--faq-neon) 0%, transparent 68%);
      filter: blur(14px);
      opacity: 0.82;
      animation: neon-pulse-soft 3s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    .response-faq-item summary {
      text-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    }

    .response-faq-item:nth-child(6n + 1) { --faq-neon: rgba(0, 224, 255, 0.72); }
    .response-faq-item:nth-child(6n + 2) { --faq-neon: rgba(255, 210, 74, 0.72); }
    .response-faq-item:nth-child(6n + 3) { --faq-neon: rgba(255, 106, 186, 0.72); }
    .response-faq-item:nth-child(6n + 4) { --faq-neon: rgba(167, 112, 255, 0.72); }
    .response-faq-item:nth-child(6n + 5) { --faq-neon: rgba(82, 255, 166, 0.72); }
    .response-faq-item:nth-child(6n + 6) { --faq-neon: rgba(255, 134, 66, 0.72); }

    .response-faq-item summary {
      list-style: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 1rem;
      padding: 0.78rem 0;
      color: #fff;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 0.97rem;
    }

    .response-faq-item summary::-webkit-details-marker {
      display: none;
    }

    .response-faq-item p {
      margin: 0 0 0.82rem;
      font-size: 0.9rem;
    }

    .response-footer-cta {
      max-width: 62rem;
      margin: 1rem auto 0;
      padding: 1.05rem 1rem;
      border-radius: 1.1rem;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18);
      box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(112, 146, 255, 0.08);
      background: linear-gradient(170deg, rgba(21, 65, 127, 0.42), rgba(12, 43, 96, 0.58));
      text-align: center;
    }

    .response-footer-cta p {
      margin: 0;
      max-width: 43ch;
      margin-inline: auto;
      font-size: 1.02rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: rgba(241, 246, 255, 0.94);
    }

    .response-footer-actions {
      margin-top: 0.92rem;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    @keyframes rise-fade {
      from {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: translateY(16px);
      }

      to {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translateY(0);
      }
    }

    @keyframes neon-pulse-strong {
      0%, 100% {
        opacity: 0.85;
        filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.15);
      }
      50% {
        opacity: 1;
        filter: blur(24px) saturate(1.45);
      }
    }

    @keyframes neon-pulse-soft {
      0%, 100% {
        opacity: 0.72;
        filter: blur(13px) saturate(1.1);
      }
      50% {
        opacity: 0.95;
        filter: blur(18px) saturate(1.32);
      }
    }

    @media (min-width: 64rem) {
      .response-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        align-items: center;
      }

      .response-copy {
        padding-right: 0;
        text-align: center;
        margin-inline: auto;
      }

      .response-title {
        margin-inline: auto;
      }

      .response-pills,
      .response-actions {
        justify-content: center;
      }

      .response-top-announcement-wrap {
        margin-inline: auto;
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 48rem) {
      .response-shell {
        border-radius: 1.1rem;
      }

      .btn-call,
      .btn-wa,
      .response-actions .btn-solid {
        min-height: 2.45rem;
        padding: 0.58rem 0.34rem;
        font-size: 0.82rem;
        letter-spacing: 0.01em;
        gap: 0.2rem;
      }

      .response-actions a span:last-child {
        line-height: 1.04;
        text-wrap: balance;
      }

      .response-actions > a {
        min-height: 3.35rem;
      }

      .response-actions > a:nth-child(4) {
        grid-column: 1 / -1;
      }

      .response-actions .btn-solid {
        min-height: 3rem;
      }

      .btn-wa span:last-child {
        font-size: 0.76rem;
      }

      .response-scroll-shell {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }

      .response-scroll-btn {
        display: none;
      }

      .response-video-card {
        flex-basis: min(78vw, 16.5rem);
      }

      .response-video-grid {
        padding-inline: 0.58rem;
        scroll-padding-inline: 0.58rem;
        border-radius: 1.25rem;
      }

      .response-video-card:nth-child(n + 4) {
        display: none;
      }

      .response-more-videos {
        margin-top: 0.65rem;
        display: flex;
        justify-content: center;
      }

      .response-more-videos-link {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        min-height: 2.65rem;
        padding: 0.65rem 1rem;
        border-radius: 999px;
        border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22);
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
        color: #f8fbff;
        text-decoration: none;
        font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
        font-size: 0.86rem;
        letter-spacing: 0.04em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
      }

      .response-actions {
        width: 100%;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
      }

      .response-members-cta {
        margin-top: 0.85rem;
      }

      .response-members-link {
        width: 100%;
        min-height: 3rem;
        font-size: 0.84rem;
      }

      .response-repertoire-list li {
        flex-basis: min(85vw, 18rem);
      }

      .response-repertoire-list li:nth-child(n) {
        animation-delay: calc(var(--rep-delay, 0ms) + 40ms);
      }

      .response-offer-highlight {
        padding: 0.66rem 0.72rem;
        border-radius: 0.9rem;
      }

      .response-offer-highlight__genres,
      .response-offer-highlight__price {
        font-size: 0.86rem;
      }

      .response-top-announcement {
        font-size: 0.88rem;
      }

      .response-video-card::before {
        opacity: 1;
        filter: blur(20px) saturate(1.34);
      }

      .response-video-card,
      .response-video-card:hover,
      .response-video-card.is-center {
        transform: none;
      }

      .response-video-card::after,
      .response-video-card:hover::after {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: none;
      }

      .response-video-thumb {
        aspect-ratio: 16 / 11;
      }

      .response-video-thumb img {
        object-position: center top;
      }

      .response-video-play {
        width: 2.1rem;
        height: 2.1rem;
      }

      .response-video-index {
        font-size: clamp(2.15rem, 11vw, 3rem);
      }

      .response-repertoire-list li::before,
      .response-faq-item::before {
        opacity: 0.92;
      }
    }

    @media (hover: none) and (pointer: coarse) {
      .response-video-grid {
        touch-action: auto;
      }

      .response-video-card,
      .response-video-card:hover,
      .response-video-card:active,
      .response-video-card:focus,
      .response-video-card:focus-visible {
        transform: none !important;
        -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
        -webkit-touch-callout: none;
        user-select: none;
        -webkit-user-select: none;
      }

      .response-video-thumb img {
        -webkit-user-drag: none;
        user-select: none;
        -webkit-user-select: none;
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 24rem) {
      .btn-call,
      .btn-wa,
      .response-actions .btn-solid {
        font-size: 0.74rem;
        padding-inline: 0.25rem;
      }

      .btn-call span:first-child,
      .btn-wa span:first-child,
      .response-actions .btn-solid span:first-child {
        display: none;
      }
    }

    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      .response-copy,
      .response-video-card,
      .response-pills span {
        animation: none;
      }

      .response-top-announcement-track {
        transform: none !important;
        width: 100%;
        display: block;
      }

      .response-top-announcement {
        white-space: normal;
        padding: 0.62rem 0.9rem;
      }

      .response-video-card::before,
      .response-video-card::after,
      .response-repertoire-list li::before,
      .response-faq-item::before {
        animation: none;
      }
    }
  </style>

  <script>
    const tickerTrack = document.querySelector('[data-ticker-track]');

    if (tickerTrack && !window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) {
      const tickerItem = tickerTrack.querySelector('[data-ticker-item]');

      if (tickerItem) {
        let rafId = 0;
        let resizeRaf = 0;
        let lastTime = performance.now();
        let offset = 0;
        let loopDistance = 0;
        let startOffset = 0;
        const speedPxPerSecond = 96;

        const measureTicker = () => {
          const wrapWidth = tickerTrack.clientWidth;
          const itemWidth = tickerItem.scrollWidth;
          if (!wrapWidth || !itemWidth) {
            return;
          }

          startOffset = wrapWidth;
          loopDistance = itemWidth;
          offset = startOffset;
          tickerItem.style.transform = `translateX(${offset}px)`;
          lastTime = performance.now();
        };

        const tick = (time) => {
          const dt = (time - lastTime) / 1000;
          lastTime = time;

          if (loopDistance > 0) {
            offset -= speedPxPerSecond * dt;
            if (offset <= -loopDistance - 12) {
              offset = startOffset;
            }
            tickerItem.style.transform = `translateX(${offset}px)`;
          }

          rafId = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
        };

        measureTicker();
        rafId = requestAnimationFrame(tick);

        if (document.fonts && document.fonts.ready) {
          document.fonts.ready.then(() => {
            measureTicker();
          });
        }

        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
          if (resizeRaf) {
            cancelAnimationFrame(resizeRaf);
          }
          resizeRaf = requestAnimationFrame(measureTicker);
        }, { passive: true });

        if ('ResizeObserver' in window) {
          const ro = new ResizeObserver(() => {
            if (resizeRaf) {
              cancelAnimationFrame(resizeRaf);
            }
            resizeRaf = requestAnimationFrame(measureTicker);
          });
          ro.observe(tickerTrack);
          ro.observe(tickerItem);
        }
      }
    }

    const shells = document.querySelectorAll('[data-scroll-shell]');

    function initCenterHighlight(lane) {
      if (window.matchMedia('(max-width: 48rem)').matches) {
        return;
      }

      const cards = lane.matches('.response-video-grid')
        ? Array.from(lane.querySelectorAll('.response-video-card'))
        : Array.from(lane.querySelectorAll('li'));

      if (!cards.length) {
        return;
      }

      let rafId = 0;

      const updateCenterCard = () => {
        rafId = 0;
        const laneRect = lane.getBoundingClientRect();
        const laneCenter = laneRect.left + laneRect.width / 2;

        let closest = null;
        let minDistance = Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;

        cards.forEach((card) => {
          const rect = card.getBoundingClientRect();
          const cardCenter = rect.left + rect.width / 2;
          const distance = Math.abs(cardCenter - laneCenter);
          if (distance < minDistance) {
            minDistance = distance;
            closest = card;
          }
        });

        cards.forEach((card) => card.classList.remove('is-center'));
        if (closest) {
          closest.classList.add('is-center');
        }
      };

      const requestUpdate = () => {
        if (rafId) {
          return;
        }
        rafId = requestAnimationFrame(updateCenterCard);
      };

      lane.addEventListener('scroll', requestUpdate, { passive: true });
      window.addEventListener('resize', requestUpdate, { passive: true });
      requestUpdate();
    }

    shells.forEach((shell) => {
      const lane = shell.querySelector('.response-video-grid, .response-repertoire-list');
      const prev = shell.querySelector('[data-scroll-prev]');
      const next = shell.querySelector('[data-scroll-next]');

      if (!lane || !prev || !next) {
        return;
      }

      const step = () => Math.max(260, lane.clientWidth * 0.75);

      prev.addEventListener('click', () => {
        lane.scrollBy({ left: -step(), behavior: 'smooth' });
      });

      next.addEventListener('click', () => {
        lane.scrollBy({ left: step(), behavior: 'smooth' });
      });

      initCenterHighlight(lane);
    });
  </script>
</BaseLayout>
```

```astro
import BaseLayout from '../../layouts/BaseLayout.astro';

<BaseLayout
  title={`Colaborator Saxofon | ${brand.name}`}

>

            <span class="collab-moment-pill"><span aria-hidden="true">🎉</span> Petrecere premium</span>
            <span class="collab-moment-pill"><span aria-hidden="true">🏢</span> Gale corporate</span>
```

### src/pages/comunitate/[slug].astro
```astro
---
import BaseLayout from '../../layouts/BaseLayout.astro';
import CoupleHero from '../../components/CoupleHero.astro';
import CoupleGallery from '../../components/CoupleGallery.astro';
import CoupleRecommendation from '../../components/CoupleRecommendation.astro';
import BackButton from '../../components/BackButton.astro';
import siteContent from '../../data/siteContent.json';
import couplesData from '../../data/couples.json';

export const prerender = true;

interface Couple {
  slug: string;
  names: string;
  city: string;
  date: string;
  isoDate: string;
  locationName: string;
  locationAddress: string;
  coverPhoto: string;
  accentColor: string;
  accentGlow: string;
  loveStory: string;
  recommendation: string;
  recommendationSource: string;
  danceVideoUrl: string;
  photos: string[];
  blogSlug: string;
  uploadToken: string;
}

export function getStaticPaths() {
  return (couplesData.couples as Couple[]).map((couple) => ({
    params: { slug: couple.slug },
    props: { couple },
  }));
}

const { couple } = Astro.props as { couple: Couple };

const { brand } = siteContent;

const youtubeId = couple.danceVideoUrl
  ? new URL(couple.danceVideoUrl).searchParams.get('v') || ''
  : '';

const pageTitle = `${couple.names} — Povestea lor | ${brand.name}`;
const pageDescription = `Descoperă povestea de dragoste a perechii ${couple.names} din ${couple.city}. Recomandare, galerie foto și dansul mirilor — ${brand.name}.`;

const SITE = 'https://www.florentinapanaofficial.ro';
const coupleOgImage = couple.coverPhoto
  ? encodeURI(decodeURI(couple.coverPhoto.startsWith('http') ? couple.coverPhoto : `${SITE}${couple.coverPhoto}`))
  : undefined;

const eventLd = {
  '@context': 'https://schema.org',
  '@type': 'Event',
  name: `Nuntă ${couple.names}`,
  startDate: couple.isoDate,
  location: {
    '@type': 'Place',
    name: couple.locationName,
    address: couple.locationAddress,
  },
  performer: {
    '@type': 'MusicGroup',
    name: brand.name,
  },
  description: pageDescription,
};

const reviewLd = {
  '@context': 'https://schema.org',
  '@type': 'Review',
  reviewBody: couple.recommendation,
  author: { '@type': 'Person', name: couple.names },
  itemReviewed: {
    '@type': 'MusicGroup',
    name: brand.name,
  },
  reviewRating: {
    '@type': 'Rating',
    ratingValue: '5',
    bestRating: '5',
  },
};
---

<BaseLayout
  title={pageTitle}
  description={pageDescription}
  ogImage={coupleOgImage}
>
  <main class="couple-page">
    <BackButton href="/comunitate/" label="← Comunitate" />

    <!-- Hero -->
    <CoupleHero
      names={couple.names}
      city={couple.city}
      date={couple.date}
      locationName={couple.locationName}
      coverPhoto={couple.coverPhoto}
      accentColor={couple.accentColor}
      accentGlow={couple.accentGlow}
    />

    <!-- Nav intern -->
    <nav class="couple-page__nav" aria-label="Secțiuni">
      <a href="#poveste" class="couple-page__nav-link" style={`--nav-accent: ${couple.accentColor};`}>💕 Povestea</a>
      <a href="#recomandare" class="couple-page__nav-link" style={`--nav-accent: ${couple.accentColor};`}>💬 Recomandare</a>
      <a href="#galerie" class="couple-page__nav-link" style={`--nav-accent: ${couple.accentColor};`}>📸 Galerie</a>
      <a href="#dans" class="couple-page__nav-link" style={`--nav-accent: ${couple.accentColor};`}>💃 Dansul Mirilor</a>
    </nav>

    <!-- 1. Povestea de dragoste -->
    <section class="couple-section" id="poveste" style={`--section-accent: ${couple.accentColor};`}>
      <h2 class="couple-section__title">💕 Povestea lor de dragoste</h2>
      <div class="couple-section__content">
        <p>{couple.loveStory}</p>
      </div>
    </section>

    <!-- 2. Recomandare -->
    <CoupleRecommendation
      recommendation={couple.recommendation}
      names={couple.names}
      recommendationSource={couple.recommendationSource}
      accentColor={couple.accentColor}
      accentGlow={couple.accentGlow}
    />

    <!-- 3. Galerie Foto -->
    <CoupleGallery
      photos={couple.photos}
      names={couple.names}
      accentColor={couple.accentColor}
    />

    <!-- 4. Dansul Mirilor -->
    <section class="couple-section" id="dans" style={`--section-accent: ${couple.accentColor};`}>
      <h2 class="couple-section__title">💃 Dansul Mirilor</h2>

      {youtubeId ? (
        <div class="couple-dance__video">
          <iframe
            src={`https://www.youtube.com/embed/${youtubeId}?rel=0`}
            title={`Dansul Mirilor — ${couple.names}`}
            allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture"
            allowfullscreen
            loading="lazy"
          ></iframe>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div class="couple-dance__empty">
          <p>🎵 Videoclipul cu dansul mirilor va fi adăugat în curând.</p>
        </div>
      )}
    </section>

    <!-- CTA -->
    {couple.blogSlug && (
      <div class="couple-page__cta">
        <a href={`/blog/${couple.blogSlug}/`} class="couple-page__cta-link" style={`--cta-accent: ${couple.accentColor};`}>
          📰 Citește articolul dedicat → {couple.names}
        </a>
      </div>
    )}

    <!-- JSON-LD -->
    <script is:inline type="application/ld+json" set:html={JSON.stringify(eventLd)} />
    <script is:inline type="application/ld+json" set:html={JSON.stringify(reviewLd)} />
  </main>
</BaseLayout>

<style>
  .couple-page {
    padding-bottom: 3rem;
  }

  /* Nav intern */
  .couple-page__nav {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    padding: 1rem 1.5rem;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    max-width: 720px;
    margin: 0 auto;
  }

  .couple-page__nav-link {
    padding: 0.5rem 1rem;
    border-radius: 2rem;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7);
    text-decoration: none;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    transition: all 0.25s ease;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  .couple-page__nav-link:hover {
    color: var(--nav-accent);
    border-color: var(--nav-accent);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  }

  /* Sections */
  .couple-section {
    padding: 3rem 1.5rem;
    max-width: 720px;
    margin: 0 auto;
  }

  .couple-section__title {
    font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
    font-size: 1.75rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--section-accent);
    text-align: center;
    margin: 0 0 1.5rem;
  }

  .couple-section__content {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    border-radius: 1rem;
    padding: 2rem;
  }

  .couple-section__content p {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85);
    line-height: 1.8;
    font-size: 1.05rem;
    margin: 0;
  }

  /* Dance Video */
  .couple-dance__video {
    position: relative;
    padding-bottom: 56.25%;
    height: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    border-radius: 1rem;
    max-width: 720px;
    margin: 0 auto;
  }

  .couple-dance__video iframe {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 1rem;
  }

  .couple-dance__empty {
    text-align: center;
    padding: 2rem;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
    border: 1px dashed rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
    border-radius: 1rem;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6);
  }

  /* CTA Blog */
  .couple-page__cta {
    text-align: center;
    padding: 2rem 1.5rem;
    max-width: 720px;
    margin: 0 auto;
  }

  .couple-page__cta-link {
    display: inline-block;
    padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem;
    border-radius: 2rem;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
    color: var(--cta-accent);
    text-decoration: none;
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    transition: all 0.25s ease;
  }

  .couple-page__cta-link:hover {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
    border-color: var(--cta-accent);
  }

  @media (max-width: 767px) {
    .couple-section {
      padding: 2rem 1rem;
    }

    .couple-section__content {
      padding: 1.25rem;
    }

    .couple-page__nav {
      gap: 0.35rem;
      padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
    }

    .couple-page__nav-link {
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      padding: 0.4rem 0.75rem;
    }
  }
</style>
```
