```astro
import BaseLayout from '../layouts/BaseLayout.astro';
import BackButton from '../components/BackButton.astro';
import EmbedSnippet from '../components/EmbedSnippet.astro';
import PhotoGallery from '../components/PhotoGallery.astro';
import { readdir, stat } from 'node:fs/promises';
import path from 'node:path';

/* ── Date galerie: toate pozele din colecție ──
   REGULĂ: Pozele NOI se adaugă ÎNTOTDEAUNA la începutul array-ului (sus),
   în blocul "🆕 ULTIMELE ADĂUGATE". Astfel vizitatorii văd primii cele mai
   recente momente. Pozele vechi rămân în blocul de mai jos, în ordinea lor. */
const base = "/images/galerie-foto-site";
type GalleryPhoto = { src: string; alt: string; cat: string };
type DirPhotoMeta = { name: string; mtimeMs: number };

const basePhotos = [
  // ═══ DOAR PRIMELE 5 — restul pozelor sunt afișate pe pagina /membri/ ═══
  { src: `${base}/Eveniment%20Arabesc.jpg`, alt: "Formația Florentina Pană cu trupa Arabesc la eveniment live", cat: "evenimente" },
  { src: `${base}/Galerie Evenimente 1.jpg`, alt: "Eveniment live cu Formația Florentina Pană", cat: "evenimente" },
  { src: `${base}/Galerie Evenimente 2.jpg`, alt: "Scenă completă la eveniment live", cat: "evenimente" },
];

// Folosim process.cwd() + path.join pentru a evita probleme cu spații în new URL()
const extraPhotoDirPath = path.join(process.cwd(), 'public', 'images', 'poze 09.07.2026');
const allowedExt = new Set(['.jpg', '.jpeg', '.png', '.webp', '.avif']);
const blockedPhotoTokens = ['grup 1', 'grup 2', 'grup selfi', 'grup arabesc'];
let latestPhotos: GalleryPhoto[] = [];

try {
  const entries = await readdir(extraPhotoDirPath, { withFileTypes: true });
  const filesWithMeta = await Promise.all(
    entries
      .filter((entry) => entry.isFile())
      .map(async (entry) => {
        const name = entry.name;
        const lowerName = name.toLowerCase();
        if (blockedPhotoTokens.some((token) => lowerName.includes(token))) return null;
        const ext = name.includes('.') ? `.${name.split('.').pop()?.toLowerCase()}` : '';
        if (!allowedExt.has(ext)) return null;
        const filePath = path.join(extraPhotoDirPath, name);
        const meta = await stat(filePath);
        return { name, mtimeMs: meta.mtimeMs } as DirPhotoMeta;
      }),
  );

  latestPhotos = filesWithMeta
    .filter((item): item is DirPhotoMeta => item !== null)
    .sort((a, b) => b.mtimeMs - a.mtimeMs)
    .map(({ name }) => {
      const cleanName = name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, '').replace(/[\-_]+/g, ' ').trim();
      return {
        src: `/images/poze%2009.07.2026/${encodeURIComponent(name)}`,
        alt: `Foto eveniment Formația Florentina Pană - ${cleanName || 'live'}`,
        cat: 'evenimente',
      };
    });
} catch {
  latestPhotos = [];
}

const photos = [...latestPhotos, ...basePhotos];

    <!-- ═══ GALERIE VIRALĂ — distribuire & backlinks ═══ -->

<!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════
     SCRIPT — Filtre, Lightbox, Swipe, Keyboard
═══════════════════════════════════════════ -->
<script is:inline>
  const items = document.querySelectorAll('.gal-item');

  // ── Montaj cinematic autoplay ──
  const montageRoot = document.querySelector('[data-montage-root]');
  const montageSlides = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[data-montage-slide]'));
  const montageStage = document.querySelector('[data-montage-stage]');
  const montagePrev = document.querySelector('[data-montage-prev]');
  const montageNext = document.querySelector('[data-montage-next]');
  const montagePlay = document.querySelector('[data-montage-play]');
  const montageBeat = document.querySelector('[data-montage-beat]');
  const montageAutoBeat = document.querySelector('[data-montage-autobeat]');
  const montagePreset = document.querySelector('[data-montage-preset]');
  const montageBpm = document.querySelector('[data-montage-bpm]');
  const montageBpmVal = document.querySelector('[data-montage-bpm-val]');
  const montageSense = document.querySelector('[data-montage-sense]');
  const montageSenseVal = document.querySelector('[data-montage-sense-val]');
  const montageAudio = document.querySelector('[data-montage-audio]');
  const beatBars = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[data-beat-bar]'));
  let montageIndex = 0;
  let montageTimer = null;
  let beatTimer = null;
  let montagePlaying = true;
  let beatEnabled = true;
  let autoBeatEnabled = true;
  let currentPreset = 'elegant';
  let beatBarIdx = 0;
  let audioCtx = null;
  let analyser = null;
  let sourceNode = null;
  let beatRaf = 0;
  let lastDetectedAt = 0;
  let lastAutoPresetAt = 0;
  let lastEnergyTarget = 'elegant';
  let energyTargetStreak = 0;
  const lowEnergyHistory = [];
  const totalEnergyHistory = [];

  function getBeatSensitivity() {
    const raw = Number(montageSense?.value || 130);
    return Number.isFinite(raw) ? raw / 100 : 1.3;
  }

  function syncUsesAudioBeats() {
    return beatEnabled && autoBeatEnabled && !!analyser && !!montageAudio && !montageAudio.paused;
  }

  function triggerBeatBar() {
    if (!beatBars.length) return;
    const bar = beatBars[beatBarIdx % beatBars.length];
    beatBarIdx += 1;
    if (!bar) return;
    bar.classList.remove('is-hit');
    void bar.offsetWidth;
    bar.classList.add('is-hit');
  }

  function setMontagePreset(nextPreset) {
    const normalized = nextPreset || 'elegant';
    if (currentPreset === normalized) return;
    currentPreset = normalized;
    if (montagePreset && montagePreset.value !== normalized) {
      montagePreset.value = normalized;
    }
    if (montageStage) montageStage.setAttribute('data-preset', currentPreset);
    renderMontage(montageIndex);
  }

  async function ensureAudioGraph() {
    if (!montageAudio || !window.AudioContext) return;
    if (!audioCtx) audioCtx = new window.AudioContext();
    if (!analyser) {
      analyser = audioCtx.createAnalyser();
      analyser.fftSize = 1024;
      analyser.smoothingTimeConstant = 0.82;
    }
    if (!sourceNode) {
      sourceNode = audioCtx.createMediaElementSource(montageAudio);
      sourceNode.connect(analyser);
      analyser.connect(audioCtx.destination);
    }
    if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') {
      await audioCtx.resume();
    }
  }

  function stopBeatDetection() {
    if (beatRaf) cancelAnimationFrame(beatRaf);
    beatRaf = 0;
    lowEnergyHistory.length = 0;
    totalEnergyHistory.length = 0;
    energyTargetStreak = 0;
  }

  function startBeatDetection() {
    if (!analyser || !montageAudio) return;
    const freq = new Uint8Array(analyser.frequencyBinCount);
    const minGapMs = 220;

    const loop = () => {
      analyser.getByteFrequencyData(freq);
      const lowBins = Math.max(10, Math.floor(freq.length * 0.1));
      const midStart = lowBins;
      const midEnd = Math.max(midStart + 10, Math.floor(freq.length * 0.42));
      const highStart = midEnd;
      const highEnd = Math.max(highStart + 10, Math.floor(freq.length * 0.82));
      let lowEnergy = 0;
      let midEnergy = 0;
      let highEnergy = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < lowBins; i += 1) lowEnergy += freq[i];
      for (let i = midStart; i < midEnd; i += 1) midEnergy += freq[i];
      for (let i = highStart; i < highEnd; i += 1) highEnergy += freq[i];
      lowEnergy /= lowBins;
      midEnergy /= Math.max(1, midEnd - midStart);
      highEnergy /= Math.max(1, highEnd - highStart);

      const totalEnergy = (lowEnergy * 0.62) + (midEnergy * 0.28) + (highEnergy * 0.10);

      lowEnergyHistory.push(lowEnergy);
      if (lowEnergyHistory.length > 44) lowEnergyHistory.shift();
      totalEnergyHistory.push(totalEnergy);
      if (totalEnergyHistory.length > 44) totalEnergyHistory.shift();
      const avg = lowEnergyHistory.reduce((sum, v) => sum + v, 0) / (lowEnergyHistory.length || 1);
      const avgTotal = totalEnergyHistory.reduce((sum, v) => sum + v, 0) / (totalEnergyHistory.length || 1);
      const threshold = avg * getBeatSensitivity();
      const energyRatio = totalEnergy / Math.max(1, avgTotal);
      const now = performance.now();

      if (syncUsesAudioBeats()) {
        let energyTarget = 'elegant';
        if (energyRatio > 1.22 && lowEnergy > 74) energyTarget = 'party';
        else if (energyRatio < 0.93 || lowEnergy < 54) energyTarget = 'romantic';

        if (energyTarget === lastEnergyTarget) energyTargetStreak += 1;
        else {
          lastEnergyTarget = energyTarget;
          energyTargetStreak = 1;
        }

        if (
          energyTargetStreak >= 14
          && energyTarget !== currentPreset
          && now - lastAutoPresetAt > 2400
        ) {
          lastAutoPresetAt = now;
          setMontagePreset(energyTarget);
        }
      }

      if (lowEnergy > threshold && now - lastDetectedAt > minGapMs) {
        lastDetectedAt = now;
        triggerBeatBar();
        if (syncUsesAudioBeats() && montagePlaying) {
          nextMontage();
        }
      }

      if (!montageAudio.paused && montageAudio.ended === false) {
        beatRaf = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
      }
    };

    stopBeatDetection();
    beatRaf = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  function getBpm() {
    const raw = Number(montageBpm?.value || 118);
    return Number.isFinite(raw) ? raw : 118;
  }

  function getSlideDuration() {
    if (!beatEnabled) return 3600;
    const beatMs = 60000 / getBpm();
    return Math.round(beatMs * 8);
  }

  function getFxClass(idx) {
    const map = {
      elegant: ['fx-kenburns', 'fx-pan-left', 'fx-pan-right'],
      party: ['fx-punch', 'fx-sweep-left', 'fx-sweep-right', 'fx-spin-micro'],
      romantic: ['fx-soft-zoom', 'fx-drift-left', 'fx-drift-right'],
    };
    const list = map[currentPreset] || map.elegant;
    return list[idx % list.length];
  }

  function renderMontage(index) {
    if (!montageSlides.length) return;
    montageIndex = (index + montageSlides.length) % montageSlides.length;
    montageSlides.forEach((slide, i) => {
      slide.classList.toggle('is-active', i === montageIndex);
      slide.classList.remove('fx-kenburns', 'fx-pan-left', 'fx-pan-right', 'fx-punch', 'fx-sweep-left', 'fx-sweep-right', 'fx-spin-micro', 'fx-soft-zoom', 'fx-drift-left', 'fx-drift-right');
      if (i === montageIndex) slide.classList.add(getFxClass(i));
    });
  }

  function nextMontage() {
    renderMontage(montageIndex + 1);
  }

  async function playMontageAudio() {
    if (!montageAudio || !montageAudio.src) return;
    try {
      await ensureAudioGraph();
      if (montageAudio.paused) {
        await montageAudio.play();
      }
      startBeatDetection();
    } catch {
      stopBeatDetection();
    }
  }

  function pauseMontageAudio() {
    if (!montageAudio) return;
    if (!montageAudio.paused) montageAudio.pause();
    stopBeatDetection();
  }

  function startMontage() {
    if (!montageSlides.length) return;
    stopMontage();
    if (!syncUsesAudioBeats()) {
      montageTimer = setInterval(nextMontage, getSlideDuration());
    }
    montagePlaying = true;

    if (beatEnabled && beatBars.length && !syncUsesAudioBeats()) {
      const beatMs = Math.round(60000 / getBpm());
      beatTimer = setInterval(() => {
        triggerBeatBar();
      }, beatMs);
    }
  }

  function stopMontage() {
    if (montageTimer) clearInterval(montageTimer);
    if (beatTimer) clearInterval(beatTimer);
    montageTimer = null;
    beatTimer = null;
    montagePlaying = false;
  }

  if (montageSlides.length) {
    montagePrev?.addEventListener('click', () => {
      renderMontage(montageIndex - 1);
      if (montagePlaying) startMontage();
    });

    montageNext?.addEventListener('click', () => {
      renderMontage(montageIndex + 1);
      if (montagePlaying) startMontage();
    });

    montagePlay?.addEventListener('click', () => {
      if (!montageAudio || !montageAudio.paused) {
        // Audio joacă → pauză
        pauseMontageAudio();
        if (montagePlay) montagePlay.textContent = '▶ Muzică';
      } else {
        // Pornire audio SINCRONĂ din gestul utilizatorului (evită blocarea autoplay)
        const playPromise = montageAudio.play();
        if (montagePlay) montagePlay.textContent = '⏸ Muzică';
        if (playPromise !== undefined) {
          playPromise.then(async () => {
            await ensureAudioGraph();
            startBeatDetection();
          }).catch(() => {
            stopBeatDetection();
            if (montagePlay) montagePlay.textContent = '▶ Muzică';
          });
        }
      }
    });

    montageBeat?.addEventListener('click', () => {
      beatEnabled = !beatEnabled;
      montageBeat.textContent = beatEnabled ? 'Beat ON' : 'Beat OFF';
      montageBeat.setAttribute('aria-pressed', beatEnabled ? 'true' : 'false');
      if (montagePlaying) startMontage();
    });

    montageAutoBeat?.addEventListener('click', () => {
      autoBeatEnabled = !autoBeatEnabled;
      montageAutoBeat.textContent = autoBeatEnabled ? 'Sync AUTO' : 'Sync BPM';
      montageAutoBeat.setAttribute('aria-pressed', autoBeatEnabled ? 'true' : 'false');
      if (montagePlaying) startMontage();
    });

    montagePreset?.addEventListener('change', () => {
      setMontagePreset(montagePreset.value || 'elegant');
    });

    montageBpm?.addEventListener('input', () => {
      if (montageBpmVal) montageBpmVal.textContent = String(getBpm());
      if (montagePlaying) startMontage();
    });

    montageSense?.addEventListener('input', () => {
      if (montageSenseVal) montageSenseVal.textContent = `${getBeatSensitivity().toFixed(2)}x`;
    });

    montageAudio?.addEventListener('ended', () => {
      stopBeatDetection();
      if (montagePlaying) startMontage();
    });

    montageRoot?.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
      if (window.matchMedia('(hover: hover)').matches) stopMontage();
    });

    montageRoot?.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
      if (window.matchMedia('(hover: hover)').matches) startMontage();
    });

    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
      if (document.hidden) {
        stopMontage();
        pauseMontageAudio();
      }
      else if (montagePlaying || (montagePlay && montagePlay.textContent === 'Pause')) startMontage();
    });

    currentPreset = montagePreset?.value || 'elegant';
    if (montageStage) montageStage.setAttribute('data-preset', currentPreset);
    if (montageBpmVal) montageBpmVal.textContent = String(getBpm());
    if (montageSenseVal) montageSenseVal.textContent = `${getBeatSensitivity().toFixed(2)}x`;
    renderMontage(0);
    startMontage();
  }

  // ── Lightbox ──
  const lb = document.getElementById('gal-lightbox');
  const lbImg = document.getElementById('lb-img');
  const lbCounter = lb.querySelector('.lb-counter');
  const lbClose = lb.querySelector('.lb-close');
  const lbPrev = lb.querySelector('.lb-prev');
  const lbNext = lb.querySelector('.lb-next');

  function getVisibleItems() {
    return Array.from(items).filter((it) => it.style.display !== 'none');
  }

  let currentIdx = 0;

  function showPhoto(idx) {
    const visible = getVisibleItems();
    if (idx < 0 || idx >= visible.length) return;
    currentIdx = idx;
    const item = visible[idx];
    const src = item.dataset.src ?? '';
    const alt = item.querySelector('figcaption')?.textContent ?? '';
    lbImg.src = src;
    lbImg.alt = alt;
    lbCounter.textContent = `${idx + 1} / ${visible.length}`;
    lbImg.classList.remove('lb-fade-in');
    void lbImg.offsetWidth; /* force reflow for re-trigger */
    lbImg.classList.add('lb-fade-in');
  }

  function openLightbox(idx) {
    lb.classList.add('active');
    // Blochează scroll-ul în spatele lightbox-ului — pe mobil scrollează html,
    // pe desktop body; setăm pe ambele ca să acoperim toate scenariile.
    document.documentElement.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    // Pe mobil, secțiunea galeriei are scroll propriu — oprim și pe ea
    const galSection = document.querySelector('.gal-page');
    if (galSection) galSection.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    showPhoto(idx);
  }

  let closing = false;

  function closeLightbox() {
    if (closing) return;
    closing = true;
    lb.classList.add('lb-closing');
    setTimeout(() => {
      lb.classList.remove('active', 'lb-closing');
      document.documentElement.style.overflow = '';
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
      const galSection = document.querySelector('.gal-page');
      if (galSection) galSection.style.overflow = '';
      lbImg.classList.remove('lb-fade-in');
      lbImg.src = '';
      lbImg.alt = '';
      closing = false;
    }, 500);
  }

  function navPrev() {
    const visible = getVisibleItems();
    const next = (currentIdx - 1 + visible.length) % visible.length;
    showPhoto(next);
  }

  function navNext() {
    const visible = getVisibleItems();
    const next = (currentIdx + 1) % visible.length;
    showPhoto(next);
  }

  // Click pe item → deschide lightbox
  items.forEach((item) => {
    item.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const visible = getVisibleItems();
      const idx = visible.indexOf(item);
      if (idx >= 0) openLightbox(idx);
    });
    item.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
        e.preventDefault();
        const visible = getVisibleItems();
        const idx = visible.indexOf(item);
        if (idx >= 0) openLightbox(idx);
      }
    });
  });

  lbClose.addEventListener('click', closeLightbox);
  lbPrev.addEventListener('click', (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); navPrev(); });
  lbNext.addEventListener('click', (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); navNext(); });

  // Tap pe fundal sau imagine → închide (pe mobil mai ales)
  lb.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    const t = e.target;
    // Nu închide dacă user-ul a dat pe butoanele prev/next
    if (t.closest('.lb-prev') || t.closest('.lb-next')) return;
    closeLightbox();
  });

  // Keyboard
  document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (!lb.classList.contains('active')) return;
    if (e.key === 'Escape') closeLightbox();
    if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') navPrev();
    if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') navNext();
  });

  // ── Swipe touch pe mobile ──
  let touchStartX = 0;
  let touchEndX = 0;

  lb.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => { touchStartX = e.changedTouches[0].screenX; }, { passive: true });
  lb.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
    touchEndX = e.changedTouches[0].screenX;
    const diff = touchStartX - touchEndX;
    if (Math.abs(diff) > 50) {
      diff > 0 ? navNext() : navPrev();
    }
  }, { passive: true });
</script>

<!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════
     STYLES
═══════════════════════════════════════════ -->
<style>
  /* ══════════════════════════════════════════
     PAGINĂ
  ══════════════════════════════════════════ */
  .gal-page {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: var(--container-max, 1200px);
    margin-inline: auto;
    padding: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 2.5rem) var(--container-pad-x, 1.25rem);
    box-sizing: border-box;
    overflow-x: hidden;
  }

  .gal-back {
    margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
  }

  /* ══════════════════════════════════════════
     HEADER
  ══════════════════════════════════════════ */
  .gal-header {
    text-align: center;
    margin: 0 auto clamp(1.75rem, 4vw, 2.75rem);
    max-width: 62ch;
  }

  .gal-montage {
    margin: 0 auto clamp(1.4rem, 3vw, 2.1rem);
    max-width: 74rem;
  }

  .gal-montage-stage {
    position: relative;
    border-radius: 1rem;
    overflow: hidden;
    aspect-ratio: 16 / 9;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
    box-shadow: 0 16px 45px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.34);
    background: #090f21;
    isolation: isolate;
  }

  .gal-montage-slide {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 720ms ease;
    pointer-events: none;
    transform-origin: center;
  }

  .gal-montage-slide img {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover;
    transform: scale(1.02);
  }

  .gal-montage-slide figcaption {
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    padding: 1.35rem 1.1rem 0.95rem;
    font-size: 0.78rem;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92);
    background: linear-gradient(transparent, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75));
    line-height: 1.45;
    text-align: center;
    letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  }

  .gal-montage-slide.is-active {
    opacity: 1;
  }

  .gal-montage-slide.is-active img {
    animation-duration: 3.6s;
    animation-fill-mode: forwards;
    animation-timing-function: ease;
  }

  .gal-montage-slide.fx-kenburns img { animation-name: gal-kenburns; }
  .gal-montage-slide.fx-pan-left img { animation-name: gal-pan-left; }
  .gal-montage-slide.fx-pan-right img { animation-name: gal-pan-right; }
  .gal-montage-slide.fx-soft-zoom img { animation-name: gal-soft-zoom; }
  .gal-montage-slide.fx-drift-left img { animation-name: gal-drift-left; }
  .gal-montage-slide.fx-drift-right img { animation-name: gal-drift-right; }
  .gal-montage-slide.fx-punch img { animation-name: gal-punch; }
  .gal-montage-slide.fx-sweep-left img { animation-name: gal-sweep-left; }
  .gal-montage-slide.fx-sweep-right img { animation-name: gal-sweep-right; }
  .gal-montage-slide.fx-spin-micro img { animation-name: gal-spin-micro; }

  .gal-montage-overlay {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
    background:
      radial-gradient(circle at 18% 18%, rgba(0, 200, 255, 0.14), transparent 38%),
      radial-gradient(circle at 82% 80%, rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.13), transparent 36%);
  }

  .gal-montage-stage[data-preset="party"] .gal-montage-overlay {
    background:
      radial-gradient(circle at 14% 22%, rgba(255, 75, 130, 0.22), transparent 38%),
      radial-gradient(circle at 84% 18%, rgba(0, 220, 255, 0.22), transparent 34%),
      radial-gradient(circle at 78% 84%, rgba(255, 200, 72, 0.2), transparent 36%);
  }

  .gal-montage-stage[data-preset="romantic"] .gal-montage-overlay {
    background:
      radial-gradient(circle at 18% 18%, rgba(255, 178, 205, 0.2), transparent 40%),
      radial-gradient(circle at 80% 82%, rgba(255, 220, 174, 0.2), transparent 35%);
  }

  .gal-montage-beatbars {
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 0.25rem;
    padding: 0.35rem 0.45rem;
    z-index: 3;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  .gal-montage-beatbars span {
    width: 6px;
    height: 8px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.24);
    transition: height 140ms ease, background 140ms ease, box-shadow 140ms ease;
  }

  .gal-montage-beatbars span.is-hit {
    height: 18px;
    background: rgba(0, 225, 255, 0.92);
    box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(0, 225, 255, 0.45);
  }

  .gal-montage-controls {
    margin-top: 0.7rem;
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.5rem;
  }

  .gal-montage-controls-row {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.45rem;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }

  .gal-montage-controls-row--secondary {
    gap: 0.38rem;
  }

  .gal-montage-controls-row--audio {
    gap: 0.35rem;
  }

  .gal-montage-btn {
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07);
    color: #f4f8ff;
    border-radius: 999px;
    min-width: 72px;
    min-height: 40px;
    font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
    font-size: 0.78rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.07em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: border-color 220ms ease, background 220ms ease;
  }

  .gal-montage-label {
    font-size: 0.68rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: rgba(230, 238, 255, 0.86);
    font-weight: 700;
    font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
  }

  .gal-montage-file {
    height: 36px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
    color: #f4f8ff;
    padding: 0 0.75rem;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: 0.72rem;
    font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    cursor: default;
  }

  .gal-montage-audio-hint {
    font-size: 0.68rem;
    color: rgba(230, 238, 255, 0.78);
    letter-spacing: 0.02em;
    line-height: 1.25;
  }

  .gal-montage-select,
  .gal-montage-range,
  .gal-montage-bpm-val {
    height: 36px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
    color: #f4f8ff;
  }

  .gal-montage-select {
    padding: 0 0.8rem;
    min-width: 118px;
    font-size: 0.74rem;
    font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  .gal-montage-range {
    width: 120px;
    accent-color: #06d6ff;
    padding: 0 0.35rem;
  }

  .gal-montage-range--short {
    width: 92px;
  }

  .gal-montage-bpm-val {
    min-width: 44px;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
    font-size: 0.76rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  }

  .gal-montage-btn:hover,
  .gal-montage-btn:focus-visible {
    border-color: rgba(0, 200, 255, 0.55);
    background: rgba(0, 200, 255, 0.16);
  }

  .gal-montage-audio {
    display: none;
  }

  @keyframes gal-kenburns {
    from { transform: scale(1.02) translate3d(0, 0, 0); }
    to { transform: scale(1.08) translate3d(-1.2%, -0.8%, 0); }
  }

  @keyframes gal-pan-left {
    from { transform: scale(1.04) translate3d(1.6%, 0, 0); }
    to { transform: scale(1.1) translate3d(-1.6%, -0.7%, 0); }
  }

  @keyframes gal-pan-right {
    from { transform: scale(1.04) translate3d(-1.6%, 0, 0); }
    to { transform: scale(1.1) translate3d(1.6%, -0.7%, 0); }
  }

  @keyframes gal-soft-zoom {
    from { transform: scale(1.01); }
    to { transform: scale(1.06); }
  }

  @keyframes gal-drift-left {
    from { transform: scale(1.03) translate3d(0, 1.2%, 0); }
    to { transform: scale(1.08) translate3d(-1.4%, -1.1%, 0); }
  }

  @keyframes gal-drift-right {
    from { transform: scale(1.03) translate3d(0, 1.2%, 0); }
    to { transform: scale(1.08) translate3d(1.4%, -1.1%, 0); }
  }

  @keyframes gal-punch {
    0% { transform: scale(1.02); }
    22% { transform: scale(1.09); }
    45% { transform: scale(1.06); }
    100% { transform: scale(1.1); }
  }

  @keyframes gal-sweep-left {
    from { transform: scale(1.03) translate3d(2.2%, 0, 0); }
    to { transform: scale(1.11) translate3d(-2.2%, -0.6%, 0); }
  }

  @keyframes gal-sweep-right {
    from { transform: scale(1.03) translate3d(-2.2%, 0, 0); }
    to { transform: scale(1.11) translate3d(2.2%, -0.6%, 0); }
  }

  @keyframes gal-spin-micro {
    from { transform: scale(1.04) rotate(-0.45deg); }
    to { transform: scale(1.1) rotate(0.45deg); }
  }

  .gal-badge {

  .gal-title {

  /* ══════════════════════════════════════════
     GRID UNIFORM — toate cardurile cu aceeași înălțime,
     rânduri perfect aliniate (înlocuiește masonry pe coloane)
  ══════════════════════════════════════════ */
  .gal-masonry {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: clamp(0.85rem, 2vw, 1.25rem);
    width: 100%;
  }

  @media (max-width: 1023px) and (min-width: 640px) {
    .gal-masonry { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
  }

  @media (max-width: 639px) {
    .gal-masonry { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  }

  /* ══════════════════════════════════════════
     ITEM (FIGURE) — aspect ratio fix → înălțimi egale pe rând
  ══════════════════════════════════════════ */
  .gal-item {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    margin: 0;
    aspect-ratio: 4 / 3;
    border-radius: 1rem;
    overflow: hidden;
    position: relative;
    cursor: pointer;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    transition: opacity 300ms ease, border-color 300ms ease, box-shadow 300ms ease;
  }

  .gal-item:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid rgba(0, 200, 255, 0.60);
    outline-offset: 2px;
  }

  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .gal-item:hover {
      border-color: rgba(0, 200, 255, 0.40);
      box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(0, 200, 255, 0.18), 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 60, 120, 0.25);
    }
  }

  .gal-photo-img {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    display: block;
    object-fit: cover;
    object-position: center;
    border-radius: inherit;
  }

  .gal-caption {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 0;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    font-size: 0.68rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85);
    text-align: center;
    padding: 1.5rem 1rem 0.6rem;
    line-height: 1.4;
    background: linear-gradient(transparent, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7));
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 300ms ease;
  }

  .gal-item:hover .gal-caption {
    opacity: 1;
  }

  /* Hover overlay */
  .gal-hover {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 0.4rem;
    background: rgba(0, 30, 60, 0.55);
    border-radius: inherit;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 220ms ease;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  .gal-item:hover .gal-hover,
  .gal-item:focus .gal-hover {
    opacity: 1;
  }

  .gal-zoom-icon {
    width: 28px;
    height: 28px;
    color: rgba(0, 220, 255, 0.85);
  }

  .gal-hover-text {
    font-size: 0.58rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: rgba(0, 220, 255, 0.75);
  }

  /* ══════════════════════════════════════════
     BUTON ÎNCARCĂ MAI MULTE
  ══════════════════════════════════════════ */
  .gal-load-wrap {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    margin-top: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
  }

  .gal-load-btn {
    position: relative;
    font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
    font-size: 0.78rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.10em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    padding: 0.65em 1.8em;
    border-radius: 9999px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
    color: rgba(200, 215, 240, 0.45);
    cursor: not-allowed;
    opacity: 0.6;
  }

  .gal-load-tooltip {
    display: none;
    position: absolute;
    bottom: calc(100% + 8px);
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    font-size: 0.62rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    white-space: nowrap;
    padding: 0.3em 0.75em;
    border-radius: 0.4rem;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85);
    color: rgba(0, 220, 255, 0.80);
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 200, 255, 0.22);
  }

  .gal-load-btn:hover .gal-load-tooltip {
    display: block;
  }

  /* ══════════════════════════════════════════
     LIGHTBOX
  ══════════════════════════════════════════ */
  #gal-lightbox {
    display: none;
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100vw;
    height: 100dvh;
    z-index: 9999;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.95);
    backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
  }

  #gal-lightbox.active {
    display: flex;
  }

  .lb-img-wrap {
    max-width: 90vw;
    max-height: 80dvh;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
  }

  #lb-img {
    display: block;
    max-width: 90vw;
    max-height: 80dvh;
    border-radius: 0.75rem;
    box-shadow: 0 0 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8), 0 0 20px rgba(232, 200, 91, 0.25);
    border: 1px solid rgba(232, 200, 91, 0.3);
    object-fit: contain;
  }

  /* Counter */
  .lb-counter {
    position: absolute;
    top: 1.25rem;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
    font-size: 0.78rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55);
    z-index: 10;
  }

  /* Close */
  .lb-close {
    position: absolute;
    top: 1rem;
    right: 1.25rem;
    width: 42px;
    height: 42px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
    color: #ffffff;
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    z-index: 10;
    transition: background 200ms ease, border-color 200ms ease;
  }

  .lb-close:hover {
    background: rgba(255, 60, 80, 0.18);
    border-color: rgba(255, 60, 80, 0.45);
  }

  /* Nav prev/next */
  .lb-prev, .lb-next {
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%;
    transform: translateY(-50%);
    width: 44px;
    height: 44px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
    color: #ffffff;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    z-index: 10;
    transition: background 200ms ease, border-color 200ms ease;
  }

  .lb-prev { left: 1rem; }
  .lb-next { right: 1rem; }

  .lb-prev:hover, .lb-next:hover {
    background: rgba(0, 200, 255, 0.12);
    border-color: rgba(0, 200, 255, 0.40);
  }

  .lb-prev svg, .lb-next svg {
    width: 22px;
    height: 22px;
  }

  /* ══════════════════════════════════════════
     LIGHTBOX — Animație fade simplă & fiabilă
  ══════════════════════════════════════════ */
  @keyframes lb-fade-scale-in {
    0%   { transform: scale(0.92); opacity: 0; }
    100% { transform: scale(1);    opacity: 1; }
  }

  .lb-fade-in {
    animation: lb-fade-scale-in 0.8s cubic-bezier(.25,.46,.45,.94) both;
  }

  /* Închidere — fade out pe tot overlay-ul */
  #gal-lightbox.lb-closing {
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 0.5s ease-out;
  }

  /* ══════════════════════════════════════════
     MOBILE — lightbox nav mai strâns
  ══════════════════════════════════════════ */
  @media (max-width: 767px) {
    .gal-montage-stage {
      aspect-ratio: 4 / 3;
    }

    .gal-montage-slide figcaption {
      font-size: 0.72rem;
      padding: 1rem 0.8rem 0.7rem;
    }

    .gal-montage-controls-row--secondary {
      gap: 0.3rem;
    }

    .gal-montage-controls-row--audio {
      gap: 0.3rem;
    }

    .gal-montage-range {
      width: 104px;
    }

    .gal-montage-range--short {
      width: 90px;
    }

    .lb-prev { left: 0.25rem; width: 44px; height: 44px; }
    .lb-next { right: 0.25rem; width: 44px; height: 44px; }
    .lb-close { top: 0.75rem; right: 0.75rem; width: 44px; height: 44px; }
    .lb-counter { top: 0.85rem; font-size: 0.68rem; }

    #lb-img {
      max-height: 70dvh;
    }
  }
</style>

```

### src/pages/galerie-video.astro
```astro
---
import BaseLayout from '../layouts/BaseLayout.astro';
import siteContent from '../data/siteContent.json';
import seo from '../data/seo-content.json';
import BackButton from '../components/BackButton.astro';

const videoSeo = seo.galerieVideo;
const slugify = (value: string) =>
  value
    .toLowerCase()
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')
    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '');

const videoSlug = (video: { title: string; youtubeId: string }) => {
  const baseSlug = slugify(video.title);
  return `${baseSlug}-${video.youtubeId.toLowerCase()}`;
};

const sections = [
  {
    id: 'populara',
    title: 'Muzică Populară Live la Nuntă',
    category: 'petrecere',
    kicker: 'Tradiție & energie',
  },
  {
    id: 'usoara',
    title: 'Muzică Ușoară Live pentru Nuntă',
    category: 'usoara-diverse',
    kicker: 'Melodii de suflet',
  },
  {
    id: 'tineret',
    title: 'Muzică de Petrecere pentru Tineret',
    category: 'tineret-manele',
    kicker: 'Vibe de petrecere',
  },
  {
    id: 'instrumentala',
    title: 'Muzică Instrumentală',
    category: 'instrumentala',
    kicker: 'Sunete pure',
  },
  {
    id: 'dans-miri',
    title: 'Dansul Mirilor',
    category: 'dans-miri',
    kicker: 'Momentul magic',
  },
];

const videosByCategory = (cat: string) =>
  siteContent.videos.filter((v) => v.category === cat);
---

<BaseLayout
  title={videoSeo.meta.title}
  description={videoSeo.meta.description}
>
  <section class="section-container py-16">
    <div class="mb-8"><BackButton href="/" label="Acasă" /></div>
    <header class="section-head mx-auto text-center">
      <p class="kicker">Galerie Video</p>
      <h1 class="section-title">{videoSeo.h1}</h1>
      <p class="section-copy">
        {videoSeo.subtitle}
      </p>
    </header>

    {sections.map((section) => {
      const videos = videosByCategory(section.category);
      return (
        <div class="section-block" id={section.id}>
          <div class="section-label-row">
            <span class="section-kicker-chip">{section.kicker}</span>
            <h2 class="section-h2">{section.title}</h2>
          </div>

          {videos.length === 0 ? (
            <p class="empty-note">Clipuri în curând. Revino pentru actualizări.</p>
          ) : (
            <div class="video-grid">
              {videos.map((video) => {
                const slug = videoSlug(video);
                const thumbJpg = `https://img.youtube.com/vi/${video.youtubeId}/hqdefault.jpg`;
                return (
                  <a href={`/video/${slug}/`} class="video-card" title={video.title} aria-label={`Redă: ${video.title}`}>
                    <div class="thumb-shell">
                      <img
                        src={thumbJpg}
                        alt={video.title}
                        class="thumb-img"
                        loading="lazy"
                        decoding="async"
                      />
                      <div class="thumb-overlay" aria-hidden="true">
                        <svg class="play-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true">
                          <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="12" fill="rgba(0,0,0,0.55)" />
                          <polygon points="10,8 18,12 10,16" fill="white" />
                        </svg>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <p class="video-title">{video.title}</p>
                  </a>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      );
    })}

    <div class="mt-12 flex justify-center">
      <a href="/aparitii-tv/" class="btn-outline">Vezi și apariții TV</a>
    </div>
  </section>
</BaseLayout>

<style>
  .section-block {
    margin-top: clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 4rem);
    scroll-margin-top: 5rem;
  }

  .section-label-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.85rem;
    margin-bottom: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }

  .section-kicker-chip {
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--gold, #f5a623);
    border: 1px solid rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.35);
    background: rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.08);
    padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem;
    border-radius: 9999px;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  .section-h2 {
    font-size: clamp(1.25rem, 3vw, 1.75rem);
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #fff;
    margin: 0;
  }

  .video-grid {
    display: grid;
    gap: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(min(100%, 280px), 1fr));
    align-items: stretch; /* înălțimi egale pe rând */
  }

  .video-card {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    border-radius: 1rem;
    overflow: hidden;
    border: 1px solid var(--line, rgba(255,255,255,0.1));
    background: var(--surface, rgba(255,255,255,0.04));
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: transform 220ms ease, box-shadow 220ms ease, border-color 220ms ease;
    height: 100%; /* card-ul umple celula → toate cardurile au aceeași înălțime */
  }

  .video-card:hover {
    transform: translateY(-4px);
    box-shadow: 0 20px 45px rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.18);
    border-color: rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.45);
  }

  .video-card:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.8);
    outline-offset: 2px;
    border-color: rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.45);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.15);
  }

  .thumb-shell {
    position: relative;
    aspect-ratio: 16/9;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: #0e0e1a;
  }

  .thumb-img {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover;
    display: block;
    transition: transform 320ms ease;
  }

  .thumb-shell picture {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
  }

  .video-card:hover .thumb-img {
    transform: scale(1.04);
  }

  .thumb-overlay {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 220ms ease;
  }

  .video-card:hover .thumb-overlay {
    opacity: 1;
  }

  .play-icon {
    width: 3rem;
    height: 3rem;
    filter: drop-shadow(0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.6));
  }

  .video-title {
    padding: 0.75rem 1rem 0.85rem;
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #e0ecff;
    margin: 0;
    line-height: 1.4;
    flex: 1; /* împinge titlul să umple spațiul rămas → baze aliniate pe rând */
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
  }

  .empty-note {
    color: var(--muted, rgba(255,255,255,0.45));
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    font-style: italic;
    padding: 1rem 0;
  }
</style>

```

### src/pages/index.astro
```astro
---
import { Image, getImage } from 'astro:assets';
import BaseLayout from '../layouts/BaseLayout.astro';
import siteContent from '../data/siteContent.json';
import seo from '../data/seo-content.json';
import couplesData from '../data/couples.json';
import heroImg from '../assets/card-1-panoramica.jpg';

const optimizedHero = await getImage({ src: heroImg, format: 'webp', width: 320, height: 213 });

const { acasa } = seo;
const { contact } = siteContent;
const faqItems = acasa.faq;
import { sanitizeUrl } from '../lib/sanitize-url';

const socialLinks = {
  youtube:   siteContent.socialLinks?.youtube ? sanitizeUrl(siteContent.socialLinks.youtube) : null,
  facebook:  siteContent.socialLinks?.facebook ? sanitizeUrl(siteContent.socialLinks.facebook) : null,
  instagram: siteContent.socialLinks?.instagram ? sanitizeUrl(siteContent.socialLinks.instagram) : null,
  tiktok:    siteContent.socialLinks?.tiktok ? sanitizeUrl(siteContent.socialLinks.tiktok) : null,
};
const faqJsonLd = {
  '@context': 'https://schema.org',
  '@type': 'FAQPage',
  mainEntity: acasa.faq.map((item) => ({
    '@type': 'Question',
    name: item.question,
    acceptedAnswer: { '@type': 'Answer', text: item.answer },
  })),
};
const waHref = `https://wa.me/${contact.phoneRaw.replace('+', '')}?text=Bun%C4%83%20ziua!%20A%C8%99%20dori%20s%C4%83%20rezerv%20Forma%C8%9Bia%20Florentina%20Pan%C4%83%20pentru%20evenimentul%20meu.`;

const heroVideos = siteContent.videos.slice(0, 3).map((video) => ({
  title: video.title,
  thumbJpg: `https://img.youtube.com/vi/${video.youtubeId}/hqdefault.jpg`,
}));

const homepagePhotoSources = {
  claudiuFlorentina: {
    avifSrcSet: '/images/galerie-foto-site/placerea-scenei-claudiu-florentina-500.avif 500w, /images/galerie-foto-site/placerea-scenei-claudiu-florentina-700.avif 700w, /images/galerie-foto-site/placerea-scenei-claudiu-florentina-1000.avif 1000w',
    webpSrcSet: '/images/galerie-foto-site/placerea-scenei-claudiu-florentina-500.webp 500w, /images/galerie-foto-site/placerea-scenei-claudiu-florentina-700.webp 700w, /images/galerie-foto-site/placerea-scenei-claudiu-florentina-1000.webp 1000w',
    fallbackSrc: '/images/galerie-foto-site/placerea-scenei-claudiu-florentina.jpg',
  },
  anaFlorentina: {
    fallbackSrc: '/images/galerie-foto-site/placerea-scenei-ana-florentina.jpg',
  },
  evenimentOne: {
    fallbackSrc: '/images/galerie-foto-site/Galerie Evenimente 1.jpg',
  },
  claudiuTwo: {
    fallbackSrc: '/images/galerie-foto-site/Claudiu 2.jpg',
  },
} as const;

const heroSliderPhotos = [
  {
    ...homepagePhotoSources.claudiuFlorentina,
    alt: 'Formația Florentina Pană în plin show live pe scenă',
    position: '40% 30%',
  },
  {
    ...homepagePhotoSources.anaFlorentina,
    alt: 'Moment live de scenă la un eveniment premium',
    position: '50% 14%',
  },
  {
    ...homepagePhotoSources.evenimentOne,
    alt: 'Public și formație într-un moment live energic pe scenă',
    position: '38% 16%',
  }
] as const;

const heroPhotos: Array<{ variant: keyof typeof homepagePhotoSources; alt: string }> = [
  {
    variant: 'claudiuFlorentina',
    alt: 'Formația Florentina Pană în plin show live pe scenă',
  },
  {
    variant: 'anaFlorentina',
    alt: 'Moment live în duet pe scenă la un eveniment premium',
  },
  {
    variant: 'claudiuTwo',
    alt: 'Public și formație într-un moment live energic pe scenă',
  },
];

const signatureCouples = [...couplesData.couples]
  .sort((a, b) => (b.isoDate || '').localeCompare(a.isoDate || ''))
  .slice(0, 3)
  .map((item) => ({
    names: item.names,
    city: item.city,
    date: item.date,
    recommendation: item.recommendation,
    slug: item.slug,
  }));
const heroTelHref = `tel:${contact.phoneRaw}`;
const heroWaHref = `https://wa.me/${contact.phoneRaw.replace('+', '')}?text=Bun%C4%83!%20Vreau%20s%C4%83%20verific%20disponibilitatea%20Forma%C8%9Biei%20Florentina%20Pan%C4%83.`;
---

<BaseLayout title={acasa.meta.title} description={acasa.meta.description} ogImage={siteContent.seo.ogImage}>
  <Fragment slot="head">
    <script is:inline type="application/ld+json" set:html={JSON.stringify(faqJsonLd)} />
  </Fragment>

  <section class="hero-slider" aria-label="Galerie automată cu imagini live Formația Florentina Pană">
    <div class="hero-slider-track" data-hero-slider data-ready="false">
      <div class="hero-slider-placeholder" aria-hidden="true">
        Momente live autentice — se încarcă galeria foto
      </div>

      {heroSliderPhotos.map((slide, index) => (
        <div class={`hero-slider-slide${index === 0 ? ' is-active' : ''}`} data-hero-slide style={`--slide-pos: ${slide.position};`}>
          <picture>
            {slide.avifSrcSet && (
              <source
                type="image/avif"
                srcset={slide.avifSrcSet}
                sizes="(max-width: 767px) 92vw, (max-width: 1280px) 96vw, 1120px"
              />
            )}
            {slide.webpSrcSet && (
              <source
                type="image/webp"
                srcset={slide.webpSrcSet}
                sizes="(max-width: 767px) 92vw, (max-width: 1280px) 96vw, 1120px"
              />
            )}
            <img
              src={slide.fallbackSrc}
              alt={slide.alt}
              class="hero-slider-image"
              loading="lazy"
              decoding="async"
              width="1000"
              height="560"
            />
          </picture>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  </section>

  {/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
      HERO — Scenă, titlu mare, CTA-uri
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */}
  <section id="acasa" class="hero-stage hero-fullscreen hp-hero-wrap" aria-label="Secțiunea principală">
    <div class="hero-stage-inner">
      <div class="hero-light-orbs" aria-hidden="true">
        <span class="hero-orb hero-orb--one"></span>
        <span class="hero-orb hero-orb--two"></span>
        <span class="hero-orb hero-orb--three"></span>
      </div>

      <span class="kicker-badge anim-hero-load anim-hero-d1" aria-hidden="true">
        <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M11.3 1.046A1 1 0 0 1 12 2v5h4a1 1 0 0 1 .82 1.573l-7 10A1 1 0 0 1 8 18v-5H4a1 1 0 0 1-.82-1.573l7-10a1 1 0 0 1 1.12-.38Z"/></svg>
        {acasa.hero.kicker}
      </span>

      {/* Card foto — vizibil doar pe mobil, colțuri rotunjite */}
      <div class="hero-photo-card anim-hero-load anim-hero-d2">
        <img
          src={optimizedHero.src}
          alt="Formația Florentina Pană — spectacol live pe scenă"
          class="hero-photo-img anim-img-hover"
          width="320"
          height="213"
          loading="lazy"
          fetchpriority="auto"
          decoding="async"
        />
      </div>

      <h1 class="hero-title-xl anim-hero-load anim-hero-d2">
        <span class="hero-title-gold hero-title-gold--compact">Formație Nuntă Pitești - Formația Florentina Pană</span>
      </h1>

      <p class="hero-lead anim-hero-load anim-hero-d3">
        {acasa.hero.descriere}
      </p>

      <p class="hero-pricing-note anim-hero-load anim-hero-d3">
        Pentru alegerea unei formații de nuntă în Pitești contează vibe-ul, repertoriul și modul în care ținem ringul plin de la primul dans până la final.
        Dacă vrei o trupă de nunți în Argeș care livrează energie autentică și organizare clară, completează formularul de buget și revenim rapid cu o ofertă personalizată.
        <a href="/contact/" class="hero-pricing-link">Completează formularul de buget</a>
      </p>

      {/* CTA-uri hero */}
      <div class="hero-cta-row anim-hero-load anim-hero-d4">
        <a href={`tel:${contact.phoneRaw}`} class="hero-cta-primary" onclick="window.gtag&&window.gtag('event','click_phone',{event_category:'hero'})">
```
