```astro
---
import BaseLayout from '../layouts/BaseLayout.astro';

const title = 'Preview Live · Florentina Pană | Trupă Cover Evenimente';
const description = 'Preview de 60 de secunde din transmisia live. Continuă pe site pentru experiența completă.';
const ogImage = '/images/og-live-1200x630.jpg';
---

<BaseLayout title={title} description={description} ogImage={ogImage} noindex={true}>
  <section class="relative min-h-screen overflow-hidden bg-black">
    <div class="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-b from-black via-[#0a0500] to-black"></div>

    <div class="relative z-10 mx-auto flex min-h-screen max-w-5xl flex-col items-center justify-center px-4 py-10 sm:py-14">

      {/* Brand mic deasupra player */}
      <div class="mb-4 flex items-center gap-3 text-center">
        <span class="relative flex h-3 w-3">
          <span class="absolute inline-flex h-full w-full animate-ping rounded-full bg-red-500 opacity-75"></span>
          <span class="relative inline-flex h-3 w-3 rounded-full bg-red-500"></span>
        </span>
        <span class="font-['Oswald'] text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.25em] text-red-400 sm:text-sm">
          Live · Florentina Pană
        </span>
      </div>

      {/* Player Cloudflare — preview 60s */}
      <div class="relative w-full max-w-3xl rounded-3xl border-2 border-amber-500/40 bg-black/60 p-3 shadow-[0_20px_60px_rgba(245,166,35,0.2)] sm:p-4">
        <div class="relative aspect-video overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-black">
          <iframe
            id="preview-player"
            src="about:blank"
            title="Preview Live · 60 secunde"
            class="absolute inset-0 h-full w-full bg-black"
            allow="accelerometer; gyroscope; encrypted-media; picture-in-picture;"
            referrerpolicy="origin"
            allowfullscreen
            loading="eager"
          ></iframe>

          {/* Overlay countdown */}
          <div
            id="preview-countdown"
            class="pointer-events-none absolute right-3 top-3 z-10 flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-amber-400/50 bg-black/75 px-3 py-1.5 font-['Oswald'] text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.15em] text-amber-300 backdrop-blur-sm sm:right-4 sm:top-4 sm:text-sm"
          >
            <svg class="h-4 w-4" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" aria-hidden="true">
              <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M12 8v4l3 3m6-3a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z" />
            </svg>
            <span>Preview: <span id="preview-seconds">60</span>s</span>
          </div>

          {/* Mesaj fallback când nu e live și nu există replay */}
          <div
            id="preview-offline"
            class="absolute inset-0 z-20 hidden flex-col items-center justify-center gap-4 bg-gradient-to-b from-black via-[#0a0500] to-black p-6 text-center"
          >
            <p class="font-['Oswald'] text-lg font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.15em] text-amber-300 sm:text-xl">
              Transmisia nu este activă
            </p>
            <p class="max-w-md text-sm text-white/70 sm:text-base">
              Revino curând pentru următorul live. Între timp, descoperă-ne pe site.
            </p>
            <a
              href="/"
              class="mt-2 inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-amber-500 px-6 py-3 font-['Oswald'] text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-black shadow-lg transition hover:scale-105 hover:bg-amber-400"
            >
              Vizitează site-ul →
            </a>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* CTA imediat sub player + buton skip */}
      <div class="mt-6 flex flex-col items-center gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:gap-4">
        <a
          id="preview-continue"
          href="/live/"
          class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border-2 border-amber-500/60 bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-600 to-amber-500 px-7 py-3.5 font-['Oswald'] text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-black shadow-[0_8px_28px_rgba(245,166,35,0.4)] transition-all hover:scale-105"
        >
          Continuă pe site →
        </a>
        <a
          href="/contact/"
          class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-white/20 bg-white/5 px-6 py-3 font-['Oswald'] text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-white/85 transition hover:border-white/40 hover:bg-white/10"
        >
          Verifică disponibilitatea
        </a>
      </div>

      <p class="mt-5 max-w-md text-center text-xs leading-relaxed text-white/45">
        Preview de 60 de secunde. Apoi vei fi redirecționat automat pe pagina principală pentru detalii complete.
      </p>
    </div>
  </section>

  <script is:inline>
    (function () {
      var iframe = document.getElementById('preview-player');
      var offlineOverlay = document.getElementById('preview-offline');
      var countdownEl = document.getElementById('preview-countdown');
      var secondsEl = document.getElementById('preview-seconds');
      var continueBtn = document.getElementById('preview-continue');
      if (!iframe) return;

      // Permitem suprascrierea destinației prin ?next= (whitelist intern)
      var SAFE_NEXT_PATHS = ['/', '/contact/', '/live/', '/despre/', '/comunitate/', '/momente-cu-mirii/'];
      var DEFAULT_NEXT = '/';
      var DEFAULT_DURATION = 60;

      var qs = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
      var rawNext = qs.get('next');
      var nextPath = SAFE_NEXT_PATHS.indexOf(rawNext) !== -1 ? rawNext : DEFAULT_NEXT;
      var rawDuration = parseInt(qs.get('seconds') || '', 10);
      var duration = (isFinite(rawDuration) && rawDuration > 5 && rawDuration <= 180) ? rawDuration : DEFAULT_DURATION;

      if (continueBtn) continueBtn.href = nextPath;

      function isValidUid(value) { return /^[a-f0-9]{32}$/i.test(String(value || '')); }
      function isValidCustomerCode(value) { return /^[a-z0-9]{6,40}$/.test(String(value || '')); }

      function buildIframeUrl(customerCode, uid) {
        return 'https://customer-' + encodeURIComponent(customerCode) +
          '.cloudflarestream.com/' + encodeURIComponent(uid) +
          '/iframe?autoplay=true&muted=true&controls=false&preload=auto';
      }

      function showOffline() {
        if (offlineOverlay) {
          offlineOverlay.style.display = 'flex';
          offlineOverlay.classList.remove('hidden');
        }
        if (countdownEl) countdownEl.style.display = 'none';
      }

      function startCountdown() {
        if (!secondsEl) return;
        var remaining = duration;
        secondsEl.textContent = String(remaining);
        var timer = window.setInterval(function () {
          remaining -= 1;
          if (secondsEl) secondsEl.textContent = String(Math.max(remaining, 0));
          if (remaining <= 0) {
            window.clearInterval(timer);
            // Oprim playerul înainte de redirect (curățenie)
            try { iframe.src = 'about:blank'; } catch (err) {}
            // Adăugăm UTM pentru tracking în GA4
            var redirectUrl = nextPath;
            try {
              var url = new URL(redirectUrl, window.location.origin);
              url.searchParams.set('utm_source', 'live_preview');
              url.searchParams.set('utm_medium', 'redirect');
              url.searchParams.set('utm_campaign', 'live_teaser');
              redirectUrl = url.pathname + url.search;
            } catch (err) {}
            window.location.replace(redirectUrl);
          }
        }, 1000);
      }

      async function init() {
        try {
          var response = await fetch('/api/live-status/', { cache: 'no-store' });
          if (!response.ok) throw new Error('live-status fetch failed');
          var payload = await response.json();
          var customer = payload && payload.customerCode;
          var liveUid = payload && payload.videoId;
          var replayUid = payload && payload.replayId;

          if (!isValidCustomerCode(customer)) {
            showOffline();
            return;
          }

          var targetUid = null;
          if (payload && payload.isLive && isValidUid(liveUid)) targetUid = liveUid;
          else if (isValidUid(replayUid)) targetUid = replayUid;

          if (!targetUid) {
            showOffline();
            return;
          }

          iframe.src = buildIframeUrl(customer, targetUid);
          startCountdown();
        } catch (err) {
          console.warn('[live-preview] live-status unavailable.', err);
          showOffline();
        }
      }

      init();
    })();
  </script>
</BaseLayout>

```

### src/pages/live.astro
```astro
---
import BaseLayout from '../layouts/BaseLayout.astro';
import BackButton from '../components/BackButton.astro';
import liveReplays from '../data/liveReplays.json';

const livePageTitle = 'Live cu Florentina Pană | Trupă Cover & Muzică Evenimente';
const livePageDescription = 'Urmărește live stream-urile de la nunți, botezuri și evenimente cu Formația Florentina Pană. Simte energia FP Band în timp real.';
const livePageOgImage = '/images/og-live-1200x630.jpg';

/* Replay-uri sortate descrescător după dată (newest-first) */
const replays = [...liveReplays].sort((a, b) => b.date.localeCompare(a.date));
---

<BaseLayout
  title={livePageTitle}
  description={livePageDescription}
  ogImage={livePageOgImage}
>

  {/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
      HERO — Titlu editorial + indicator ON AIR
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */}
  <section class="relative overflow-hidden bg-black py-20 sm:py-28">
    <div class="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-b from-black via-black/90 to-[#1a1005]"></div>

    <div class="section-container relative z-10 text-center">
      <div class="mb-8"><BackButton href="/" label="Acasă" /></div>

      {/* Indicator ON AIR — ascuns implicit, JS îl afișează dacă e live */}
      <div class="mb-6 inline-flex items-center gap-2.5 rounded-full border border-red-500/30 bg-red-500/10 px-5 py-2.5" id="live-badge" style="display:none">
        <span class="relative flex h-3.5 w-3.5">
          <span class="absolute inline-flex h-full w-full animate-pulse rounded-full bg-red-500 opacity-75"></span>
          <span class="relative inline-flex h-3.5 w-3.5 rounded-full bg-red-500"></span>
        </span>
        <span class="text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-red-400">Transmisiune Live</span>
      </div>

      <h1 class="mx-auto max-w-3xl font-['Oswald'] text-4xl font-bold uppercase tracking-widest leading-tight text-white sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl">
        Live cu Florentina Pană
      </h1>
      <p class="mx-auto mt-5 max-w-xl text-lg leading-relaxed text-white/60">
        Transmisiuni în direct de la cele mai frumoase evenimente — nunți, botezuri, petreceri.
      </p>
    </div>
  </section>

    {/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
      PLAYER — YouTube Live/Replay Embed + ramă aurie
      Suportă atât 16:9 (landscape) cât și 9:16 (vertical/Stories)
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */}
  <section class="live-player-section bg-[#1a1005] py-12 sm:py-16">
    <div class="section-container">

      {/* Status format — detectare automată landscape / vertical */}
      <div class="mb-6 flex items-center justify-center">
        <p id="live-format-status" class="live-format-status" aria-live="polite">
          Detectăm automat formatul video...
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* Wrapper glassmorphism — fundal blur decorativ vizibil în modul vertical pe desktop */}
      <div class="live-glass-wrap" id="live-glass-wrap">
        {/* Stratul de blur glassmorphism — fundaluri colorate difuze */}
        <div class="live-glass-bg" aria-hidden="true">
          <div class="live-glass-blob live-glass-blob--amber"></div>
          <div class="live-glass-blob live-glass-blob--red"></div>
          <div class="live-glass-blob live-glass-blob--gold"></div>
        </div>

        {/* Container player — adaptiv landscape / vertical */}
        <div class="live-player-frame" id="live-player-frame">
          <div class="live-player-aspect" id="live-player-aspect">
            <iframe
              id="live-player"
              title="Live Stream — Formația Florentina Pană"
              class="absolute inset-0 h-full w-full bg-black"
              style="border: none;"
              allow="accelerometer; gyroscope; autoplay; encrypted-media; picture-in-picture;"
              allowfullscreen="true"
              loading="lazy"
            ></iframe>

            {/* ── Lower Third — Burtieră cu Like notifications ── */}
            <div id="lower-third" class="absolute bottom-0 left-0 right-0 z-20 min-h-20 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/90 via-black/70 to-transparent px-4 py-3 backdrop-blur-sm" style="display:none">
              <div class="flex items-center justify-center h-full">
                <div id="lower-third-content" class="text-center">
                  <p class="text-lg sm:text-xl font-bold text-white">
                    <span class="animate-pulse">❤️</span> <span id="lower-third-text">Cineva a dat like!</span>
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ── Card Premium Offline — afișat sub player când nu suntem live ── */}
      <div id="offline-overlay" class="live-offline-overlay" style="display:none" aria-live="polite">
        <div class="live-offline-card">
          <div class="live-offline-badge">
            <span class="live-offline-pulse" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            <span>În pauză până la următorul eveniment</span>
          </div>
          <h3 class="live-offline-title">Revenim curând în direct</h3>
          <p class="live-offline-text">
            Nu transmitem live în acest moment. În player rulează momente alese din ultimele evenimente — rămâi pe aproape, urcăm pe scenă în curând.
          </p>
          <p class="live-offline-hint">
            Transmisia începe pe site la 10 minute după startul evenimentului.
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Mesaj offline — afișat de JS când nu e live (ascuns vizual — păstrat pentru cititoarele de ecran) */}
      <p id="offline-msg" class="sr-only" style="display:none">
        În player rulează momente alese din ultimele noastre evenimente. Te anunțăm aici imediat ce intrăm în direct.
      </p>

      <div class="mt-3 flex justify-center">
        <a
          id="open-on-cloudflare"
          href="#"
          target="_blank"
          rel="noopener noreferrer"
          class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-amber-500/40 bg-amber-500/10 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-amber-300 transition hover:border-amber-500/70 hover:bg-amber-500/20 hover:text-amber-200"
          style="display:none"
        >
          Deschide într-o fereastră nouă
        </a>
      </div>

      {/* ── Like Button + Distribuie ── */}
      <div class="mt-6 flex flex-col items-center gap-4 sm:flex-row sm:justify-center">
        <button
          type="button"
          id="btn-like"
          class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border-2 border-red-500/40 bg-red-500/10 px-6 py-3 font-['Oswald'] text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.09em] text-red-300 transition hover:border-red-500/70 hover:bg-red-500/20 hover:text-red-200 active:scale-95 shadow-[0_4px_16px_rgba(239,68,68,0.2)]"
          aria-label="Dă like la transmisiunea live"
        >
          <span class="text-lg">❤️</span>
          <span id="like-text">Like</span>
          <span id="like-count" class="ml-1 text-xs opacity-70"></span>
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          id="btn-native-share"
          class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-cyan-400/30 bg-cyan-500/10 px-6 py-3 font-['Oswald'] text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.09em] text-cyan-200 transition hover:border-cyan-400/60 hover:bg-cyan-500/20 hover:text-cyan-100 active:scale-95"
          aria-label="Distribuie pagina live"
        >
          <svg class="h-4 w-4" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" aria-hidden="true">
            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M8.684 13.342C8.886 12.938 9 12.482 9 12c0-.482-.114-.938-.316-1.342m0 2.684a3 3 0 1 1 0-2.684m0 2.684l6.632 3.316m-6.632-6l6.632-3.316m0 0a3 3 0 1 0 5.367-2.684 3 3 0 0 0-5.367 2.684Zm0 9.316a3 3 0 1 0 5.368 2.684 3 3 0 0 0-5.368-2.684Z" />
          </svg>
          Distribuie
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* ── Ticker Text — Bandă de text care curge ── */}
      <div class="mt-6 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-cyan-400/20 bg-gradient-to-r from-black via-[#0d1a2e] to-black py-2">
        <div class="live-main-ticker-track inline-flex min-w-full gap-8 whitespace-nowrap font-['Oswald'] text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-cyan-300 sm:text-sm">
          <span>Urmăriți-ne live! • Comentați pe platforme! • Florentina Pană • Muzică & Energie • Suntem aici pentru voi!</span>
          <span aria-hidden="true">Urmăriți-ne live! • Comentați pe platforme! • Florentina Pană • Muzică & Energie • Suntem aici pentru voi!</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Toast confirmare copiere link */}
      <div
        id="live-share-toast"
        class="fixed bottom-6 left-1/2 z-50 -translate-x-1/2 rounded-xl border border-green-500/40 bg-[#071a0e]/90 px-5 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-green-400 shadow-xl backdrop-blur-sm"
        style="display:none"
        role="alert"
        aria-live="polite"
      >
        ✓ Link copiat!
      </div>

      {/* Text descriptiv sub player */}
      <p class="mx-auto mt-8 max-w-xl text-center text-base leading-relaxed text-white/50">
        Suntem pe scenă, dând viață momentelor magice. Dacă nu suntem live acum, poți vedea ultima noastră petrecere în player-ul de mai sus.
      </p>

      {/* ── Butoane distribuire socială ── */}
      <div class="mx-auto mt-6 flex max-w-md flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-3">
        {/* Facebook */}
        <a
          id="share-fb"
          href="#"

          aria-label="Distribuie pe Facebook"
        >
          <svg class="h-5 w-5" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true">
            <path d="M22 12c0-5.523-4.477-10-10-10S2 6.477 2 12c0 4.991 3.657 9.128 8.438 9.878v-6.987h-2.54V12h2.54V9.797c0-2.506 1.492-3.89 3.777-3.89 1.094 0 2.238.195 2.238.195v2.46h-1.26c-1.243 0-1.63.771-1.63 1.562V12h2.773l-.443 2.89h-2.33v6.988C18.343 21.128 22 16.991 22 12Z"/>
          </svg>
          <span>Facebook</span>
        </a>

        {/* Copy Link */}
        <button
          type="button"
          id="share-copy"
          class="live-share-btn"
          aria-label="Copiază linkul"
        >
          <svg class="h-5 w-5" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" aria-hidden="true">
            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M13.828 10.172a4 4 0 0 0-5.656 0l-4 4a4 4 0 1 0 5.656 5.656l1.102-1.101" />
            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M10.172 13.828a4 4 0 0 0 5.656 0l4-4a4 4 0 0 0-5.656-5.656l-1.1 1.1" />
          </svg>
          <span id="copy-label">Copiază linkul</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* CTA — imediat sub player, vizibil indiferent de format */}
      <div class="mt-8 text-center">
        <a
          href="/contact/"
          class="inline-flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl border-2 border-amber-500/60 bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-600 to-amber-500 px-8 py-4 text-lg font-bold text-black shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(245,166,35,0.35)] transition-all hover:scale-105 hover:shadow-[0_12px_40px_rgba(245,166,35,0.5)]"
        >
          <svg class="h-6 w-6" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M9.348 14.652a3.75 3.75 0 0 1 0-5.304m5.304 0a3.75 3.75 0 0 1 0 5.304m-7.425 2.121a6.75 6.75 0 0 1 0-9.546m9.546 0a6.75 6.75 0 0 1 0 9.546M5.106 18.894c-3.808-3.807-3.808-9.98 0-13.788m13.788 0c3.808 3.807 3.808 9.98 0 13.788M12 12h.008v.008H12V12Zm.375 0a.375.375 0 1 1-.75 0 .375.375 0 0 1 .75 0Z" />
          </svg>
          Vrei acest vibe la evenimentul tău? Verifică disponibilitatea
        </a>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  {/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
      ULTIMELE LIVE-URI ÎNREGISTRATE
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */}
  <section class="bg-[#0d0800] py-14 sm:py-18">
    <div class="section-container">
      <div class="mx-auto max-w-3xl text-center mb-10">
        <p class="text-amber-400/70 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-widest mb-2">Replay</p>
        <h2 class="font-serif text-3xl font-bold text-white sm:text-4xl">Ultimele Live-uri Înregistrate</h2>
        <p class="mt-3 text-white/50 text-sm">Nu ai prins transmisiunea? Revezi evenimentele noastre în întregime.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="grid gap-5 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
        {replays.map((replay) => {
          const detailUrl = `/live/replay/${replay.slug}/`;
          const watchUrl = replay.cloudflareUid
            ? `https://watch.cloudflarestream.com/${replay.cloudflareUid}`
            : `https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=${replay.youtubeId}`;
          const shareUrl = `https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=${encodeURIComponent(watchUrl)}`;
          return (
            <a href={detailUrl}
              class="group block rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border border-white/10 bg-white/5 transition-all hover:border-amber-500/40 hover:bg-white/[0.08]">
              <div class="relative aspect-video">
                <img src={replay.thumbnail}
                  alt={replay.title}
                  class="w-full h-full object-cover" loading="lazy" decoding="async" fetchpriority="low" width="480" height="360" />
                <div class="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/30 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity">
                  <span class="flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-red-600 shadow-lg">
                    <svg class="h-5 w-5 text-white ml-1" fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><polygon points="5,3 19,12 5,21"/></svg>
                  </span>
                </div>
                <span class="absolute left-3 top-3 inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border border-amber-400/35 bg-black/70 px-2.5 py-1 text-[0.65rem] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-amber-300 backdrop-blur-sm">
                  <svg class="h-3 w-3" fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">

                >

              </div>

          );

<style>
  /* ── Indicator format detectat automat ── */
  .live-format-status {

<script is:inline>
  /* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     SUPABASE CLIENT — Inițializare cu PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL și PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
  ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  (async function initSupabase() {
    const supabaseUrl = 'https://uhqujllxujfbyvwrafzn.supabase.co';
    const supabaseKey = 'sb_publishable_Pizn5TO9w3NpDGMtIKLuGg_TIlKCeCT';

    // Importăm Supabase client din CDN
    try {
      const { createClient } = await import('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2/+esm');
      const client = createClient(supabaseUrl, supabaseKey);
      window.supabaseClient = client;

      // Inițializează Like button și Realtime listeners
      initializeLiveFeatures();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Supabase client failed to load:', err);
    }
  })();

  const initializeLiveFeatures = async () => {
    if (!window.supabaseClient) return;

    const likeBtn = document.getElementById('btn-like');
    const likeCount = document.getElementById('like-count');
    const lowerThird = document.getElementById('lower-third');
    const lowerThirdText = document.getElementById('lower-third-text');
    const client = window.supabaseClient;
    
    // Identifică stream-ul după data curentă
    const streamId = 'live-stream-' + new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];

    // ── Încarcă Like count inițial ──
    const loadLikeCount = async () => {
      try {
        const { count, error } = await client
          .from('interactions')
          .select('*', { count: 'exact', head: true })
          .eq('stream_id', streamId)
          .eq('type', 'like');

        if (!error && count !== null && likeCount) {
          likeCount.textContent = count > 0 ? `(${count})` : '';
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Error loading like count:', err);
      }
    };

    // ── Like button handler ──
    if (likeBtn) {
      likeBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
        try {
          // Inserează like în Supabase
          const { error } = await client
            .from('interactions')
            .insert([
              {
                stream_id: streamId,
                type: 'like',
                created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
              }
            ]);

          if (!error) {
            likeBtn.style.transform = 'scale(1.1)';
            setTimeout(() => {
              likeBtn.style.transform = 'scale(1)';
            }, 200);
          }
        } catch (err) {
          console.error('Error adding like:', err);
        }
      });
    }

    // ── Realtime listener — ascultă noi like-uri ──
    if (lowerThird && client) {
      const channel = client
        .channel(`interactions:stream_id=eq.${streamId}`)
        .on(
          'postgres_changes',
          {
            event: 'INSERT',
            schema: 'public',
            table: 'interactions',
            filter: `stream_id=eq.${streamId}`,
          },
          (payload) => {
            if (payload.new.type === 'like') {
              showLowerThirdNotification();
              loadLikeCount(); // Reîncarcă numărul de like-uri
            }
          }
        )
        .subscribe((status) => {
          if (status === 'SUBSCRIBED') {
            console.log('✓ Realtime listener activ pentru like-uri');
          }
        });
    }

    // ── Animație Lower Third ──
    const showLowerThirdNotification = () => {
      if (!lowerThird) return;

      lowerThird.style.display = 'flex';
      lowerThird.style.animation = 'slideInLowerThird 0.4s ease';

      // Ascunde după 3 secunde
      setTimeout(() => {
        lowerThird.style.animation = 'slideOutLowerThird 0.4s ease forwards';
        setTimeout(() => {
          lowerThird.style.display = 'none';
        }, 400);
      }, 3000);
    };

    // Încarcă contul inițial
    await loadLikeCount();
  };
</script>

<script is:inline define:vars={{ replays }}>
  (function () {
    // ── Status live + fallback playlist YouTube auto pentru offline ──
    var player = document.getElementById('live-player');
    var badge = document.getElementById('live-badge');
    var offlineMsg = document.getElementById('offline-msg');
    var offlineOverlay = document.getElementById('offline-overlay');
    var openExternal = document.getElementById('open-on-cloudflare');
    var formatStatus = document.getElementById('live-format-status');
    var wrap = document.getElementById('live-glass-wrap');
    var isLive = false;
    var currentMode = null; // 'live' | 'offline-playlist' — evită reload inutil

    if (!wrap) return;

    function setFormat(vertical) {
      wrap.classList.toggle('is-vertical', vertical);
      if (formatStatus) {
        formatStatus.textContent = vertical
          ? 'Format detectat automat: Vertical 9:16'
          : 'Format detectat automat: Landscape 16:9';
      }
    }

    function isValidUid(value) {
      return /^[a-f0-9]{32}$/i.test(String(value || ''));
    }

    function isValidCustomerCode(value) {
      return /^[a-z0-9]{6,40}$/.test(String(value || ''));
    }

    function buildCloudflareIframeUrl(customerCode, videoUid, opts) {
      opts = opts || {};
      var params = [];
      if (opts.autoplay) params.push('autoplay=true');
      if (opts.muted) params.push('muted=true');
      if (opts.controls === false) params.push('controls=false');
      var qs = params.length ? '?' + params.join('&') : '';
      return 'https://customer-' + encodeURIComponent(customerCode) +
        '.cloudflarestream.com/' + encodeURIComponent(videoUid) + '/iframe' + qs;
    }

    function buildCloudflareWatchUrl(customerCode, videoUid) {
      return 'https://customer-' + encodeURIComponent(customerCode) +
        '.cloudflarestream.com/' + encodeURIComponent(videoUid) + '/watch';
    }

    function applyLiveState(nextLive) {
      isLive = !!nextLive;
      if (badge) badge.style.display = isLive ? '' : 'none';
      if (offlineMsg) offlineMsg.style.display = isLive ? 'none' : '';
      if (offlineOverlay) offlineOverlay.style.display = isLive ? 'none' : '';
    }

    function setIframeSrc(iframe, src) {
      if (!iframe) return;
      if (iframe.src !== src) iframe.src = src;
    }

    function showOfflinePlaylist() {
      if (currentMode === 'offline-playlist') {
        applyLiveState(false);
        return;
      }
      // Offline — arăt blank, nu YouTube
      if (player) {
        setIframeSrc(player, 'about:blank');
      }
      if (openExternal) openExternal.style.display = 'none';
      applyLiveState(false);
      currentMode = 'offline-playlist';
    }

    async function syncPlayerWithLiveStatus() {
      if (!player) return;

      try {
        var response = await fetch('/api/live-status/', { cache: 'no-store' });
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error('live-status fetch failed');

        var payload = await response.json();
        var customerCode = payload && payload.customerCode;
        var liveUid = payload && payload.videoId;

        if (payload && payload.isLive && isValidCustomerCode(customerCode) && isValidUid(liveUid)) {
          // Live cu Cloudflare Stream
          var liveSrc = buildCloudflareIframeUrl(customerCode, liveUid, { autoplay: true, muted: false });
          setIframeSrc(player, liveSrc);
          if (openExternal) {
            openExternal.href = buildCloudflareWatchUrl(customerCode, liveUid);
            openExternal.style.display = '';
          }
          applyLiveState(true);
          currentMode = 'live';
          return;
        }

        // Nu e live → fallback blank (offline)
        showOfflinePlaylist();
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('[live-page] Cloudflare Stream unavailable.', err);
        showOfflinePlaylist();
      }
    }

    // Playerul principal este landscape în această pagină
    setFormat(false);
    syncPlayerWithLiveStatus();

    // Repolling la 60s pentru a prinde tranziția online → offline
    window.setInterval(syncPlayerWithLiveStatus, 60000);

    // ── Share buttons — URL dinamic ──
    var pageUrl = encodeURIComponent(window.location.href);

    var fbBtn = document.getElementById('share-fb');
    var copyBtn = document.getElementById('share-copy');
    var copyLabel = document.getElementById('copy-label');

    if (fbBtn) fbBtn.href = 'https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=' + pageUrl;

    if (copyBtn && copyLabel) {
      copyBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
        navigator.clipboard.writeText(window.location.href).then(function () {
          var orig = copyLabel.textContent;
          copyLabel.textContent = 'Copiat!';
          copyBtn.style.borderColor = 'rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.5)';
          copyBtn.style.color = '#22c55e';
          setTimeout(function () {
            copyLabel.textContent = orig;
            copyBtn.style.borderColor = '';
            copyBtn.style.color = '';
          }, 2000);
        });
      });
    }

    // ── Buton nativ Distribuie ──
    var nativeShareBtn = document.getElementById('btn-native-share');
    var shareToast = document.getElementById('live-share-toast');

    function showShareToast() {
      if (!shareToast) return;
      shareToast.style.display = '';
      clearTimeout(shareToast._hideTimer);
      shareToast._hideTimer = setTimeout(function () {
        shareToast.style.display = 'none';
      }, 2500);
    }

    if (nativeShareBtn) {
      nativeShareBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
        var url = window.location.href;
        var shareData = {
          title: 'Live cu Florentina Pană',
          text: 'Urmărește transmisiunea live a Formației Florentina Pană!',
          url: url,
        };
        if (navigator.share && navigator.canShare && navigator.canShare(shareData)) {
          navigator.share(shareData).catch(function () {});
        } else {
          navigator.clipboard.writeText(url).then(showShareToast).catch(function () {
            try {
              var ta = document.createElement('textarea');
              ta.value = url;
              ta.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;opacity:0;pointer-events:none';
              document.body.appendChild(ta);
              ta.focus();
              ta.select();
              document.execCommand('copy');
              document.body.removeChild(ta);
              showShareToast();
            } catch (err) {}
          });
        }
      });
    }
  })();
</script>
```

### src/pages/live/replay/[slug].astro
```astro
---
import BaseLayout from '../../../layouts/BaseLayout.astro';
import BackButton from '../../../components/BackButton.astro';
import liveReplays from '../../../data/liveReplays.json';

export const prerender = true;

export function getStaticPaths() {
  return liveReplays.map((replay) => ({
    params: { slug: replay.slug },
    props: { replay },
  }));
}

interface Replay {
  slug: string;
  title: string;
  shortTitle: string;
  metaDescription: string;
  description: string;
  eventType: string;
  location: string;
  date: string;
  durationSeconds: number;
  tags: string[];
  youtubeId: string | null;
  cloudflareUid: string | null;
  thumbnail: string;
}

const { replay } = Astro.props as { replay: Replay };

const pageTitle = `${replay.title} | Replay Live | Formația Florentina Pană`;
const pageDescription = replay.metaDescription;
const ogImage = replay.thumbnail;

const dateFormatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('ro-RO', { day: 'numeric', month: 'long', year: 'numeric' });
const [y, m, d] = replay.date.split('-').map(Number);
const formattedDate = dateFormatter.format(new Date(y, m - 1, d));
const isoDate = `${replay.date}T20:00:00+03:00`;

const minutes = Math.floor(replay.durationSeconds / 60);
const seconds = replay.durationSeconds % 60;
const formattedDuration = `${minutes} min${seconds > 0 ? ` ${seconds}s` : ''}`;
const isoDuration = `PT${minutes}M${seconds > 0 ? `${seconds}S` : ''}`;

const embedUrl = replay.cloudflareUid
  ? `https://iframe.cloudflarestream.com/${replay.cloudflareUid}?autoplay=false&muted=false&controls=true`
  : `https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/${replay.youtubeId}?rel=0&modestbranding=1`;
const watchUrl = replay.cloudflareUid
  ? `https://watch.cloudflarestream.com/${replay.cloudflareUid}`
  : `https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=${replay.youtubeId}`;

const SITE_URL = 'https://www.florentinapanaofficial.ro';
const canonicalUrl = `${SITE_URL}/live/replay/${replay.slug}/`;
const shareFbUrl = `https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=${encodeURIComponent(canonicalUrl)}`;

const paragraphs = replay.description.split(/\n\n+/);

const otherReplays = liveReplays
  .filter((r) => r.slug !== replay.slug)
  .sort((a, b) => b.date.localeCompare(a.date))
  .slice(0, 3);

const videoJsonLd = {
  '@context': 'https://schema.org',
  '@type': 'VideoObject',
  name: replay.title,
  description: replay.description,
  thumbnailUrl: replay.thumbnail,
  uploadDate: isoDate,
  duration: isoDuration,
  contentUrl: watchUrl,
  embedUrl,
  publisher: {
    '@type': 'Organization',
    name: 'Formația Florentina Pană',
    url: SITE_URL,
    logo: {
      '@type': 'ImageObject',
      url: `${SITE_URL}/images/sigla-fp-band.webp`,
    },
  },
  keywords: replay.tags.join(', '),
  inLanguage: 'ro',
  isFamilyFriendly: true,
  contentLocation: {
    '@type': 'Place',
    name: replay.location,
  },
};
---

<BaseLayout
  title={pageTitle}
  description={pageDescription}
  ogImage={ogImage}
  ogType="video.other"
  ogVideoUrl={embedUrl}
  ogVideoSecureUrl={embedUrl}
  ogVideoWidth="1280"
  ogVideoHeight="720"
  datePublished={isoDate}
>
  <script is:inline type="application/ld+json" set:html={JSON.stringify(videoJsonLd)} />

  <section class="bg-black py-10 sm:py-14">
    <div class="section-container">
      <BackButton href="/live/" label="Înapoi la Live" />

      <div class="replay-player-wrap mx-auto mt-6 max-w-4xl">
        <div class="relative w-full overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-black aspect-video shadow-2xl ring-1 ring-amber-500/20">
          <iframe
            src={embedUrl}
            title={replay.title}
            class="absolute inset-0 h-full w-full"
            frameborder="0"
            allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share"
            allowfullscreen
            loading="lazy"
          ></iframe>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="mx-auto mt-6 max-w-4xl">
        <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-2 mb-3">
          <span class="replay-meta-badge"><svg class="h-3.5 w-3.5" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M6.75 3v2.25M17.25 3v2.25M3 18.75V7.5a2.25 2.25 0 0 1 2.25-2.25h13.5A2.25 2.25 0 0 1 21 7.5v11.25"/></svg>{formattedDate}</span>
          <span class="replay-meta-badge"><svg class="h-3.5 w-3.5" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M15 10.5a3 3 0 1 1-6 0 3 3 0 0 1 6 0Z"/><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M19.5 10.5c0 7.142-7.5 11.25-7.5 11.25S4.5 17.642 4.5 10.5a7.5 7.5 0 1 1 15 0Z"/></svg>{replay.location}</span>
          <span class="replay-meta-badge"><svg class="h-3.5 w-3.5" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M12 6v6h4.5m4.5 0a9 9 0 1 1-18 0 9 9 0 0 1 18 0Z"/></svg>{formattedDuration}</span>
          <span class="replay-meta-badge replay-meta-badge--type">{replay.eventType}</span>
        </div>
        <h1 class="font-serif text-2xl font-bold text-white sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl">{replay.title}</h1>

        <div class="mt-5 flex flex-wrap gap-3">
          <a href={shareFbUrl} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="replay-action-btn">
            <svg class="h-4 w-4" fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M22 12a10 10 0 1 0-11.56 9.88v-6.99H7.9V12h2.54V9.8c0-2.5 1.49-3.89 3.77-3.89 1.09 0 2.24.2 2.24.2v2.46h-1.26c-1.24 0-1.63.77-1.63 1.56V12h2.77l-.44 2.89h-2.33v6.99A10 10 0 0 0 22 12Z"/></svg>
            Distribuie pe Facebook
          </a>
          <button type="button" class="replay-action-btn" data-replay-copy data-url={canonicalUrl}>
            <svg class="h-4 w-4" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M13.19 8.688a4.5 4.5 0 0 1 1.242 7.244l-4.5 4.5a4.5 4.5 0 0 1-6.364-6.364l1.757-1.757m13.35-.622 1.757-1.757a4.5 4.5 0 0 0-6.364-6.364l-4.5 4.5a4.5 4.5 0 0 0 1.242 7.244"/></svg>
            <span data-copy-text>Copiază link</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <article class="replay-description mx-auto mt-8 max-w-4xl">
        <h2 class="replay-section-title">Despre acest replay</h2>
        {paragraphs.map((p) => <p>{p}</p>)}

        <div class="mt-6 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          {replay.tags.map((tag) => (
            <span class="replay-tag">#{tag}</span>
          ))}
        </div>
      </article>

      <div class="replay-cta mx-auto mt-10 max-w-4xl">
        <h2 class="replay-cta-title">Vrei un eveniment ca acesta?</h2>
        <p class="replay-cta-subtitle">
          Verifică disponibilitatea Formației Florentina Pană pentru data evenimentului tău. Răspundem rapid, cu pachet personalizat și detalii complete.
        </p>
        <a href="/contact/" class="replay-cta-btn">
          <span>Verifică disponibilitatea</span>
          <svg class="h-5 w-5" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M13.5 4.5 21 12m0 0-7.5 7.5M21 12H3"/></svg>
        </a>
      </div>

      {otherReplays.length > 0 && (
        <div class="mx-auto mt-14 max-w-5xl">
          <h2 class="replay-section-title text-center">Alte replay-uri</h2>
          <div class="mt-6 grid gap-5 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
            {otherReplays.map((other) => (
              <a href={`/live/replay/${other.slug}/`} class="group block rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border border-white/10 bg-white/5 transition-all hover:border-amber-500/40 hover:bg-white/[0.08]">
                <div class="relative aspect-video">
                  <img src={other.thumbnail} alt={other.title} class="w-full h-full object-cover" loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="480" height="360" />
                  <div class="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/30 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity">
                    <span class="flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-red-600 shadow-lg">
                      <svg class="h-5 w-5 text-white ml-1" fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><polygon points="5,3 19,12 5,21"/></svg>
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div class="p-4">
                  <p class="text-sm font-semibold text-white/90 group-hover:text-amber-400 transition-colors line-clamp-2">{other.title}</p>
                </div>
              </a>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  </section>
</BaseLayout>

<script is:inline>
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-replay-copy]').forEach((btn) => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
      const url = btn.getAttribute('data-url') || window.location.href;
      const label = btn.querySelector('[data-copy-text]');
      try {
        await navigator.clipboard.writeText(url);
        if (label) {
          const original = label.textContent;
          label.textContent = 'Link copiat!';
          setTimeout(() => { label.textContent = original; }, 2000);
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    });
  });
</script>

<style>
  .replay-meta-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; padding: 0.4rem 0.8rem; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); color: rgba(255,255,255,0.78); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; }
  .replay-meta-badge--type { border-color: rgba(245,166,35,0.40); background: rgba(245,166,35,0.10); color: #f5c97a; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; font-size: 0.7rem; }

  .replay-action-btn:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); background: rgba(245,166,35,0.10); border-color: rgba(245,166,35,0.45); color: #fff; }

  .replay-cta-title { margin: 0 0 0.5rem; font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; }
  .replay-cta-subtitle { margin: 0 auto 1.25rem; max-width: 36rem; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.72); font-size: 0.95rem; line-height: 1.55; }

  .replay-cta-btn:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 14px 32px rgba(245,166,35,0.42), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.35); }
  .line-clamp-2 { display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; overflow: hidden; }
  @media (max-width: 480px) { .replay-cta { padding: 1.25rem 1rem; } .replay-cta-btn { width: 100%; justify-content: center; font-size: 0.9rem; } }
</style>
```
