### src/pages/membri.astro
```astro
﻿---
import BaseLayout from '../layouts/BaseLayout.astro';
import siteContent from '../data/siteContent.json';
import BackButton from '../components/BackButton.astro';

const { membri, colaboratori: colaboratoriData } = siteContent as any;
const allMembri: any[] = membri ?? [];
const solisti        = allMembri.filter((m: any) => m.categorie === 'solisti');
const instrumentisti = allMembri.filter((m: any) => m.categorie === 'instrumentisti');
const colaboratori: any[] = (colaboratoriData ?? []).filter(
  (c: any) => c.nume && !c.nume.toLowerCase().includes('în curând')
);

/** Verifică dacă un membru are galerie foto reală (array non-gol). */
function areGalerieFoto(m: any): boolean {
  return Array.isArray(m.galpisFoto) && m.galpisFoto.length > 0;
}

function initiale(name: string): string {
  return name.split(' ').filter(Boolean).map((w) => w[0]).join('').slice(0, 2).toUpperCase();
}
---

<BaseLayout
  title="Membrii Formației Florentina Pană | Trupă Profesionistă Nuntă Pitești, Argeș"
  description="Cunoaște echipa formației Florentina Pană — soliști vocali și instrumentiști cu experiență de peste 20 ani. Formație nuntă Pitești și Argeș, disponibilă pentru nunți, botezuri și evenimente în toată România."
  hideFooter={true}
>
<div class="stage-wrap">
  <div class="stage-back"><BackButton href="/" label="Acasă" /></div>

  <!-- ═══ STAGE PAGE HEADER ═══ -->
  <header class="sph" aria-label="Prezentare echipă">
    <div class="sph-beams" aria-hidden="true">
      <div class="sph-beam b1"></div><div class="sph-beam b2"></div>
      <div class="sph-beam b3"></div><div class="sph-beam b4"></div>
      <div class="sph-beam b5"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="sph-lines" aria-hidden="true"></div>
    <div class="sph-content">
      <p class="sph-eyebrow">Formația Florentina Pană</p>
      <h1 class="sph-title">Echipa Noastră</h1>
      <p class="sph-sub">Soliști vocali, instrumentiști și colaboratori cu experiență de peste 10 ani pentru nunți, botezuri și evenimente în toată România.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="sph-floor" aria-hidden="true"></div>
  </header>

  <!-- ═══ SOLIȘTI VOCALI ═══ -->
  <section class="stage-section" aria-labelledby="sec-solisti">
    <div class="stl-row" role="presentation">
      <span class="stl-line" aria-hidden="true"></span>
      <div class="stl-center">
        <svg class="stl-icon" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 2a3 3 0 0 0-3 3v7a3 3 0 0 0 6 0V5a3 3 0 0 0-3-3Z"/><path d="M19 10v2a7 7 0 0 1-14 0v-2"/><line x1="12" y1="19" x2="12" y2="22"/></svg>
        <span class="stl-text" id="sec-solisti">Soliști Vocali</span>
      </div>
      <span class="stl-line stl-line--r" aria-hidden="true"></span>
    </div>
    <div class="ac-grid ac-grid--duo">
      {solisti.map((m: any, i: number) => (
        <div class="member-card-wrap">
          <article class={`ac ac--solist${areGalerieFoto(m) ? ' has-gal' : ''}`} data-member={m.nume}>
            <div class="ac-photos">
              {m.imagine && m.imagine.trim() !== '' ? (
                <img class="ac-photo is-active" src={m.imagine} alt={`${m.nume} — ${m.rol}, Formația Florentina Pană Pitești`} loading="eager" decoding="async" width="560" height="840" />
              ) : (
                <div class="ac-ph"><div class="ac-ph-light" aria-hidden="true"></div><span class="ac-initials">{initiale(m.nume)}</span></div>
              )}
              {areGalerieFoto(m) && m.galpisFoto.slice(1, 7).map((foto: any, n: number) => (
                <img class="ac-photo" src={foto.src} alt={foto.alt ?? m.nume} loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="560" height="840" data-slide={n + 1} />
              ))}
            </div>
            <div class="ac-scanlines" aria-hidden="true"></div>
            <div class="ac-grad" aria-hidden="true"></div>
            <div class="ac-beam" aria-hidden="true"></div>
            <div class="ac-top">
              <span class="ac-badge ac-b--solist">Solist Vocal</span>
              {m.experienta && m.experienta.trim() !== '' && <span class="ac-star">★ {m.experienta}</span>}
            </div>
            <div class="ac-body">
              <p class="ac-spec">{m.specialitate}</p>
              <h3 class="ac-name">{m.nume}</h3>
              <div class="ac-reveal">
                {m.citat && <blockquote class="ac-citat"><p>{m.citat}</p></blockquote>}
                {areGalerieFoto(m) && (
                  <div class="ac-strip" role="list" aria-label={`Galerie ${m.nume}`}>
                    {m.galpisFoto.slice(0, 5).map((foto: any, n: number) => (
                      <button class="ac-th gallery-thumb" type="button" role="listitem"
                        data-src={foto.src} data-alt={foto.alt ?? m.nume} data-member={m.nume}
                        data-fx={String((n % 6) + 1)} tabindex="-1" aria-label={foto.alt ?? `Foto ${n + 1}`}>
                        <img src={foto.src} alt="" loading="lazy" width="72" height="72" />
                      </button>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
            <button class="bio-btn" type="button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls={`bio-s${i}`} aria-label={`Biografie ${m.nume}`}>
              <span class="bio-btn-text">BIO</span>
            </button>
          </article>
          <div class="bio-panel" id={`bio-s${i}`} aria-hidden="true">
            {m.citat && <blockquote class="bio-quote"><p>{m.citat}</p></blockquote>}
            <p class="bio-text">{m.bio}</p>
            {m.taguri && m.taguri.length > 0 && (
              <div class="bio-tags" aria-label="Specializări">
                {m.taguri.map((tag: string) => <span class="bio-tag">{tag}</span>)}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  </section>

  <div class="scroll-hint-wrap" aria-hidden="true">
    <a href="#sec-instr" class="scroll-hint-btn">
      <span class="scroll-hint-text">Instrumentiști</span>
      <svg class="scroll-hint-arrow" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"/></svg>
    </a>
  </div>

  <!-- ═══ INSTRUMENTIȘTI ═══ -->
  <section class="stage-section" id="sec-instr" aria-labelledby="sec-instr-title">
    <div class="stl-row" role="presentation">
      <span class="stl-line" aria-hidden="true"></span>
      <div class="stl-center">
        <svg class="stl-icon" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 18V5l12-2v13"/><circle cx="6" cy="18" r="3"/><circle cx="18" cy="16" r="3"/></svg>
        <span class="stl-text" id="sec-instr-title">Instrumentiști</span>
      </div>
      <span class="stl-line stl-line--r" aria-hidden="true"></span>
    </div>
    <div class="ac-grid ac-grid--trio">
      {instrumentisti.map((m: any, i: number) => (
        <div class="member-card-wrap">
          <article class={`ac ac--instr${areGalerieFoto(m) ? ' has-gal' : ''}`} data-member={m.nume}>
            <div class="ac-photos">
              {m.imagine && m.imagine.trim() !== '' ? (
                <img class="ac-photo is-active" src={m.imagine} alt={`${m.nume} — ${m.specialitate}, Formația Florentina Pană`} loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="560" height="840" />
              ) : (
                <div class="ac-ph"><div class="ac-ph-light" aria-hidden="true"></div><span class="ac-initials">{initiale(m.nume)}</span></div>
              )}
              {areGalerieFoto(m) && m.galpisFoto.slice(1, 7).map((foto: any, n: number) => (
                <img class="ac-photo" src={foto.src} alt={foto.alt ?? m.nume} loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="560" height="840" data-slide={n + 1} />
              ))}
            </div>
            <div class="ac-scanlines" aria-hidden="true"></div>
            <div class="ac-grad" aria-hidden="true"></div>
            <div class="ac-beam" aria-hidden="true"></div>
            <div class="ac-top">
              <span class="ac-badge ac-b--instr">Instrumentist</span>
              {m.specialitate && <span class="ac-instr-pill">{m.specialitate}</span>}
            </div>
            <div class="ac-body">
              <h3 class="ac-name">{m.nume}</h3>
              <div class="ac-reveal">
                {m.citat && <blockquote class="ac-citat"><p>{m.citat}</p></blockquote>}
                {areGalerieFoto(m) && (
                  <div class="ac-strip" role="list" aria-label={`Galerie ${m.nume}`}>
                    {m.galpisFoto.slice(0, 5).map((foto: any, n: number) => (
                      <button class="ac-th gallery-thumb" type="button" role="listitem"
                        data-src={foto.src} data-alt={foto.alt ?? m.nume} data-member={m.nume}
                        data-fx={String((n % 6) + 1)} tabindex="-1" aria-label={foto.alt ?? `Foto ${n + 1}`}>
                        <img src={foto.src} alt="" loading="lazy" width="72" height="72" />
                      </button>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
            <button class="bio-btn" type="button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls={`bio-in${i}`} aria-label={`Biografie ${m.nume}`}>
              <span class="bio-btn-text">BIO</span>
            </button>
          </article>
          <div class="bio-panel" id={`bio-in${i}`} aria-hidden="true">
            {m.citat && <blockquote class="bio-quote"><p>{m.citat}</p></blockquote>}
            <p class="bio-text">{m.bio}</p>
            {m.taguri && m.taguri.length > 0 && (
              <div class="bio-tags" aria-label="Specializări">
                {m.taguri.map((tag: string) => <span class="bio-tag">{tag}</span>)}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  </section>

  <div class="scroll-hint-wrap" aria-hidden="true">
    <a href="#sec-colab" class="scroll-hint-btn">
      <span class="scroll-hint-text">Colaboratori</span>
      <svg class="scroll-hint-arrow" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"/></svg>
    </a>
  </div>

  <!-- ═══ COLABORATORI ═══ -->
  <section class="stage-section" aria-labelledby="sec-colab">
    <div class="stl-row" role="presentation">
      <span class="stl-line" aria-hidden="true"></span>
      <div class="stl-center">
        <svg class="stl-icon" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M17 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-4-4H5a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v2"/><circle cx="9" cy="7" r="4"/><path d="M23 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-3-3.87"/><path d="M16 3.13a4 4 0 0 1 0 7.75"/></svg>
        <span class="stl-text" id="sec-colab">Colaboratori</span>
      </div>
      <span class="stl-line stl-line--r" aria-hidden="true"></span>
    </div>
    <div class="ac-grid ac-grid--auto">
      {colaboratori.map((m: any, i: number) => (
        <div class="member-card-wrap">
          <article class={`ac ac--colab${areGalerieFoto(m) ? ' has-gal' : ''}`} data-member={m.nume}>
            <div class="ac-photos">
              {m.imagine && m.imagine.trim() !== '' ? (
                <img class="ac-photo is-active" src={m.imagine} alt={`${m.nume} — ${m.specialitate}, colaborator Formația Florentina Pană`} loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="560" height="840" />
              ) : (
                <div class="ac-ph"><div class="ac-ph-light" aria-hidden="true"></div><span class="ac-initials">{initiale(m.nume)}</span></div>
              )}
              {areGalerieFoto(m) && m.galpisFoto.slice(1, 7).map((foto: any, n: number) => (
                <img class="ac-photo" src={foto.src} alt={foto.alt ?? m.nume} loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="560" height="840" data-slide={n + 1} />
              ))}
            </div>
            <div class="ac-scanlines" aria-hidden="true"></div>
            <div class="ac-grad" aria-hidden="true"></div>
            <div class="ac-beam" aria-hidden="true"></div>
            <div class="ac-top">
              <span class="ac-badge ac-b--colab">Colaborator</span>
              {m.experienta && m.experienta.trim() !== '' && <span class="ac-star">★ {m.experienta}</span>}
            </div>
            <div class="ac-body">
              <p class="ac-spec">{m.specialitate}</p>
              <h3 class="ac-name">{m.nume}</h3>
              <div class="ac-reveal">
                {m.citat && <blockquote class="ac-citat"><p>{m.citat}</p></blockquote>}
                {areGalerieFoto(m) && (
                  <div class="ac-strip" role="list" aria-label={`Galerie ${m.nume}`}>
                    {m.galpisFoto.slice(0, 5).map((foto: any, n: number) => (
                      <button class="ac-th gallery-thumb" type="button" role="listitem"
                        data-src={foto.src} data-alt={foto.alt ?? m.nume} data-member={m.nume}
                        data-fx={String((n % 6) + 1)} tabindex="-1" aria-label={foto.alt ?? `Foto ${n + 1}`}>
                        <img src={foto.src} alt="" loading="lazy" width="72" height="72" />
                      </button>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
            <button class="bio-btn" type="button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls={`bio-co${i}`} aria-label={`Biografie ${m.nume}`}>
              <span class="bio-btn-text">BIO</span>
            </button>
          </article>
          <div class="bio-panel" id={`bio-co${i}`} aria-hidden="true">
            {m.citat && <blockquote class="bio-quote"><p>{m.citat}</p></blockquote>}
            <p class="bio-text">{m.bio}</p>
            {m.taguri && m.taguri.length > 0 && (
              <div class="bio-tags" aria-label="Specializări">
                {m.taguri.map((tag: string) => <span class="bio-tag">{tag}</span>)}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- ═══ GALLERY POPUP ═══ -->
  <div id="gallery-popup" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Foto mărit">
    <button id="gallery-popup-close" type="button" aria-label="Închide galeria">✕</button>
    <button id="gallery-popup-prev" type="button" class="gallery-popup-nav gallery-popup-prev" aria-label="Foto anterioară">
      <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m15 18-6-6 6-6"/></svg>
    </button>
    <div id="gallery-popup-inner"><img id="gallery-popup-img" src="" alt="" /></div>
    <button id="gallery-popup-next" type="button" class="gallery-popup-nav gallery-popup-next" aria-label="Foto următoare">
      <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m9 18 6-6-6-6"/></svg>
    </button>
    <div id="gallery-popup-counter" class="gallery-popup-counter" aria-live="polite"></div>
  </div>

</div>
</BaseLayout>


<script is:inline>
  // ═══ Mut popup-ul galerie la <body> — evită containment-ul
  // backdrop-filter/overflow care blochează position:fixed ═══
  (function() {
    const popup = document.getElementById('gallery-popup');
    if (popup && popup.parentElement !== document.body) {
      document.body.appendChild(popup);
    }
  })();

  document.querySelectorAll('.bio-btn').forEach((btn) => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      const wrap = btn.closest('.member-card-wrap');
      if (!wrap) return;
      const panel = wrap.querySelector('.bio-panel');
      if (!panel) return;
      const isOpen = panel.classList.contains('open');

      // Închide toate celelalte paneluri
      document.querySelectorAll('.bio-panel.open').forEach((p) => {
        p.classList.remove('open');
        p.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      });
      document.querySelectorAll('.bio-btn.active').forEach((b) => {
        b.classList.remove('active');
        b.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      });

      if (!isOpen) {
        panel.classList.add('open');
        panel.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
        btn.classList.add('active');
        btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
      }
    });
  });

  // Click în afara închide panelul
  document.addEventListener('click', () => {
    document.querySelectorAll('.bio-panel.open').forEach((p) => {
      p.classList.remove('open');
      p.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('.bio-btn.active').forEach((b) => {
      b.classList.remove('active');
      b.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    });
  });

  // ═══ GALLERY POPUP FX + NAVIGARE GRUP ═══
  const fxMap = {
    '1': { enter: 'fx-pop-in',      leave: 'fx-pop-out'      },
    '2': { enter: 'fx-warp-in',     leave: 'fx-warp-out'     },
    '3': { enter: 'fx-rubber-in',   leave: 'fx-rubber-out'   },
    '4': { enter: 'fx-flip-in',     leave: 'fx-flip-out'     },
    '5': { enter: 'fx-splat-in',    leave: 'fx-splat-out'    },
    '6': { enter: 'fx-spindrop-in', leave: 'fx-spindrop-out' },
  };

  const popup      = document.getElementById('gallery-popup');
  const popupImg   = document.getElementById('gallery-popup-img');
  const popupClose = document.getElementById('gallery-popup-close');
  const popupPrev  = document.getElementById('gallery-popup-prev');
  const popupNext  = document.getElementById('gallery-popup-next');
  const popupCounter = document.getElementById('gallery-popup-counter');

  let currentFx  = '1';
  let lastFocusedThumb = null;

  // Grupurile de poze per membru — populate la click
  let currentGroup = [];   // Array<{src, alt, fx}>
  let currentIndex = 0;

  function allFxClasses() {
    return Object.values(fxMap).flatMap((v) => [v.enter, v.leave]);
  }

  function updateNav() {
    const total = currentGroup.length;
    const hasPrev = currentIndex > 0;
    const hasNext = currentIndex < total - 1;
    popupPrev.style.display = total > 1 ? '' : 'none';
    popupNext.style.display = total > 1 ? '' : 'none';
    popupPrev.disabled = !hasPrev;
    popupNext.disabled = !hasNext;
    popupPrev.style.opacity = hasPrev ? '1' : '0.3';
    popupNext.style.opacity = hasNext ? '1' : '0.3';
    popupCounter.textContent = total > 1 ? (currentIndex + 1) + ' / ' + total : '';
  }

  function showImage(idx, fx, animate) {
    if (idx < 0 || idx >= currentGroup.length) return;
    currentIndex = idx;
    const item = currentGroup[idx];
    const anim = fxMap[fx] ?? fxMap['1'];
    if (animate) {
      popupImg.classList.remove(...allFxClasses());
      popupImg.classList.add(anim.enter);
    }
    popupImg.src = item.src;
    popupImg.alt = item.alt;
    updateNav();
  }

  function openPopup(memberName, startIdx, fx) {
    // Colectează toate thumb-urile aceluiași membru
    const thumbs = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.gallery-thumb[data-member="' + CSS.escape(memberName) + '"]'));
    currentGroup = thumbs.map(function(t) {
      return { src: t.dataset.src || '', alt: t.dataset.alt || '', fx: t.dataset.fx || '1' };
    });
    currentIndex = startIdx;
    currentFx = fx;

    lastFocusedThumb = document.activeElement;
    popupImg.classList.remove(...allFxClasses());
    popup.classList.add('active');

    showImage(startIdx, fx, true);

    history.pushState({ galleryOpen: true }, '');
    requestAnimationFrame(function() { popupClose.focus(); });
  }

  function navigateTo(direction) {
    var newIdx = currentIndex + direction;
    if (newIdx < 0 || newIdx >= currentGroup.length) return;
    var item = currentGroup[newIdx];
    popupImg.classList.remove(...allFxClasses());
    showImage(newIdx, item.fx, true);
  }

  function closePopup(fx, opts) {
    fx = fx || currentFx;
    opts = opts || {};
    if (!popup.classList.contains('active')) return;
    var anim = fxMap[fx] || fxMap['1'];
    popupImg.classList.remove(...allFxClasses());
    popupImg.classList.add(anim.leave);
    if (!opts.fromPopstate) {
      history.back();
    }
    popupImg.addEventListener('animationend', function() {
      popup.classList.remove('active');
      popupImg.src = '';
      popupImg.alt = '';
      popupImg.classList.remove(anim.leave);
      currentGroup = [];
      currentIndex = 0;
      popupCounter.textContent = '';
      if (lastFocusedThumb && lastFocusedThumb.focus) {
        lastFocusedThumb.focus();
        lastFocusedThumb = null;
      }
    }, { once: true });
  }

  // Butonul fizic Back închide popup-ul dacă e deschis
  window.addEventListener('popstate', function() {
    if (popup.classList.contains('active')) {
      closePopup(currentFx, { fromPopstate: true });
    }
  });

  // ═══ GALLERY SLIDER — dots + mouse drag ═══
  let galleryDragged = false;

  document.querySelectorAll('.gallery-thumb').forEach(function(thumb) {
    function activateThumb() {
      var fx     = thumb.dataset.fx     || '1';
      var member = thumb.dataset.member || '';
      // Determină indexul în grupul membrului
      var siblings = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.gallery-thumb[data-member="' + CSS.escape(member) + '"]'));
      var idx = siblings.indexOf(thumb);
      currentFx = fx;
      openPopup(member, idx >= 0 ? idx : 0, fx);
    }

    thumb.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      e.stopPropagation();
      if (galleryDragged) { galleryDragged = false; return; }
      activateThumb();
    });

    thumb.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
      if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        activateThumb();
      }
    });
  });

  // ── Navigare prev/next butoane ──
  popupPrev.addEventListener('click', function(e) { e.stopPropagation(); navigateTo(-1); });
  popupNext.addEventListener('click', function(e) { e.stopPropagation(); navigateTo(1); });

  // ── Click pe backdrop închide ──
  popup.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    // Nu închide dacă click pe butoanele de nav sau pe imagine
    if (e.target.closest('.gallery-popup-nav') || e.target.closest('#gallery-popup-inner')) return;
    closePopup(currentFx);
  });

  popupClose.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    e.stopPropagation();
    closePopup(currentFx);
  });

  // ── Tastatură: Escape, Stânga, Dreapta ──
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
    if (!popup.classList.contains('active')) return;
    if (e.key === 'Escape') closePopup(currentFx);
    if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft')  navigateTo(-1);
    if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') navigateTo(1);
  });

  // ── Pe mobil, swipe-ul în popup este DEZACTIVAT intenționat.
  //    Navigarea între poze se face DOAR din săgețile ‹ › (.gallery-popup-nav).
  //    Blocăm propagarea touch-urilor către detectorul global de swipe
  //    din public/js/mobile-swipe.js, ca un swipe accidental în popup
  //    să NU mai declanșeze navigarea între paginile din meniu.
  (function() {
    function stopIfActive(e) {
      if (!popup.classList.contains('active')) return;
      e.stopPropagation();
    }
    popup.addEventListener('touchstart',  stopIfActive, { passive: true });
    popup.addEventListener('touchmove',   stopIfActive, { passive: true });
    popup.addEventListener('touchend',    stopIfActive, { passive: true });
    popup.addEventListener('touchcancel', stopIfActive, { passive: true });
  })();

  // ═══ GALLERY SLIDER — dots + mouse drag ═══
  document.querySelectorAll('.mc-gallery-wrap').forEach((wrap) => {
    const gallery = wrap.querySelector('.mc-gallery');
    const indicator = wrap.querySelector('.mc-gallery-indicator');
    const hint = wrap.querySelector('.mc-gallery-hint');
    if (!gallery) return;

    const dots = indicator ? indicator.querySelectorAll('.dot') : [];
    const thumbs = gallery.querySelectorAll('.mc-gallery-ph');

    let hintHidden = false;

    // ── Actualizare dots la scroll ──
    function updateDots() {
      if (dots.length < 2) return;
      const scrollLeft = gallery.scrollLeft;

      let activeIdx = 0;
      let minDist = Infinity;
      thumbs.forEach((thumb, idx) => {
        const thumbCenter = thumb.offsetLeft + thumb.offsetWidth / 2;
        const galCenter = scrollLeft + gallery.clientWidth / 2;
        const dist = Math.abs(thumbCenter - galCenter);
        if (dist < minDist) {
          minDist = dist;
          activeIdx = idx;
        }
      });

      dots.forEach((dot, idx) => {
        dot.classList.toggle('active', idx === activeIdx);
      });
    }

    gallery.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
      // Ascunde hint-ul după primul scroll
      if (!hintHidden && gallery.scrollLeft > 10 && hint) {
        hint.style.opacity = '0';
        hint.style.transition = 'opacity 0.3s';
        hintHidden = true;
      }
      updateDots();
    }, { passive: true });

    // ── Mouse drag scroll (pentru desktop cu mouse) ──
    let isDragging = false;
    let startX = 0;
    let scrollStart = 0;
    let dragMoved = false;

    gallery.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
      // Doar click stânga
      if (e.button !== 0) return;
      isDragging = true;
      dragMoved = false;
      startX = e.pageX;
      scrollStart = gallery.scrollLeft;
      gallery.style.cursor = 'grabbing';
      gallery.style.userSelect = 'none';
      e.preventDefault();
    });

    document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
      if (!isDragging) return;
      const dx = e.pageX - startX;
      if (Math.abs(dx) > 5) dragMoved = true;
      gallery.scrollLeft = scrollStart - dx;
    });

    document.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
      if (!isDragging) return;
      isDragging = false;
      gallery.style.cursor = '';
      gallery.style.userSelect = '';
      if (dragMoved) galleryDragged = true;
    });
  });

  // ── Photo cycling on hover (membrii cu galerie) ──
  document.querySelectorAll('.ac.has-gal').forEach(function(card) {
    var photos = Array.from(card.querySelectorAll('.ac-photo'));
    if (photos.length < 2) return;
    var timer = null;
    var idx = 0;
    card.addEventListener('mouseenter', function() {
      timer = setInterval(function() {
        photos[idx].classList.remove('is-active');
        idx = (idx + 1) % photos.length;
        photos[idx].classList.add('is-active');
      }, 4200);
    });
    card.addEventListener('mouseleave', function() {
      clearInterval(timer); timer = null;
      photos.forEach(function(p, i) { p.classList.toggle('is-active', i === 0); });
      idx = 0;
    });
  });
</script>

<!-- Override-urile mobile sunt acum în globals.css (secțiunile 5 & 6 = vertical by default). -->
<style is:global>
  @media (max-width: 767px) {
    /* Padding lateral specific paginii Membri (mai strâns decât global) */
    html main#continut > section.membri-page-wrap > section.mem-section {
      padding-left: 0.6rem !important;
      padding-right: 0.6rem !important;
      padding-bottom: 1rem !important;
    }
  }

  /* ══════════════════════════════════════════
     GALLERY POPUP OVERLAY — global (popup e mutat pe <body> via JS)
  ══════════════════════════════════════════ */
  #gallery-popup {
    display: none;
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    z-index: 9000;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.82);
    backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
    cursor: zoom-out;
  }

  #gallery-popup.active {
    display: flex;
  }

  #gallery-popup-close {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0.75rem;
    right: 0.75rem;
    z-index: 10;
    width: 44px;
    height: 44px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25);
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);
    backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 1.25rem;
    line-height: 1;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    transition: background 200ms, transform 200ms, border-color 200ms;
  }

  #gallery-popup-close:hover,
  #gallery-popup-close:focus-visible {
    background: rgba(255, 60, 80, 0.65);
    border-color: rgba(255, 60, 80, 0.6);
    transform: scale(1.1);
    outline: none;
  }

  @media (max-width: 767px) {
    #gallery-popup-close {
      top: calc(env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px) + 0.75rem);
      right: 0.75rem;
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      font-size: 1.4rem;
    }
  }

  /* ── Butoane navigare Prev / Next ── */
  .gallery-popup-nav {
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%;
    transform: translateY(-50%);
    z-index: 10;
    width: 48px;
    height: 48px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25);
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);
    backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
    color: #fff;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    transition: background 200ms, transform 200ms, border-color 200ms, opacity 200ms;
    pointer-events: auto;
  }

  .gallery-popup-prev { left: 0.75rem; }
  .gallery-popup-next { right: 0.75rem; }

  .gallery-popup-nav:hover,
  .gallery-popup-nav:focus-visible {
    background: rgba(0, 200, 255, 0.25);
    border-color: rgba(0, 200, 255, 0.5);
    transform: translateY(-50%) scale(1.1);
    outline: none;
  }

  .gallery-popup-nav:disabled {
    cursor: default;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  /* ── Counter (1 / N) ── */
  .gallery-popup-counter {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 1rem;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    z-index: 10;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
    backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
    padding: 0.3rem 0.9rem;
    border-radius: 1rem;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
    pointer-events: none;
    min-height: 1.5rem;
  }

  @media (max-width: 767px) {
    .gallery-popup-nav {
      width: 40px;
      height: 40px;
    }
    .gallery-popup-prev { left: 0.4rem; }
    .gallery-popup-next { right: 0.4rem; }
    .gallery-popup-nav svg {
      width: 20px;
      height: 20px;
    }
    .gallery-popup-counter {
      bottom: 0.75rem;
      font-size: 0.78rem;
    }
  }

  #gallery-popup-inner {
    position: relative;
    max-width: 90vw;
    max-height: 85dvh;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  #gallery-popup-img {
    display: block;
    max-width: 90vw;
    max-height: 85dvh;
    border-radius: 0.75rem;
    box-shadow: 0 0 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.8), 0 0 20px rgba(232,200,91,0.25);
    border: 1px solid rgba(232,200,91,0.3);
    object-fit: contain;
  }

  /* ── FX keyframes ── */
  @keyframes fx-pop-in {
    0%   { transform: scale(0.5);  opacity: 0; }
    70%  { transform: scale(1.06); opacity: 1; }
    100% { transform: scale(1);    opacity: 1; }
  }
  @keyframes fx-pop-out {
    0%   { transform: scale(1);   opacity: 1; }
    100% { transform: scale(0.5); opacity: 0; }
  }
  @keyframes fx-warp-in {
    0%   { transform: scaleX(0.1) scaleY(2.5); opacity: 0; }
    60%  { transform: scaleX(1.05) scaleY(0.97); opacity: 1; }
    100% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; }
  }
  @keyframes fx-warp-out {
    0%   { transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; }
    100% { transform: scaleX(0.1) scaleY(2.5); opacity: 0; }
  }
  @keyframes fx-rubber-in {
    0%   { transform: scale(1);           opacity: 0; }
    30%  { transform: scaleX(1.25) scaleY(0.75); opacity: 1; }
    50%  { transform: scaleX(0.85) scaleY(1.15); }
    70%  { transform: scaleX(1.05) scaleY(0.95); }
    100% { transform: scale(1); }
  }
  @keyframes fx-rubber-out {
    0%   { transform: scale(1);           opacity: 1; }
    30%  { transform: scaleX(1.25) scaleY(0.75); }
    100% { transform: scale(0.1); opacity: 0; }
  }
  @keyframes fx-flip-in {
    0%   { transform: perspective(600px) rotateY(-90deg); opacity: 0; }
    70%  { transform: perspective(600px) rotateY(8deg);  opacity: 1; }
    100% { transform: perspective(600px) rotateY(0deg);  opacity: 1; }
  }
  @keyframes fx-flip-out {
    0%   { transform: perspective(600px) rotateY(0deg);   opacity: 1; }
    100% { transform: perspective(600px) rotateY(90deg);  opacity: 0; }
  }
  @keyframes fx-splat-in {
    0%   { transform: scale(2.5); opacity: 0; filter: blur(12px); }
    60%  { transform: scale(0.95); opacity: 1; filter: blur(0); }
    100% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; filter: blur(0); }
  }
  @keyframes fx-splat-out {
    0%   { transform: scale(1);   opacity: 1; filter: blur(0); }
    100% { transform: scale(2.5); opacity: 0; filter: blur(12px); }
  }
  @keyframes fx-spindrop-in {
    0%   { transform: rotate(-180deg) scale(0); opacity: 0; }
    70%  { transform: rotate(10deg) scale(1.04); opacity: 1; }
    100% { transform: rotate(0deg) scale(1); opacity: 1; }
  }
  @keyframes fx-spindrop-out {
    0%   { transform: rotate(0deg) scale(1); opacity: 1; }
    100% { transform: rotate(180deg) scale(0); opacity: 0; }
  }

  .fx-pop-in      { animation: fx-pop-in      0.7s cubic-bezier(.22,.68,0,1.36) both; }
  .fx-pop-out     { animation: fx-pop-out     0.45s ease-in both; }
  .fx-warp-in     { animation: fx-warp-in     0.75s cubic-bezier(.22,.68,0,1.2)  both; }
  .fx-warp-out    { animation: fx-warp-out    0.45s ease-in both; }
  .fx-rubber-in   { animation: fx-rubber-in   0.9s ease both; }
  .fx-rubber-out  { animation: fx-rubber-out  0.45s ease-in both; }
  .fx-flip-in     { animation: fx-flip-in     0.75s ease both; }
  .fx-flip-out    { animation: fx-flip-out    0.45s ease-in both; }
  .fx-splat-in    { animation: fx-splat-in    0.85s cubic-bezier(.22,.68,0,1.2)  both; }
  .fx-splat-out   { animation: fx-splat-out   0.45s ease-in both; }
  .fx-spindrop-in { animation: fx-spindrop-in 0.85s cubic-bezier(.22,.68,0,1.36) both; }
  .fx-spindrop-out{ animation: fx-spindrop-out 0.45s ease-in both; }

  @media (max-width: 767px) {
    #gallery-popup-inner {
      max-width: 95vw;
      max-height: 70dvh;
    }
    #gallery-popup-img {
      max-width: 95vw;
      max-height: 70dvh;
    }
  }
</style>

<style>
  /* ══ WRAPPER ══ */
  .stage-wrap { width: 100%; max-width: 100%; overflow-x: clip; }

  .stage-back {
    max-width: var(--container-max, 1200px);
    margin-inline: auto;
    padding: 1.5rem var(--container-pad-x, 1.25rem) 0;
  }

  /* ══ STAGE PAGE HEADER ══ */
  .sph {
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-align: center;
    padding: clamp(3.5rem, 8vw, 6rem) var(--container-pad-x, 1.25rem) clamp(3rem, 6vw, 4.5rem);
    background:
      radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 0%, rgba(6, 214, 255, 0.10) 0%, transparent 60%),
      radial-gradient(ellipse at 20% 50%, rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.05) 0%, transparent 50%),
      radial-gradient(ellipse at 80% 50%, rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.05) 0%, transparent 50%);
  }

  .sph-lines {
    position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; z-index: 1;
    background: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, transparent 0px, transparent 2px, rgba(0,0,0,0.05) 2px, rgba(0,0,0,0.05) 3px);
  }

  .sph-beams { position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; z-index: 0; overflow: hidden; }

  .sph-beam {
    position: absolute; top: 0;
    width: 140px; height: 100%;
    transform-origin: 50% 0%;
    clip-path: polygon(25% 0%, 75% 0%, 100% 100%, 0% 100%);
  }

  .b1 { left: 3%; background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(6,214,255,0.20), transparent 80%); transform: rotate(-16deg); animation: beam-flicker 5s ease-in-out infinite; }
  .b2 { left: 22%; background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(245,166,35,0.11), transparent 80%); transform: rotate(-6deg); animation: beam-flicker 7s ease-in-out infinite 1.2s; }
  .b3 { left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(255,255,255,0.07), transparent 70%); animation: beam-flicker 8s ease-in-out infinite 2.8s; }
  .b4 { right: 22%; left: auto; background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(245,166,35,0.11), transparent 80%); transform: rotate(6deg); animation: beam-flicker 7s ease-in-out infinite 0.6s; }
  .b5 { right: 3%; left: auto; background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(6,214,255,0.20), transparent 80%); transform: rotate(16deg); animation: beam-flicker 5s ease-in-out infinite 1.8s; }

  @keyframes beam-flicker {
    0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
    35% { opacity: 0.55; }
    65% { opacity: 0.90; }
  }

  .sph-content { position: relative; z-index: 2; max-width: 56ch; margin-inline: auto; }

  .sph-eyebrow {
    display: inline-block;
    font-size: 0.60rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.28em; text-transform: uppercase;
    color: rgba(6,214,255,0.82); margin-bottom: 0.85rem;
    padding: 0.3em 1em; border: 1px solid rgba(6,214,255,0.22); border-radius: 999px;
    background: rgba(6,214,255,0.06);
  }

  .sph-title {
    font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
    font-size: clamp(2.4rem, 6vw, 4.5rem); font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #ffffff;
    line-height: 1; margin: 0 0 1.1rem;
    text-shadow: 0 0 50px rgba(6,214,255,0.25), 0 2px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
  }

  .sph-sub {
    font-size: clamp(0.82rem, 1.4vw, 0.96rem);
    color: rgba(180,205,240,0.72); line-height: 1.65; margin: 0;
  }

  .sph-floor {
    position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 80px;
    background: linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent, rgba(0,0,0,0.22));
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  /* ══ SECTION LABEL ══ */
  .stage-section {
    padding-block: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 3rem);
    padding-inline: var(--container-pad-x, 1.25rem);
    max-width: var(--container-max, 1200px);
    margin-inline: auto; box-sizing: border-box;
    overflow-x: clip;
    scroll-margin-top: 1.5rem;
  }

  .stl-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1.25rem; margin-bottom: clamp(1.5rem, 3.5vw, 2.5rem); }

  .stl-line {
    flex: 1; height: 1px;
    background: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, rgba(6,214,255,0.45));
  }
  .stl-line--r {
    background: linear-gradient(to left, transparent, rgba(6,214,255,0.45));
  }

  .stl-center {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.55rem;
    padding: 0.4rem 1.25rem;
    border: 1px solid rgba(6,214,255,0.22); border-radius: 6px;
    background: rgba(6,214,255,0.04); white-space: nowrap;
  }

  .stl-icon { color: rgba(6,214,255,0.75); flex-shrink: 0; }

  .stl-text {
    font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif; font-size: 0.65rem; font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(6,214,255,0.85);
  }

  /* ══ GRIDS ══ */
  .ac-grid { display: grid; gap: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 1.5rem); min-width: 0; }
  .ac-grid--duo { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
  .ac-grid--trio { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
  .ac-grid--auto { grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(260px, 1fr)); }

  @media (max-width: 1023px) { .ac-grid--trio { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); } }
  @media (max-width: 767px) {
    /* Pe telefoane (ex: Samsung A56), o singură coloană păstrează
       încadrarea corectă a imaginilor și evită cardurile înghesuite. */
    .ac-grid--duo, .ac-grid--trio, .ac-grid--auto { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  }
  @media (max-width: 480px) {
    .ac-grid--duo, .ac-grid--trio, .ac-grid--auto { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  }

  /* ══ ARTIST CARD ══ */
  .member-card-wrap {
    position: relative;
    max-width: 100%;
    overflow-x: clip;
    --card-neon: rgba(6, 214, 255, 0.86);
    --card-neon-soft: rgba(6, 214, 255, 0.42);
  }

  .member-card-wrap::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: -28px;
    z-index: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
    border-radius: 1.35rem;
    background:
      radial-gradient(circle at 50% 18%, var(--card-neon) 0%, transparent 44%),
      radial-gradient(circle at 50% 88%, var(--card-neon-soft) 0%, transparent 62%);
    filter: blur(28px) saturate(1.35);
    mix-blend-mode: screen;
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(6px) scale(1);
    animation: card-neon-breathe 2.8s ease-in-out infinite;
    transition: opacity 320ms ease, transform 380ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), filter 320ms ease;
  }

  @keyframes card-neon-breathe {
    0%, 100% { opacity: 0.85; filter: blur(26px) saturate(1.22); }
    50% { opacity: 1; filter: blur(32px) saturate(1.42); }
  }

  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .member-card-wrap:hover::before {
      opacity: 1;
      filter: blur(34px) saturate(1.5);
      transform: translateY(3px) scale(1.03);
    }
  }

  .member-card-wrap:nth-child(6n + 1) { --card-neon: rgba(0, 224, 255, 0.92); --card-neon-soft: rgba(0, 224, 255, 0.50); }
  .member-card-wrap:nth-child(6n + 2) { --card-neon: rgba(255, 210, 74, 0.92); --card-neon-soft: rgba(255, 210, 74, 0.50); }
  .member-card-wrap:nth-child(6n + 3) { --card-neon: rgba(255, 106, 186, 0.92); --card-neon-soft: rgba(255, 106, 186, 0.50); }
  .member-card-wrap:nth-child(6n + 4) { --card-neon: rgba(167, 112, 255, 0.92); --card-neon-soft: rgba(167, 112, 255, 0.50); }
  .member-card-wrap:nth-child(6n + 5) { --card-neon: rgba(82, 255, 166, 0.92); --card-neon-soft: rgba(82, 255, 166, 0.50); }
  .member-card-wrap:nth-child(6n + 6) { --card-neon: rgba(255, 134, 66, 0.92); --card-neon-soft: rgba(255, 134, 66, 0.50); }

  .ac {
    position: relative; aspect-ratio: 2 / 3;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 100%;
    border-radius: 1.1rem; overflow: hidden; cursor: pointer;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.10);
    background:
      linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(7, 18, 42, 0.80) 0%, rgba(3, 10, 25, 0.90) 100%);
    box-shadow:
      0 14px 36px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45),
      0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--card-neon) 65%, transparent),
      0 0 24px color-mix(in srgb, var(--card-neon) 75%, transparent),
      0 0 56px color-mix(in srgb, var(--card-neon-soft) 92%, transparent),
      inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07),
      inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
    transition: transform 380ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), border-color 380ms ease, box-shadow 380ms ease;
    isolation: isolate;
    z-index: 1;
  }

  .ac::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    z-index: 3;
    pointer-events: none;
    border-radius: inherit;
    border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--card-neon) 88%, white 12%);
    opacity: 1;
    transition: opacity 320ms ease, box-shadow 320ms ease, border-color 320ms ease;
    box-shadow:
      inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--card-neon) 40%, transparent),
      0 0 20px color-mix(in srgb, var(--card-neon) 65%, transparent);
  }

  .ac::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: -45% auto auto -60%;
    width: 56%;
    height: 190%;
    transform: rotate(17deg);
    z-index: 4;
    pointer-events: none;
    background: linear-gradient(
      90deg,
      transparent 0%,
      rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.00) 25%,
      rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15) 50%,
      rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.00) 75%,
      transparent 100%
    );
    opacity: 0;
    transition: transform 600ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), opacity 420ms ease;
  }

  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .ac:hover {
      transform: translateY(-6px) scale(1.012);
      border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--card-neon) 90%, white 10%);
      box-shadow:
        0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--card-neon) 70%, transparent),
        0 0 34px color-mix(in srgb, var(--card-neon) 78%, transparent),
        0 0 76px color-mix(in srgb, var(--card-neon-soft) 96%, transparent),
        0 18px 55px rgba(0,0,0,0.42);
    }

    .ac:hover::after {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translateX(170%) rotate(17deg);
    }

    .ac:hover::before {
      border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--card-neon) 90%, white 10%);
      box-shadow:
        inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--card-neon) 70%, transparent),
        0 0 28px color-mix(in srgb, var(--card-neon) 90%, transparent),
        0 0 52px color-mix(in srgb, var(--card-neon-soft) 96%, transparent);
    }
  }

  .ac:focus-within { outline: 2px solid rgba(6,214,255,0.65); outline-offset: 3px; }

  /* ── Photos ── */
  .ac-photos {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    border-radius: inherit;
    background: rgba(4, 10, 25, 0.72);
  }

  .ac-photo {
    position: absolute; inset: 0;
    width: 100%; height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover; object-position: center top;
    opacity: 0;
    border-radius: inherit;
    clip-path: inset(0 round inherit);
    transition: opacity 900ms ease;
  }

  .ac-photo.is-active {
    opacity: 1;
    animation: ac-kenburns 12s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
  }

  @keyframes ac-kenburns {
    0%   { transform: scale(1.04) translate(0%, 0%); }
    50%  { transform: scale(1.09) translate(-1.2%, -0.6%); }
    100% { transform: scale(1.04) translate(1.2%, 0.6%); }
  }

  .ac-photo[src*="oprea-marian"]     { object-position: center 5%; }      /* portret inalt -> cap sus */
  .ac-photo[src*="catalin-matei"]    { object-position: center 15%; }     /* portret standard */
  .ac-photo[src*="cristian-ograbek"] { object-position: center 42%; }     /* acordeon -> urca usor cadrul */
  .ac-photo[src*="Claudiu%201.jpg"],
  .ac-photo[src*="Claudiu 1.jpg"]    { object-position: center 44%; }     /* URL encoded + ne-encoded */
  .ac-photo[src*="Florentina Pan"]   { object-position: center top; }    /* portret standard */
  .ac-photo[src*="Alexia"]           { object-position: center top; }    /* headshot → cap în vârf */
  .ac-photo[data-slide]              { object-position: center top; }    /* cycling slides → cap sus */

  /* ── Placeholder ── */
  .ac-ph {
    position: absolute; inset: 0;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;

  .ac-ph-light {
    position: absolute; top: -30%; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
    width: 160%; height: 160%;
    background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 0%, rgba(6,214,255,0.14) 0%, transparent 55%);
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  .ac-initials {
    font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
    font-size: clamp(3.5rem, 8vw, 5.5rem); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e8c85b 0%, #fff3a0 55%, #e8c85b 100%);
    -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
    filter: drop-shadow(0 0 20px rgba(232,200,91,0.40));
    line-height: 1;
  }

  /* ── Atmosphere overlays ── */
  .ac-scanlines {
    position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; z-index: 1;
    background: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, transparent 0px, transparent 2px, rgba(0,0,0,0.04) 2px, rgba(0,0,0,0.04) 3px);
  }

  .ac-grad {
    position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; z-index: 2;
    background: linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent 0%, transparent 22%, rgba(0,2,12,0.22) 52%, rgba(0,2,12,0.90) 80%, rgba(0,2,12,0.97) 100%);
  }

  .ac--solist .ac-grad {
    background:
      radial-gradient(circle at 50% 18%, rgba(232, 200, 91, 0.12) 0%, transparent 36%),
      linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent 0%, transparent 20%, rgba(0,2,12,0.22) 52%, rgba(0,2,12,0.90) 80%, rgba(0,2,12,0.97) 100%);
  }

  .ac--instr .ac-grad {
    background:
      radial-gradient(circle at 50% 18%, rgba(6, 214, 255, 0.13) 0%, transparent 36%),
      linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent 0%, transparent 20%, rgba(0,2,12,0.22) 52%, rgba(0,2,12,0.90) 80%, rgba(0,2,12,0.97) 100%);
  }

  .ac--colab .ac-grad {
    background:
      radial-gradient(circle at 50% 18%, rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.12) 0%, transparent 36%),
      linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent 0%, transparent 20%, rgba(0,2,12,0.22) 52%, rgba(0,2,12,0.90) 80%, rgba(0,2,12,0.97) 100%);
  }

  .ac-beam {
    position: absolute; top: -20%; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
    width: 70%; height: 90%;
    clip-path: polygon(28% 0%, 72% 0%, 100% 100%, 0% 100%);
    pointer-events: none; z-index: 1;
    opacity: 0; transition: opacity 500ms ease;
  }

  .ac--solist .ac-beam { background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(255,230,80,0.14), transparent); }
  .ac--instr  .ac-beam { background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(6,214,255,0.14), transparent); }
  .ac--colab  .ac-beam { background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(168,85,247,0.14), transparent); }

  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) { .ac:hover .ac-beam { opacity: 1; } }

  /* ── Top badge row ── */
  .ac-top {
    position: absolute; top: 0.85rem; left: 0.85rem; right: 0.85rem;
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.45rem; flex-wrap: wrap; z-index: 5;
  }

  .ac-badge {
    font-size: 0.52rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase;
    padding: 0.25em 0.75em; border-radius: 999px;
  }

  .ac-b--solist { background: rgba(232,200,91,0.14); color: rgba(255,240,160,0.95); border: 1px solid rgba(232,200,91,0.35); }
  .ac-b--instr  { background: rgba(6,214,255,0.10);  color: rgba(100,240,255,0.95); border: 1px solid rgba(6,214,255,0.28); }
  .ac-b--colab  { background: rgba(168,85,247,0.12); color: rgba(210,160,255,0.95); border: 1px solid rgba(168,85,247,0.30); }

  .ac-star {
    font-size: 0.50rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: rgba(255,230,120,0.80);
    background: rgba(255,200,50,0.08); border: 1px solid rgba(255,200,50,0.20);
    padding: 0.22em 0.65em; border-radius: 999px;
  }

  .ac-instr-pill {
    font-size: 0.50rem; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: rgba(100,240,255,0.80);
    background: rgba(6,214,255,0.08); border: 1px solid rgba(6,214,255,0.20);
    padding: 0.22em 0.65em; border-radius: 999px;
  }

  /* ── Bottom content ── */
  .ac-body {
    position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
    padding: 1.1rem 3.8rem 1.1rem 1.1rem;
    z-index: 5; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.32rem;
    backdrop-filter: blur(3px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(3px);
  }

  .ac-spec {
    font-size: 0.68rem; letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    color: rgba(160,200,240,0.80); font-style: italic; margin: 0; line-height: 1.4;
  }

  .ac-name {
    font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
    font-size: clamp(1.1rem, 2.2vw, 1.6rem); font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: #ffffff; margin: 0; line-height: 1.1;
    text-shadow: 0 2px 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.65);
    transition: transform 380ms ease;
  }

  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) { .ac:hover .ac-name { transform: translateY(-2px); } }

  /* ── Hover reveal (citat + gallery) ── */
  .ac-reveal {
    overflow: hidden; max-height: 0; opacity: 0; transform: translateY(8px);
    transition: max-height 480ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), opacity 380ms ease 80ms, transform 380ms ease 80ms;
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.55rem;
  }

  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .ac:hover .ac-reveal { max-height: 280px; opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
  }

  .ac-citat { margin: 0; padding-left: 0.65rem; border-left: 2px solid rgba(6,214,255,0.55); }
  .ac--solist .ac-citat { border-left-color: rgba(232,200,91,0.60); }
  .ac--colab  .ac-citat { border-left-color: rgba(168,85,247,0.60); }

  .ac-citat p {
    font-size: 0.70rem; font-style: italic; color: rgba(200,225,255,0.82); line-height: 1.55; margin: 0;
  }

  .ac-strip { display: flex; gap: 0.35rem; flex-wrap: nowrap; overflow: hidden; }

  .ac-th {
    flex: 0 0 52px; width: 52px; height: 52px; border-radius: 0.4rem; overflow: hidden;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.14); padding: 0; cursor: pointer;
    background: transparent; transition: border-color 200ms, transform 200ms;
  }

  .ac-th img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; display: block; }

  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .ac-th:hover { border-color: rgba(6,214,255,0.70); transform: scale(1.1); }
  }

  /* ══ BIO BUTTON ══ */
  @keyframes bio-pulse {
    0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(0,200,255,0.60); }
    50%       { box-shadow: 0 0 0 10px rgba(0,200,255,0.00); }
  }

  .bio-btn {
    position: absolute; bottom: 0.85rem; right: 0.85rem;
    width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 50%;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00c8ff 0%, #0066ff 100%);
    border: none; cursor: pointer;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    color: #ffffff;
    animation: bio-pulse 2.2s ease-in-out infinite;
    transition: background 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1), transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1);
    z-index: 10;
  }

  .bio-btn:hover { transform: scale(1.14); }

  .ac--solist .bio-btn {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f0d77a 0%, #b88a17 100%);
    box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(232, 200, 91, 0.40);
  }

  .ac--instr .bio-btn {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00dcff 0%, #006dff 100%);
    box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(6, 214, 255, 0.40);
  }

  .ac--colab .bio-btn {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #bb82ff 0%, #6a2fcb 100%);
    box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.40);
  }

  .bio-btn.active {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ff4060 0%, #cc0033 100%);
    animation: none; transform: rotate(45deg) scale(1.08);
  }

  .bio-btn-text { font-size: 0.62rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; pointer-events: none; }
  .bio-btn.active .bio-btn-text::before { content: '×'; font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0; }
  .bio-btn.active .bio-btn-text { font-size: 0; }

  /* ══ BIO PANEL ══ */
  .bio-panel {
    max-height: 0; overflow: hidden; opacity: 0;
    transform: scaleY(0.85) translateY(-10px); transform-origin: top center;
    background: rgba(4,12,32,0.72);
    border: 1px solid rgba(0,200,255,0.18); border-top: none;
    border-radius: 0 0 1.1rem 1.1rem; padding: 0 1.75rem;
    transition:
      max-height 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1),
      opacity    0.35s ease,
      transform  0.5s cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1),
      padding    0.35s ease;
  }

  .bio-panel.open {
    max-height: 1000px; opacity: 1;
    transform: scaleY(1) translateY(0);
    padding: 1.5rem 1.75rem 2rem;
  }

  @media (max-width: 767px) { .bio-panel.open { padding: 1.25rem 1.25rem 1.5rem; } }

  .bio-quote { margin: 0 0 1rem; padding-left: 1rem; border-left: 3px solid rgba(0,200,255,0.65); }
  .bio-quote p { font-size: clamp(0.88rem, 1.1vw, 0.98rem); font-style: italic; color: rgba(180,215,255,0.85); line-height: 1.75; margin: 0; }

  .bio-text { font-size: clamp(0.85rem, 1.1vw, 0.95rem); line-height: 1.82; color: rgba(210,225,245,0.85); margin: 0 0 1rem; }

  .bio-tags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.4rem; }

  .bio-tag {
    font-size: 0.60rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.10em; text-transform: uppercase;
    padding: 0.26em 0.75em; border-radius: 9999px;
    background: rgba(0,200,255,0.08); color: rgba(0,220,255,0.75); border: 1px solid rgba(0,200,255,0.20);
  }

  /* ══ SCROLL HINT ══ */
  .scroll-hint-wrap { display: flex; justify-content: center; padding: 0.75rem 0 0; }

  .scroll-hint-btn {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem;
    padding: 0.4rem 1.1rem 0.4rem 1.2rem; border-radius: 9999px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(6,214,255,0.25); background: rgba(6,214,255,0.06);
    color: rgba(160,230,255,0.85); text-decoration: none;
    font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase;
    transition: background 200ms, border-color 200ms, color 200ms;
  }

  .scroll-hint-btn:hover { background: rgba(6,214,255,0.14); border-color: rgba(6,214,255,0.5); color: #fff; }

  .scroll-hint-arrow { animation: bounce-down 1.6s ease-in-out infinite; }

  @keyframes bounce-down {
    0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); }
    50%       { transform: translateY(4px); }
  }

  /* ══ MOBILE ══ */
  @media (max-width: 1024px) {
    .ac {
      aspect-ratio: auto;
      min-height: unset;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      border-radius: 1.45rem;
    }

    .ac-photos {
      position: relative;
      inset: auto;
      width: 100%;
      aspect-ratio: 4 / 5;
      min-height: clamp(260px, 58vw, 360px);
      flex: none;
      border-radius: 1.45rem 1.45rem 0 0;
      background: rgba(4, 10, 25, 0.72);
    }

    .ac-body {
      position: relative;
      left: auto;
      right: auto;
      bottom: auto;
      padding: 0.9rem 3.6rem 0.95rem 0.9rem;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(4, 10, 25, 0.14), rgba(4, 10, 25, 0.9));
      border-radius: 0 0 1.45rem 1.45rem;
    }

    .ac-name {
      line-height: 1.15;
      text-shadow: none;
    }

    .ac::after {
      opacity: 0.65;
      transform: translateX(95%) rotate(17deg);
    }

    .member-card-wrap::before {
      inset: -12px;
      opacity: 1;
      filter: blur(22px) saturate(1.35);
      transform: translateY(4px) scale(1);
    }

    .ac-spec {
      line-height: 1.5;
    }

    .ac-photo {
      pointer-events: none;
      border-radius: inherit;
      clip-path: inset(0 round inherit);
    }

    .ac-photos,
    .ac-ph,
    .ac-scanlines,
    .ac-grad,
    .ac-beam {
      border-radius: inherit;
    }

    .ac-beam {
      clip-path: inset(0 round 1.45rem 1.45rem 0 0);
    }
  }

  @media (max-width: 767px) {
    :global(html) {
      scrollbar-width: none !important;
      scrollbar-color: transparent transparent !important;
    }

    :global(body.page-shell) {
      scrollbar-width: none !important;
      -ms-overflow-style: none !important;
      scrollbar-color: transparent transparent !important;
    }

    :global(main#continut),
    :global(#continut) {
      scrollbar-width: none !important;
      -ms-overflow-style: none !important;
      scrollbar-color: transparent transparent !important;
    }

    :global(html::-webkit-scrollbar) {
      display: none !important;
      width: 0 !important;
      height: 0 !important;
    }

    :global(body.page-shell::-webkit-scrollbar) {
      display: none !important;
      width: 0 !important;
      height: 0 !important;
    }

    :global(main#continut::-webkit-scrollbar),
    :global(#continut::-webkit-scrollbar) {
      display: none !important;
      width: 0 !important;
      height: 0 !important;
    }

    .ac-photos {
      aspect-ratio: 3 / 4;
      min-height: clamp(280px, 68vw, 420px);
    }

    .ac,
    .ac-photos,
    .ac-body,
    .bio-panel {
      border-radius: 1.35rem;
    }

    .stage-wrap,
    .stage-section,
    .ac-grid,
    .member-card-wrap,
    .ac,
    .bio-panel {
      max-width: 100%;
      overflow-x: hidden;
    }

    .member-card-wrap,
    .ac,
    .ac-photos,
    .bio-btn,
    .gallery-thumb {
      touch-action: pan-y pinch-zoom;
    }

    .ac-body {
      padding: 0.85rem 3.15rem 0.9rem 0.85rem;
    }

    .ac-photo {
      touch-action: pan-y pinch-zoom;
    }

    /* Pe telefon eliminam drift-ul lateral ca subiectul sa nu "iasa" din cadru. */
    .ac-photo.is-active {
      animation: ac-kenburns-mobile 10s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
    }

    .ac-photo[src*="cristian-ograbek"],
    .ac-photo[src*="Claudiu%201.jpg"],
    .ac-photo[src*="Claudiu 1.jpg"],
    .ac-photo[src*="catalin-matei"],
    .ac-photo[src*="oprea-marian"] {
      object-position: center 36%;
    }

    .ac-photo[src*="oprea-marian"] {
      object-position: center 12%;
    }

    .ac-name { font-size: clamp(0.95rem, 4vw, 1.25rem); }
    .bio-btn { width: 44px; height: 44px; bottom: 0.7rem; right: 0.7rem; }

    .ac::before {
      opacity: 0.6;
    }

    .member-card-wrap::before {
      inset: -8px;
      opacity: 0.14;
      filter: blur(10px) saturate(1.08);
      transform: translateY(0) scale(1);
    }
  }

  @keyframes ac-kenburns-mobile {
    0%   { transform: scale(1.03) translate(0%, 0%); }
    50%  { transform: scale(1.06) translate(0%, -0.45%); }
    100% { transform: scale(1.03) translate(0%, 0.45%); }
  }
</style>
```
