### src/pages/momente-cu-mirii.astro
```astro
---
import BaseLayout from '../layouts/BaseLayout.astro';
import siteContent from '../data/siteContent.json';
import BackButton from '../components/BackButton.astro';
import { query as dbQuery } from '../lib/db.js';

const { realMoments, brand } = siteContent;

export const prerender = false;

let dbMomentPhotos: Array<{
  id: number;
  titlu: string;
  imagine_url: string;
  data_upload: string;
}> = [];

try {
  const rows = (await dbQuery(
    `SELECT id, titlu, imagine_url, data_upload
     FROM gallery
     WHERE imagine_url LIKE '/uploads/%'
     ORDER BY data_upload DESC, id DESC
     LIMIT 60`,
  )) as Array<{ id: number; titlu: string; imagine_url: string; data_upload: string }>;

  dbMomentPhotos = rows.filter((row) => typeof row.imagine_url === 'string' && row.imagine_url.startsWith('/uploads/'));
} catch (error) {
  console.error('Nu s-au putut citi pozele pentru galeria completă:', error);
}

const hasDbMomentPhotos = dbMomentPhotos.length > 0;

const SITE_FALLBACK = 'https://florentinapanaofficial.ro';
const site = Astro.site?.toString().replace(/\/$/, '') ?? SITE_FALLBACK;

const eventsJsonLd = realMoments.events
  .filter((ev: any) => ev.startDate)
  .map((ev: any) => {
    const validEventStatuses = new Set([
      'https://schema.org/EventScheduled',
      'https://schema.org/EventCancelled',
      'https://schema.org/EventPostponed',
      'https://schema.org/EventRescheduled',
      'https://schema.org/EventMovedOnline',
    ]);
    const normalizedEventStatus = validEventStatuses.has(ev.eventStatus)
      ? ev.eventStatus
      : 'https://schema.org/EventScheduled';
    const isCompleted = Boolean(ev.endDate && new Date(ev.endDate).getTime() < Date.now());
    return {
      '@context': 'https://schema.org',
      '@type': 'MusicEvent',
      name: ev.title,
      description: ev.description || `Eveniment live cu ${brand.name} — ${ev.couple}, ${ev.city}`,
      startDate: ev.startDate,
      ...(ev.endDate && { endDate: ev.endDate }),
      eventStatus: normalizedEventStatus,
      eventAttendanceMode: 'https://schema.org/OfflineEventAttendanceMode',
      location: {
        '@type': 'Place',
        name: ev.locationName || `Salon Evenimente ${ev.city}`,
        address: {
          '@type': 'PostalAddress',
          addressLocality: ev.city,
          addressCountry: 'RO',
          ...(ev.locationAddress && { streetAddress: ev.locationAddress }),
        },
      },
      ...(ev.image && {
        image: ev.image.startsWith('http') ? ev.image : `${site}${ev.image}`,
      }),
      performer: {
        '@type': 'MusicGroup',
        name: brand.name,
        url: site,
      },
      organizer: {
        '@type': 'MusicGroup',
        name: brand.name,
        url: site,
      },
      ...(!isCompleted && {
        offers: {
          '@type': 'Offer',
          url: `${site}/contact`,
          availability: 'https://schema.org/InStock',
          priceCurrency: 'RON',
          price: '0',
          validFrom: ev.startDate,
          description: 'Contactați-ne pentru ofertă personalizată',
        },
      }),
    };
  });


---

<BaseLayout title={`Momente cu Mirii — Album Foto Nunți Pitești, Argeș | ${brand.name}`} description="Album foto cu mirii și trupa la nunți în Pitești, Argeș și Muntenia. Formație nuntă profesionistă — cele mai frumoase momente live de la evenimentele Formației Florentina Pană.">
  <Fragment slot="head">
    {eventsJsonLd.map((eventSchema: any) => (
      <script is:inline type="application/ld+json" set:html={JSON.stringify(eventSchema)} />
    ))}
    <link rel="preload" as="style" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,600;0,700;1,300;1,400&display=swap" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,600;0,700;1,300;1,400&display=swap" data-async-css />
    <script is:inline>
      // Activează CSS-ul asincron după ce s-a încărcat — echivalent cu media="print" onload="this.media='all'"
      document.querySelectorAll('link[data-async-css]').forEach((l) => { l.media = 'all'; });
    </script>
    <noscript><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,600;0,700;1,300;1,400&display=swap" /></noscript>
  </Fragment>
  <!-- Overlay cer la apus — inutilă în afara dialogului, mutată înăuntru -->
  <section class="section-container pt-6 pb-16" id="momente-reale">
    <div class="mb-4"><BackButton href="/" label="Acasă" /></div>
    <header class="section-head mx-auto text-center">
      <p class="kicker mx-auto">Galerie specială</p>
      <h1 class="section-title">Momente Speciale cu Mirii — Formație Nuntă Pitești și Argeș</h1>
      <p class="section-copy">Album în format landscape, cu pagini stânga-dreapta ca o foaie A4 pe orizontală, ideal pentru cadre largi cu mirii și trupa.</p>
    </header>

    <div class="mt-5 flex flex-wrap justify-center gap-2">
      <span class="rounded-full border border-white/20 bg-white/10 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-cyan-100">
        {hasDbMomentPhotos ? `${dbMomentPhotos.length}+` : realMoments.stats.events} cadre
      </span>
    </div>

    <!-- ─── Couple Cards ────────────────────────────────────────────── -->
    <div class="couple-cards-section">
      <header class="couple-cards-section-head">
        <p class="kicker mx-auto">Poveștile lor</p>
        <h2 class="section-title text-2xl md:text-3xl">Poveștile care ne-au umplut inima — nunți în Argeș și România</h2>
      </header>

      <div class="couple-cards-grid">
        {realMoments.events.map((event, idx) => {
          const isAboveFold = idx < 3;
          return (
            <article
              class="couple-card"
              data-couple-search={`${event.couple} ${event.city} ${event.date}`.toLowerCase()}
              style={`--cc:${(event as any).accentColor ?? '#f5a623'};--cc-glow:${(event as any).accentGlow ?? 'rgba(245,166,35,0.28)'}`}
            >
              {/* Etaj 1 — fotografia (click → lightbox cu petale + cer) */}
              {event.image && event.image.trim() !== '' ? (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  class="cc-photo"
                  data-lightbox-src={event.image}
                  data-lightbox-alt={event.couple}
                  data-lightbox-caption={`${event.couple} \u2022 ${event.city} \u2022 ${event.date}`}
                  data-lightbox-audio={event.audioUrl ?? ''}
                  data-lightbox-quote={event.coupleQuote ?? ''}
                  aria-label={`Deschide fotografia ${event.couple}`}
                >
                  <img src={event.image} alt={event.couple} loading={isAboveFold ? "eager" : "lazy"} decoding="async" width="600" height="400" fetchpriority={isAboveFold ? "high" : "auto"} />
                  <div class="cc-name-overlay">
                    <span class="cc-name">{event.couple}</span>
                    <span class="cc-meta">{event.city} &bull; {event.date}</span>
                  </div>
                </button>
              ) : (
                <div class="cc-photo cc-photo--placeholder" aria-label={event.couple}>
                  <div class="cc-ph-initials">{event.couple.split(' & ').map(n => n[0]).join('&')}</div>
                  <span class="cc-ph-label">Foto în curând</span>
                  <div class="cc-name-overlay">
                    <span class="cc-name">{event.couple}</span>
                    <span class="cc-meta">{event.city} &bull; {event.date}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Etaj 2 — citat + link blog + link Dans Miri */}
              <div class="cc-footer">
                {event.coupleQuote && <p class="cc-quote">{event.coupleQuote}</p>}
                <div class="cc-links">
                  {(event as any).blogSlug && (
                    <a class="cc-link" href={`/blog/${(event as any).blogSlug}/`}>
                      Citește povestea lor &rarr;
                    </a>
                  )}
                  <span class="cc-link cc-link--dance cc-link--disabled">
                    Dansul Mirilor — în curând
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </article>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
    <!-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── -->

    <dialog id="photo-lightbox" class="photo-lightbox cinematic-lightbox">
      <!-- Cer la apus — înăuntrul dialogului, vizibil în top-layer -->
      <div id="sunset-overlay" aria-hidden="true"></div>
      <canvas id="lightbox-fireworks" class="lightbox-fireworks-canvas" aria-hidden="true"></canvas>
      <button type="button" class="lightbox-close-btn" data-lightbox-close aria-label="Închide galeria">✕</button>
      <div class="lightbox-stage">
        <button type="button" class="lightbox-nav-btn lightbox-nav-prev" data-lightbox-prev aria-label="Fotografia anterioară" disabled>&#8249;</button>
        <div class="lightbox-image-shell">
          <img id="photo-lightbox-image" src="" alt="" class="lightbox-image" />
        </div>
        <button type="button" class="lightbox-nav-btn lightbox-nav-next" data-lightbox-next aria-label="Fotografia următoare" disabled>&#8250;</button>
      </div>
      <p id="photo-lightbox-caption" class="lightbox-caption"></p>
      <div class="lightbox-size-selector" aria-label="Alege dimensiunea imaginii">
        <button type="button" class="lightbox-size-btn" data-lightbox-size-toggle>Preset: Normal</button>
      </div>
      <div class="lightbox-demo-sound-wrap">
        <button type="button" class="lightbox-demo-sound-btn" data-lightbox-demo-sound>Redă sunet demo</button>
      </div>
      <div class="lightbox-audio-wrap">
        <p id="photo-lightbox-audio-note" class="lightbox-audio-note hidden">Testimonial audio personalizat pentru această fotografie.</p>
        <button type="button" class="audio-play-btn" data-lightbox-audio-play aria-label="Redă testimonial audio">
          <span class="audio-icon" aria-hidden="true">
            <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
              <path d="M3 9V15H7L12 20V4L7 9H3Z" fill="#eaf4ff"/>
              <path d="M16.5 12C16.5 13.1046 15.6046 14 14.5 14V10C15.6046 10 16.5 10.8954 16.5 12Z" fill="#eaf4ff"/>
              <path d="M19 12C19 15.3137 16.3137 18 13 18V16C15.2091 16 17 14.2091 17 12C17 9.79086 15.2091 8 13 8V6C16.3137 6 19 8.68629 19 12Z" fill="#eaf4ff"/>
            </svg>
          </span>
        </button>
        <audio id="photo-lightbox-audio" class="lightbox-audio hidden" controls preload="none"></audio>
      </div>
      <blockquote id="photo-lightbox-quote" class="lightbox-quote hidden" role="presentation">
        <p class="lightbox-quote-text"></p>
      </blockquote>
      <div class="lightbox-blessing" role="contentinfo">
        <p class="lightbox-blessing-main">Formația Florentina Pană urează <strong>Casă de Piatră</strong> tinerilor căsătoriți! 💍</p>
        <div class="lightbox-blessing-admin" data-lightbox-blessing-extra>
          <!-- Administrator: adaugă mesajul personalizat aici -->
        </div>
      </div>
    </dialog>
  </section>

  <script is:inline>
    const lightbox = document.getElementById('photo-lightbox');
    const lightboxImage = document.getElementById('photo-lightbox-image');
    const lightboxCaption = document.getElementById('photo-lightbox-caption');
    const lightboxAudio = document.getElementById('photo-lightbox-audio');
    const lightboxAudioNote = document.getElementById('photo-lightbox-audio-note');
    const lightboxQuote = document.getElementById('photo-lightbox-quote');
    const rootElement = document.documentElement;
    const lightboxDemoSoundButton = document.querySelector('[data-lightbox-demo-sound]');
    const lightboxSizeToggleButton = document.querySelector('[data-lightbox-size-toggle]');

    const albumRoot = document.querySelector('[data-home-gallery-grid]');
    const filmStripTrack = /** @type {HTMLElement|null} */ (document.querySelector('[data-film-strip-track]'));
    const albumPrevButton = document.querySelector('[data-album-prev]');
    const albumNextButton = document.querySelector('[data-album-next]');
    const albumIndicator = document.querySelector('[data-album-indicator]');
    const albumSearchInput = document.querySelector('[data-album-search-input]');
    const albumSearchButton = document.querySelector('[data-album-search-button]');
    const albumSearchClearButton = document.querySelector('[data-album-search-clear]');
    const albumSearchResult = document.querySelector('[data-album-search-result]');

    const sizePresetStorageKey = 'fp-lightbox-size-preset';
    const rawAlbumPhotos = albumRoot?.getAttribute('data-album-photos') ?? '[]';
    let allAlbumPhotos = [];
    let albumPhotos = [];

    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(rawAlbumPhotos);
      allAlbumPhotos = Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : [];
      albumPhotos = [...allAlbumPhotos];
    } catch {
      allAlbumPhotos = [];
      albumPhotos = [];
    }

    let activePhotoIndex = 0;
    let currentSearchTerm = '';
    let searchDebounceTimer = null;
    let currentSizePreset = window.localStorage.getItem(sizePresetStorageKey) || 'normal';
    let isClosingLightbox = false;
    let currentLightboxIndex = -1;
    let savedScrollY = 0;

    if (!['normal', 'large'].includes(currentSizePreset)) {
      currentSizePreset = 'normal';
    }

    const syncSizePresetUi = () => {
      if (!(lightbox instanceof HTMLElement)) return;

      lightbox.setAttribute('data-size-preset', currentSizePreset);

      if (!(lightboxSizeToggleButton instanceof HTMLButtonElement)) return;
      const isLarge = currentSizePreset === 'large';
      lightboxSizeToggleButton.textContent = isLarge ? 'Preset: Large (+10%)' : 'Preset: Normal';
      lightboxSizeToggleButton.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(isLarge));
    };

    syncSizePresetUi();

    if (lightboxAudio instanceof HTMLAudioElement) {
      lightboxAudio.addEventListener('error', () => {
        lightboxAudio.classList.add('hidden');
        if (lightboxAudioNote instanceof HTMLElement) {
          lightboxAudioNote.classList.add('hidden');
        }
      });
    }

    const playDemoSound = () => {
      const AudioContextClass = window.AudioContext || /** @type {any} */ (window).webkitAudioContext;
      if (!AudioContextClass) return;

      const audioContext = new AudioContextClass();
      const masterGain = audioContext.createGain();
      masterGain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.5, audioContext.currentTime);
      masterGain.connect(audioContext.destination);

      const sequence = [392, 523.25, 659.25, 523.25];
      sequence.forEach((frequency, index) => {
        const oscillator = audioContext.createOscillator();
        const gain = audioContext.createGain();
        const startAt = audioContext.currentTime + index * 0.16;
        const stopAt = startAt + 0.14;

        oscillator.type = 'triangle';
        oscillator.frequency.setValueAtTime(frequency, startAt);

        gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, startAt);
        gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.06, startAt + 0.03);
        gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, stopAt);

        oscillator.connect(gain);
        gain.connect(masterGain);
        oscillator.start(startAt);
        oscillator.stop(stopAt);
      });

      window.setTimeout(() => {
        audioContext.close().catch(() => {});
      }, 980);
    };

    const closeLightbox = () => {
      if (!lightbox || !lightbox.open) return;
      if (isClosingLightbox) return;

      isClosingLightbox = true;
      lightbox.classList.add('is-closing');

      window.setTimeout(() => {
        if (lightbox.open) {
          lightbox.close();
        }
      }, 380);
    };

    const lockPageScrollForLightbox = () => {
      savedScrollY = window.scrollY;
      document.body.style.top = `-${savedScrollY}px`;
      rootElement.classList.add('lightbox-open-lock');
      document.body.classList.add('lightbox-open-lock');
      // Cer la apus — fade in overlay
      const overlay = /** @type {HTMLElement|null} */ (document.getElementById('sunset-overlay'));
      if (overlay) overlay.style.opacity = '1';
    };

    const unlockPageScrollForLightbox = () => {
      rootElement.classList.remove('lightbox-open-lock');
      document.body.classList.remove('lightbox-open-lock');
      document.body.style.top = '';
      window.scrollTo({ top: savedScrollY, behavior: 'instant' });
      // Revenire la cer albastru
      const overlay = /** @type {HTMLElement|null} */ (document.getElementById('sunset-overlay'));
      if (overlay) overlay.style.opacity = '0';
    };

    // ── Petale Canvas 2D — generate programatic (bezier + gradient) ─────────
    const petalsCanvas = /** @type {HTMLCanvasElement|null} */ (document.getElementById('lightbox-fireworks'));
    let ptRafId    = null;
    const ptPetals = [];
    const PT_MAX   = 55;

    /**
     * Pre-renderează 4 variante de petală de trandafir pe câte un canvas mic.
     * Forma: curbe bezier care dau un oval alungit cu vârf, ca o petală reală.
     */
    const ptVariants = (() => {
      // [culoare bază R,G,B], highlight, vârf închis
      const defs = [
        { base: [210, 25, 55],  hi: [255, 160, 175] },  // roșu aprins
        { base: [185, 10, 40],  hi: [240, 130, 150] },  // roșu închis
        { base: [230, 60, 90],  hi: [255, 190, 205] },  // roz-roșu
        { base: [200, 30, 65],  hi: [250, 150, 165] },  // roșu mediu
      ];
      return defs.map(({ base: [r, g, b], hi: [hr, hg, hb] }) => {
        const oc  = document.createElement('canvas');
        oc.width  = 72;
        oc.height = 108;
        const c   = oc.getContext('2d');
        if (!c) return oc;

        // Centru canvas: (36, 54)
        c.save();
        c.translate(36, 54);

        // ── Forma petalei: oval alungit cu vârf spre sus ──────────────────
        c.beginPath();
        c.moveTo(0, -50);                           // vârf sus
        c.bezierCurveTo( 32, -38,  36,  8,  18, 36);  // dreapta
        c.bezierCurveTo(  8,  50,  -8,  50, -18, 36);  // baza
        c.bezierCurveTo(-36,   8, -32, -38,   0, -50); // stânga
        c.closePath();

        // Gradient radial: centru luminos → margini închise
        const grd = c.createRadialGradient(-4, -18, 4, 2, 5, 52);
        grd.addColorStop(0,    `rgba(${Math.min(r+55,255)}, ${Math.min(g+70,255)}, ${Math.min(b+75,255)}, 1)`);
        grd.addColorStop(0.45, `rgba(${r}, ${g}, ${b}, 0.97)`);
        grd.addColorStop(1,    `rgba(${Math.max(r-45,0)}, ${Math.max(g-10,0)}, ${Math.max(b-10,0)}, 0.65)`);
        c.fillStyle = grd;
        c.fill();

        // Vene subtile (linie de la vârf la bază)
        c.beginPath();
        c.moveTo(0, -46);
        c.bezierCurveTo(2, 0, 1, 28, 0, 38);
        c.strokeStyle = `rgba(${Math.max(r-30,0)}, ${Math.max(g-5,0)}, ${Math.max(b-5,0)}, 0.28)`;
        c.lineWidth   = 1.2;
        c.stroke();

        // Highlight — reflexie lumină în stânga-sus
        c.beginPath();
        c.moveTo(0, -50);
        c.bezierCurveTo(-22, -38, -26, -8, -14, 14);
        c.bezierCurveTo( -8,  24,  -2, 22,   0, 14);
        c.bezierCurveTo(  6,   2,   4, -30,   0, -50);
        c.closePath();
        c.fillStyle = `rgba(${hr}, ${hg}, ${hb}, 0.22)`;
        c.fill();

        c.restore();
        return oc;
      });
    })();

    // ── Vânt global — oscilează lent + rafale bruște ─────────────────────
    let ptWindT   = Math.random() * 100;
    let ptWindX   = 0;   // curent de fond (lent, sinusoidal)
    let ptGustX   = 0;   // rafală bruscă

    class Petal2D {
      constructor(cW, cH) {
        this.x       = Math.random() * cW;
        this.y       = -30 - Math.random() * 80;
        this.cH      = cH;
        this.variant = ptVariants[Math.floor(Math.random() * ptVariants.length)];
        this.tilt    = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
        this.angle   = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
        this.swayT   = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
        this.turbT   = Math.floor(Math.random() * 40);
        this.spin    = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.008;
        this.vx      = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.15;
        this.vy      = 0.12 + Math.random() * 0.10;

        // ── Personalitate: 0 = rapid, 1 = plutitor, 2 = prins de curenți ──
        const t = Math.random();
        if (t < 0.30) {
          // ── LENT ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
          this.pType    = 0;
          this.w        = 18 + Math.random() * 12;
          this.gravity  = 0.008 + Math.random() * 0.004;
          this.dragBase = 0.018 + Math.random() * 0.008;
          this.dragFace = 0.022 + Math.random() * 0.010;
          this.tiltF    = 0.006 + Math.random() * 0.008;
          this.swayA    = 3  + Math.random() * 4;
          this.swayF    = 0.004 + Math.random() * 0.003;
          this.windSens = 0.04 + Math.random() * 0.04;
          this.alpha    = 0.82 + Math.random() * 0.18;
        } else if (t < 0.65) {
          // ── FOARTE LENT / PLUTITOR ────────────────────────────────────────
          this.pType    = 1;
          this.w        = 26 + Math.random() * 16;
          this.gravity  = 0.004 + Math.random() * 0.003;
          this.dragBase = 0.040 + Math.random() * 0.018;
          this.dragFace = 0.055 + Math.random() * 0.020;
          this.tiltF    = 0.003 + Math.random() * 0.004;
          this.swayA    = 6 + Math.random() * 8;
          this.swayF    = 0.002 + Math.random() * 0.002;
          this.windSens = 0.10 + Math.random() * 0.08;
          this.alpha    = 0.70 + Math.random() * 0.22;
        } else {
          // ── MEDIU LENT ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
          this.pType    = 2;
          this.w        = 22 + Math.random() * 14;
          this.gravity  = 0.006 + Math.random() * 0.004;
          this.dragBase = 0.028 + Math.random() * 0.010;
          this.dragFace = 0.038 + Math.random() * 0.014;
          this.tiltF    = 0.005 + Math.random() * 0.006;
          this.swayA    = 4 + Math.random() * 6;
          this.swayF    = 0.003 + Math.random() * 0.003;
          this.windSens = 0.08 + Math.random() * 0.06;
          this.alpha    = 0.75 + Math.random() * 0.25;
        }

        this.h = this.w * (1.40 + Math.random() * 0.40);
      }

      update() {
        const face = Math.abs(Math.cos(this.tilt));

        // Drag multiplicativ
        const dragCoeff = this.dragBase + face * face * this.dragFace;
        this.vy += this.gravity;
        this.vy *= (1 - dragCoeff);
        this.vy  = Math.max(0.10, this.vy);

        // Balans sinusoidal propriu
        this.swayT += this.swayF;
        const sway = Math.sin(this.swayT) * this.swayA * this.swayF * (0.4 + face * 0.9);

        // Micro-turbulență minimă
        this.turbT++;
        let turbX = 0;
        if (this.turbT > 90 + Math.random() * 60) {
          turbX = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.3 * face;
          this.turbT = 0;
        }

        // Vânt global + rafală, ponderate de sensibilitatea petlalei
        const windEffect = (ptWindX + ptGustX) * this.windSens * (0.6 + face * 0.7);

        this.x += this.vx + sway + turbX + windEffect;
        this.y += this.vy;

        // Tilt — fără minim forțat, lasă petalele să se miște lin
        const tiltAccel = (1.0 - face) * 0.001;
        this.tiltF = Math.min(this.tiltF + tiltAccel * (Math.random() - 0.5), 0.012);
        this.tilt += this.tiltF;

        this.angle += this.spin * 0.3;

        return this.y < this.cH + 40;
      }

      draw(ctx) {
        if (!this.variant) return;
        const face   = Math.abs(Math.cos(this.tilt));
        const scaleY = Math.max(0.06, face);
        ctx.save();
        ctx.globalAlpha = this.alpha * (0.62 + 0.38 * face);
        ctx.translate(this.x, this.y);
        ctx.rotate(this.angle);
        ctx.drawImage(this.variant, -this.w / 2, -(this.h * scaleY) / 2, this.w, this.h * scaleY);
        ctx.restore();
      }
    }

    const ptFrame = (_ts) => {
      if (!petalsCanvas) return;
      const ctx = petalsCanvas.getContext('2d');
      if (!ctx) return;
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, petalsCanvas.width, petalsCanvas.height);

      // ── Actualizează vântul global ──────────────────────────────────────
      ptWindT += 0.0006;
      // Curent de fond: foarte slab și lent
      ptWindX = Math.sin(ptWindT * 0.3) * 0.08 + Math.sin(ptWindT * 0.7) * 0.04;
      // Fără rafale bruște
      ptGustX = 0;

      // Generează petale noi — ritm constant și vizibil
      if (ptPetals.length < PT_MAX && Math.random() < 0.55) {
        ptPetals.push(new Petal2D(petalsCanvas.width, petalsCanvas.height));
      }

      for (let i = ptPetals.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        const alive = ptPetals[i].update();
        ptPetals[i].draw(ctx);
        if (!alive) ptPetals.splice(i, 1);
      }

      ptRafId = requestAnimationFrame(ptFrame);
    };

    const startPetals = () => {
      if (!petalsCanvas) return;
      if (window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) return;
      stopPetals();
      petalsCanvas.width  = window.innerWidth;
      petalsCanvas.height = window.innerHeight;
      // Pre-populează imediat — petale distribuite pe tot ecranul la deschidere
      for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
        const p = new Petal2D(petalsCanvas.width, petalsCanvas.height);
        p.y = (Math.random() - 0.1) * petalsCanvas.height;
        ptPetals.push(p);
      }
      ptRafId = requestAnimationFrame(ptFrame);
    };

    const stopPetals = () => {
      if (ptRafId) { cancelAnimationFrame(ptRafId); ptRafId = null; }
      ptPetals.length = 0;
      if (petalsCanvas) {
        const ctx = petalsCanvas.getContext('2d');
        ctx?.clearRect(0, 0, petalsCanvas.width, petalsCanvas.height);
      }
    };
    // ── End Petale ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    const lbNavPrev = /** @type {HTMLButtonElement|null} */ (document.querySelector('[data-lightbox-prev]'));
    const lbNavNext = /** @type {HTMLButtonElement|null} */ (document.querySelector('[data-lightbox-next]'));

    const updateLightboxNavButtons = () => {
      if (lbNavPrev instanceof HTMLButtonElement) {
        lbNavPrev.disabled = currentLightboxIndex <= 0;
      }
      if (lbNavNext instanceof HTMLButtonElement) {
        lbNavNext.disabled = currentLightboxIndex >= albumPhotos.length - 1;
      }
    };

    const loadPhotoInLightbox = (photo) => {
      if (!lightboxImage || !lightboxCaption) return;
      const audioSrc = String(photo.audio ?? '');
      const quoteSrc = String(photo.quote ?? '');

      lightboxImage.setAttribute('src', String(photo.image ?? ''));
      lightboxImage.setAttribute('alt', String(photo.title ?? 'Fotografie eveniment'));
      lightboxCaption.textContent = String(photo.caption ?? '');

      if (lightboxQuote instanceof HTMLElement) {
        const quoteText = lightboxQuote.querySelector('.lightbox-quote-text');
        if (quoteText) quoteText.textContent = quoteSrc;
        lightboxQuote.classList.toggle('hidden', !quoteSrc);
      }

      if (lightboxAudio instanceof HTMLAudioElement) {
        lightboxAudio.pause();
        lightboxAudio.removeAttribute('src');
        lightboxAudio.classList.add('hidden');
        lightboxAudio.load();
        if (audioSrc) {
          lightboxAudio.setAttribute('src', audioSrc);
          lightboxAudio.classList.remove('hidden');
          const playPromise = lightboxAudio.play();
          if (playPromise && typeof playPromise.catch === 'function') {
            playPromise.catch(() => {});
          }
        }
      }

      if (lightboxAudioNote instanceof HTMLElement) {
        lightboxAudioNote.classList.toggle('hidden', !audioSrc);
      }
    };

    const navigateLightbox = (direction) => {
      const nextIndex = direction === 'next' ? currentLightboxIndex + 1 : currentLightboxIndex - 1;
      if (nextIndex < 0 || nextIndex >= albumPhotos.length) return;
      const imageShell = lightbox?.querySelector('.lightbox-image-shell');
      if (!(imageShell instanceof HTMLElement)) return;

      imageShell.classList.add('is-photo-leaving');
      window.setTimeout(() => {
        currentLightboxIndex = nextIndex;
        loadPhotoInLightbox(albumPhotos[nextIndex]);
        updateLightboxNavButtons();
        imageShell.classList.remove('is-photo-leaving');
        imageShell.classList.add('is-photo-entering');
        window.setTimeout(() => imageShell.classList.remove('is-photo-entering'), 320);
      }, 210);
    };

    const openLightboxFromTrigger = (trigger) => {
      if (!lightbox || !lightboxImage || !lightboxCaption) return;

      const src = trigger.getAttribute('data-lightbox-src') ?? '';
      const alt = trigger.getAttribute('data-lightbox-alt') ?? 'Fotografie eveniment';
      const caption = trigger.getAttribute('data-lightbox-caption') ?? '';
      const audioSrc = trigger.getAttribute('data-lightbox-audio') ?? '';
      const quoteSrc = trigger.getAttribute('data-lightbox-quote') ?? '';

      lightboxImage.setAttribute('src', src);
      lightboxImage.setAttribute('alt', alt);
      lightboxCaption.textContent = caption;

      currentLightboxIndex = albumPhotos.findIndex((p) => String(p.image ?? '') === src);
      if (currentLightboxIndex < 0) currentLightboxIndex = 0;
      updateLightboxNavButtons();

      if (lightboxQuote instanceof HTMLElement) {
        const quoteText = lightboxQuote.querySelector('.lightbox-quote-text');
        if (quoteText) quoteText.textContent = quoteSrc;
        lightboxQuote.classList.toggle('hidden', !quoteSrc);
      }

      if (lightboxAudio instanceof HTMLAudioElement) {
        lightboxAudio.pause();
        lightboxAudio.removeAttribute('src');
        lightboxAudio.classList.add('hidden');
        lightboxAudio.load();

        if (audioSrc) {
          lightboxAudio.setAttribute('src', audioSrc);
          lightboxAudio.classList.remove('hidden');

          const playPromise = lightboxAudio.play();
          if (playPromise && typeof playPromise.catch === 'function') {
            playPromise.catch(() => {});
          }
        }
      }

      if (lightboxAudioNote instanceof HTMLElement) {
        lightboxAudioNote.classList.toggle('hidden', !audioSrc);
      }

      isClosingLightbox = false;
      lightbox.classList.remove('is-closing');
      lockPageScrollForLightbox();
      lightbox.showModal();
      startPetals();
    };

    const normalizeSearchText = (value) =>
      String(value ?? '')
        .toLowerCase()
        .normalize('NFD')
        .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
        .trim();

    const updateSearchResultText = () => {
      if (!(albumSearchResult instanceof HTMLElement)) return;

      if (!currentSearchTerm) {
        albumSearchResult.textContent = `Se afișează toate fotografiile (${albumPhotos.length}).`;
        return;
      }

      albumSearchResult.textContent = `Rezultate pentru „${currentSearchTerm}”: ${albumPhotos.length}`;
    };

    const coupleCards = /** @type {HTMLElement[]} */ ([...document.querySelectorAll('.couple-card')]);
    const coupleCardsSection = /** @type {HTMLElement|null} */ (document.querySelector('.couple-cards-section'));

    // Click pe fotografia unui cuplu → deschide lightbox cu petale + cer
    document.querySelector('.couple-cards-grid')?.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
      const btn = event.target instanceof Element
        ? event.target.closest('[data-lightbox-src].cc-photo')
        : null;
      if (!(btn instanceof HTMLElement)) return;
      openLightboxFromTrigger(btn);
    });

    const filterCoupleCards = (needle) => {
      let visibleCount = 0;
      coupleCards.forEach((card) => {
        const haystack = normalizeSearchText(card.getAttribute('data-couple-search') ?? '');
        const match = !needle || haystack.includes(needle);
        card.style.display = match ? '' : 'none';
        if (match) visibleCount++;
      });
      if (coupleCardsSection instanceof HTMLElement) {
        coupleCardsSection.style.display = visibleCount === 0 ? 'none' : '';
      }
    };

    const applyAlbumSearch = () => {
      const needle = normalizeSearchText(currentSearchTerm);

      if (!needle) {
        albumPhotos = [...allAlbumPhotos];
      } else {
        albumPhotos = allAlbumPhotos.filter((photo) => {
          const title = normalizeSearchText(photo?.title);
          const caption = normalizeSearchText(photo?.caption);
          return title.includes(needle) || caption.includes(needle);
        });
      }

      filterCoupleCards(needle);
      activePhotoIndex = 0;
      renderFilmStrip();
      updateSearchResultText();
    };

    // ── Film strip ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const THUMB_W = 210;
    const THUMB_GAP = 12;

    const renderFilmStrip = () => {
      if (!filmStripTrack) return;
      filmStripTrack.innerHTML = '';

      if (albumPhotos.length === 0) {
        const empty = document.createElement('p');
        empty.className = 'film-empty-msg';
        empty.textContent = 'Nu am găsit fotografii pentru această căutare.';
        filmStripTrack.appendChild(empty);
        updateStripIndicator();
        updateStripNavButtons();
        return;
      }

      albumPhotos.forEach((photo, i) => {
        const item = document.createElement('div');
        item.className = 'film-thumb' + (i === activePhotoIndex ? ' film-thumb--active' : '');

        const btn = document.createElement('button');
        btn.type = 'button';
        btn.className = 'film-thumb-btn';
        btn.style.borderRadius = '16px';
        btn.setAttribute('data-film-idx', String(i));
        btn.setAttribute('data-lightbox-src', String(photo.image ?? ''));
        btn.setAttribute('data-lightbox-alt', String(photo.title ?? 'Fotografie eveniment'));
        btn.setAttribute('data-lightbox-caption', String(photo.caption ?? ''));
        btn.setAttribute('data-lightbox-audio', String(photo.audio ?? ''));
        btn.setAttribute('data-lightbox-quote', String(photo.quote ?? ''));
        btn.setAttribute('aria-label', String(photo.title ?? 'Fotografie eveniment'));

        const img = document.createElement('img');
        img.src = String(photo.image ?? '');
        img.alt = String(photo.title ?? '');
        img.loading = i < 8 ? 'eager' : 'lazy';
        img.className = 'film-thumb-img';
        img.style.borderRadius = '14px';
        img.draggable = false;
        btn.appendChild(img);

        if (i === activePhotoIndex) {
          const pill = document.createElement('span');
          pill.className = 'film-active-open-hint';
          pill.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
          pill.textContent = '▶ Deschide';
          btn.appendChild(pill);
        }

        item.appendChild(btn);
        filmStripTrack.appendChild(item);
      });

      scrollToActive(false);
      updateStripIndicator();
      updateStripNavButtons();
    };

    const scrollToActive = (animated = true) => {
      const outer = filmStripTrack?.parentElement;
      if (!outer || !filmStripTrack) return;
      const outerW = outer.clientWidth;
      const itemW = THUMB_W + THUMB_GAP;
      const activeMidX = activePhotoIndex * itemW + THUMB_W / 2;
      const scrollLeft = activeMidX - outerW / 2;
      filmStripTrack.style.transition = animated ? 'transform 440ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1)' : 'none';
      filmStripTrack.style.transform = `translateX(${-Math.max(0, scrollLeft)}px)`;
    };

    const updateStripIndicator = () => {
      if (albumIndicator) {
        albumIndicator.textContent = albumPhotos.length > 0
          ? `${activePhotoIndex + 1} / ${albumPhotos.length}`
          : '—';
      }
    };

    const updateStripNavButtons = () => {
      if (albumPrevButton instanceof HTMLButtonElement) albumPrevButton.disabled = activePhotoIndex <= 0;
      if (albumNextButton instanceof HTMLButtonElement) albumNextButton.disabled = activePhotoIndex >= albumPhotos.length - 1;
    };

    renderFilmStrip();
    updateSearchResultText();

    const runSearchFromInput = () => {
      if (!(albumSearchInput instanceof HTMLInputElement)) return;
      currentSearchTerm = albumSearchInput.value.trim();
      applyAlbumSearch();
    };

    albumSearchButton?.addEventListener('click', runSearchFromInput);

    albumSearchInput?.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
      if (event.key === 'Enter') {
        event.preventDefault();
        runSearchFromInput();
      }
    });

    albumSearchInput?.addEventListener('input', () => {
      if (searchDebounceTimer) {
        window.clearTimeout(searchDebounceTimer);
      }

      searchDebounceTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {
        runSearchFromInput();
      }, 220);
    });

    albumSearchClearButton?.addEventListener('click', () => {
      if (albumSearchInput instanceof HTMLInputElement) {
        albumSearchInput.value = '';
      }
      currentSearchTerm = '';
      applyAlbumSearch();
    });

    albumPrevButton?.addEventListener('click', () => {
      if (activePhotoIndex <= 0) return;
      activePhotoIndex -= 1;
      renderFilmStrip();
    });

    albumNextButton?.addEventListener('click', () => {
      if (activePhotoIndex >= albumPhotos.length - 1) return;
      activePhotoIndex += 1;
      renderFilmStrip();
    });

    albumRoot?.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
      const btn = event.target instanceof Element ? event.target.closest('[data-film-idx]') : null;
      if (!btn) return;
      const idx = parseInt(btn.getAttribute('data-film-idx') ?? '-1', 10);
      if (isNaN(idx) || idx < 0 || idx >= albumPhotos.length) return;
      if (idx === activePhotoIndex) {
        openLightboxFromTrigger(btn);
      } else {
        activePhotoIndex = idx;
        renderFilmStrip();
      }
    });

    if (lightbox && lightboxImage && lightboxCaption) {
      // Keep exit click-only: prevent default ESC/cancel close behavior.
      lightbox.addEventListener('cancel', (event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
      });

      lightboxDemoSoundButton?.addEventListener('click', () => {
        playDemoSound();
      });

      lightboxSizeToggleButton?.addEventListener('click', () => {
        currentSizePreset = currentSizePreset === 'large' ? 'normal' : 'large';
        window.localStorage.setItem(sizePresetStorageKey, currentSizePreset);
        syncSizePresetUi();
      });

      lightbox.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        const target = event.target instanceof Element ? event.target : null;
        if (
          target?.closest('.lightbox-size-selector') ||
          target?.closest('.lightbox-demo-sound-wrap') ||
          target?.closest('.lightbox-audio-wrap') ||
          target?.closest('.lightbox-nav-btn') ||
          target?.closest('.lightbox-close-btn') ||
          target?.closest('.lightbox-image-shell') ||
          target?.closest('.lightbox-caption') ||
          target?.closest('.lightbox-quote') ||
          target?.closest('.lightbox-blessing')
        ) {
          return;
        }

        closeLightbox();
      });

      document.querySelector('[data-lightbox-close]')?.addEventListener('click', () => closeLightbox());
      lbNavPrev?.addEventListener('click', () => navigateLightbox('prev'));
      lbNavNext?.addEventListener('click', () => navigateLightbox('next'));

      lightbox.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
        if (!lightbox.open) return;
        if (event.key === 'ArrowLeft') { event.preventDefault(); navigateLightbox('prev'); }
        if (event.key === 'ArrowRight') { event.preventDefault(); navigateLightbox('next'); }
        if (event.key === 'Escape') { event.preventDefault(); closeLightbox(); }
      });

      lightbox.addEventListener('close', () => {
        isClosingLightbox = false;
        lightbox.classList.remove('is-closing');
        stopPetals();
        unlockPageScrollForLightbox();

        // Animate album back into view after lightbox closes
        if (albumRoot instanceof HTMLElement) {
          albumRoot.classList.remove('album-is-returning');
          void albumRoot.offsetWidth;
          albumRoot.classList.add('album-is-returning');
          window.setTimeout(() => albumRoot.classList.remove('album-is-returning'), 700);
        }
        lightboxImage.setAttribute('src', '');
        lightboxImage.setAttribute('alt', '');
        lightboxCaption.textContent = '';

        if (lightboxQuote instanceof HTMLElement) {
          lightboxQuote.classList.add('hidden');
          const quoteText = lightboxQuote.querySelector('.lightbox-quote-text');
          if (quoteText) quoteText.textContent = '';
        }

        if (lightboxAudio instanceof HTMLAudioElement) {
          lightboxAudio.pause();
          lightboxAudio.removeAttribute('src');
          lightboxAudio.classList.add('hidden');
          lightboxAudio.load();
        }

        if (lightboxAudioNote instanceof HTMLElement) {
          lightboxAudioNote.classList.add('hidden');
        }
      });
    }

    const homeGalleryUploadForm = document.querySelector('[data-home-gallery-upload-form]');
    const homeGalleryDropzone = document.querySelector('[data-home-gallery-dropzone]');
    const homeGalleryDropzoneTrigger = document.querySelector('[data-home-gallery-dropzone-trigger]');
    const homeAudioDropzone = document.querySelector('[data-home-audio-dropzone]');
    const homeAudioDropzoneTrigger = document.querySelector('[data-home-audio-dropzone-trigger]');
    const homeAudioFileName = document.querySelector('[data-home-audio-file-name]');
    const homeGalleryFileInput = document.getElementById('home-gallery-photo-input');
    const homeGalleryAudioInput = document.getElementById('home-gallery-audio-input');
    const homeGalleryTitleInput = document.querySelector('[data-home-gallery-title]');
    const homeGalleryPreview = document.querySelector('[data-home-gallery-preview]');
    const homeGalleryStatus = document.querySelector('[data-home-gallery-status]');
    const homeGalleryUrlInput = document.querySelector('[data-home-gallery-url]');
    const homeGallerySubmitButton = document.querySelector('[data-home-gallery-submit]');

    let selectedHomeGalleryFile = null;
    let selectedHomeGalleryAudioFile = null;

    const showHomeGalleryStatus = (message, type = 'info') => {
      if (!homeGalleryStatus) return;

      homeGalleryStatus.textContent = message;
      homeGalleryStatus.classList.remove('hidden', 'border-red-300/50', 'bg-red-500/10', 'text-red-100', 'border-lime-300/50', 'bg-lime-500/10', 'text-lime-100', 'border-white/30', 'bg-white/10', 'text-white');

      if (type === 'error') {
        homeGalleryStatus.classList.add('border-red-300/50', 'bg-red-500/10', 'text-red-100');
        return;
      }

      if (type === 'success') {
        homeGalleryStatus.classList.add('border-lime-300/50', 'bg-lime-500/10', 'text-lime-100');
        return;
      }

      homeGalleryStatus.classList.add('border-white/30', 'bg-white/10', 'text-white');
    };

    const validateHomeGalleryFile = (file) => {
      const allowedTypes = ['image/jpeg', 'image/jpg', 'image/png', 'image/webp'];
      if (!allowedTypes.includes((file.type || '').toLowerCase())) {
        return 'Sunt permise doar fișiere JPG, PNG și WebP.';
      }

      if (file.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024) {
        return 'Fișierul este prea mare. Limita este 5MB.';
      }

      return '';
    };

    const validateHomeGalleryAudioFile = (file) => {
      const mime = (file.type || '').toLowerCase();
      const ext = (file.name || '').toLowerCase().split('.').pop() ?? '';
      const isMp3 = mime === 'audio/mpeg' || mime === 'audio/mp3' || ext === 'mp3';

      if (!isMp3) {
        return 'Fișierul audio trebuie să fie MP3.';
      }

      if (file.size > 4 * 1024 * 1024) {
        return 'Fișierul audio este prea mare. Limita este 4MB.';
      }

      return '';
    };

    const setHomeGalleryPreview = (file) => {
      if (!(homeGalleryPreview instanceof HTMLImageElement)) return;

      const objectUrl = URL.createObjectURL(file);
      homeGalleryPreview.src = objectUrl;
      homeGalleryPreview.classList.remove('hidden');
      homeGalleryPreview.onload = () => {
        URL.revokeObjectURL(objectUrl);
      };
    };

    const resizeHomeGalleryFile = async (file) => {
      const imageUrl = URL.createObjectURL(file);

      try {
        const imageElement = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
          const image = new Image();
          image.onload = () => resolve(image);
          image.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Nu s-a putut procesa imaginea.'));
          image.src = imageUrl;
        });

        const maxWidth = 1400;
        const maxHeight = 1400;
        const scale = Math.min(maxWidth / imageElement.width, maxHeight / imageElement.height, 1);
        const targetWidth = Math.max(1, Math.round(imageElement.width * scale));
        const targetHeight = Math.max(1, Math.round(imageElement.height * scale));

        const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
        canvas.width = targetWidth;
        canvas.height = targetHeight;

        const context = canvas.getContext('2d');
        if (!context) return file;

        context.drawImage(imageElement, 0, 0, targetWidth, targetHeight);

        const blob = await new Promise((resolve) => {
          canvas.toBlob((result) => resolve(result), 'image/webp', 0.86);
        });

        if (!(blob instanceof Blob)) return file;
        const optimizedName = file.name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, '') + '.webp';
        return new File([blob], optimizedName, { type: 'image/webp' });
      } finally {
        URL.revokeObjectURL(imageUrl);
      }
    };

    const handleHomeGalleryFile = async (file) => {
      const error = validateHomeGalleryFile(file);
      if (error) {
        selectedHomeGalleryFile = null;
        showHomeGalleryStatus(error, 'error');
        return;
      }

      showHomeGalleryStatus('Optimizăm fotografia înainte de upload...', 'info');

      try {
        const optimizedFile = await resizeHomeGalleryFile(file);
        selectedHomeGalleryFile = optimizedFile;
        setHomeGalleryPreview(optimizedFile);
        showHomeGalleryStatus(`Fișier pregătit: ${optimizedFile.name}`, 'info');
      } catch {
        selectedHomeGalleryFile = file;
        setHomeGalleryPreview(file);
        showHomeGalleryStatus(`Fișier pregătit: ${file.name}`, 'info');
      }
    };

    const handleHomeGalleryAudioFile = (file) => {
      const error = validateHomeGalleryAudioFile(file);
      if (error) {
        selectedHomeGalleryAudioFile = null;
        if (homeAudioFileName instanceof HTMLElement) {
          homeAudioFileName.textContent = 'Nu ai selectat audio.';
        }
        showHomeGalleryStatus(error, 'error');
        return;
      }

      selectedHomeGalleryAudioFile = file;
      if (homeAudioFileName instanceof HTMLElement) {
        homeAudioFileName.textContent = `Audio pregătit: ${file.name}`;
      }
      showHomeGalleryStatus('Fișier audio pregătit pentru upload.', 'info');
    };

    if (homeGalleryDropzone && homeGalleryFileInput instanceof HTMLInputElement) {
      homeGalleryDropzone.addEventListener('click', () => homeGalleryFileInput.click());

      homeGalleryDropzone.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
        if (event.key === 'Enter' || event.key === ' ') {
          event.preventDefault();
          homeGalleryFileInput.click();
        }
      });

      homeGalleryFileInput.addEventListener('change', () => {
        const file = homeGalleryFileInput.files?.[0];
        if (!file) return;
        handleHomeGalleryFile(file);
      });

      homeGalleryDropzone.addEventListener('dragover', (event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        homeGalleryDropzone.classList.add('border-lime-300', 'bg-lime-500/15');
      });

      homeGalleryDropzone.addEventListener('dragleave', () => {
        homeGalleryDropzone.classList.remove('border-lime-300', 'bg-lime-500/15');
      });

      homeGalleryDropzone.addEventListener('drop', (event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        homeGalleryDropzone.classList.remove('border-lime-300', 'bg-lime-500/15');

        const file = event.dataTransfer?.files?.[0];
        if (!file) return;
        handleHomeGalleryFile(file);
      });
    }

    homeGalleryDropzoneTrigger?.addEventListener('click', () => {
      if (homeGalleryFileInput instanceof HTMLInputElement) {
        homeGalleryFileInput.click();
      }
    });

    if (homeAudioDropzone && homeGalleryAudioInput instanceof HTMLInputElement) {
      homeAudioDropzone.addEventListener('click', () => homeGalleryAudioInput.click());

      homeAudioDropzone.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
        if (event.key === 'Enter' || event.key === ' ') {
          event.preventDefault();
          homeGalleryAudioInput.click();
        }
      });

      homeGalleryAudioInput.addEventListener('change', () => {
        const file = homeGalleryAudioInput.files?.[0];
        if (!file) return;
        handleHomeGalleryAudioFile(file);
      });

      homeAudioDropzone.addEventListener('dragover', (event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        homeAudioDropzone.classList.add('border-cyan-200', 'bg-cyan-500/20');
      });

      homeAudioDropzone.addEventListener('dragleave', () => {
        homeAudioDropzone.classList.remove('border-cyan-200', 'bg-cyan-500/20');
      });

      homeAudioDropzone.addEventListener('drop', (event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        homeAudioDropzone.classList.remove('border-cyan-200', 'bg-cyan-500/20');

        const file = event.dataTransfer?.files?.[0];
        if (!file) return;
        handleHomeGalleryAudioFile(file);
      });
    }

    homeAudioDropzoneTrigger?.addEventListener('click', () => {
      if (homeGalleryAudioInput instanceof HTMLInputElement) {
        homeGalleryAudioInput.click();
      }
    });

    homeGalleryUploadForm?.addEventListener('submit', async (event) => {
      event.preventDefault();

      const photoTitle =
        homeGalleryTitleInput instanceof HTMLInputElement
          ? homeGalleryTitleInput.value.trim()
          : '';

      if (photoTitle.length < 2 || photoTitle.length > 180) {
        showHomeGalleryStatus('Titlul fotografiei trebuie să aibă între 2 și 180 de caractere.', 'error');
        return;
      }

      if (!(selectedHomeGalleryFile instanceof File)) {
        showHomeGalleryStatus('Selectează mai întâi o imagine validă.', 'error');
        return;
      }

      if (homeGallerySubmitButton instanceof HTMLButtonElement) {
        homeGallerySubmitButton.disabled = true;
        homeGallerySubmitButton.textContent = 'Se procesează...';
      }

      try {
        const formData = new FormData();
        formData.append('photo', selectedHomeGalleryFile);
        formData.append('title', photoTitle);
        if (selectedHomeGalleryAudioFile instanceof File) {
          formData.append('audio', selectedHomeGalleryAudioFile);
        }

        const response = await fetch('/api/upload-photo', {
          method: 'POST',
          body: formData,
        });

        const data = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error(data.error || 'Upload-ul a eșuat.');
        }

        if (homeGalleryUrlInput instanceof HTMLInputElement) {
          homeGalleryUrlInput.value = data.url || '';
        }

        if (albumRoot && data.url) {
          if (albumRoot.getAttribute('data-home-gallery-source') === 'fallback') {
            window.location.reload();
            return;
          }

          const safeTitle = String(data.title || photoTitle);
          const newPhoto = {
            title: safeTitle,
            image: String(data.url),
            caption: `${safeTitle} • ${new Date().toLocaleDateString('ro-RO')}`,
            audio: String(data.audioUrl || `/uploads/audio/${String(data.url).split('/').pop()?.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, '') || ''}.mp3`),
          };

          allAlbumPhotos.unshift(newPhoto);

          const normalizedNeedle = normalizeSearchText(currentSearchTerm);
          const matchesFilter =
            !normalizedNeedle ||
            normalizeSearchText(newPhoto.title).includes(normalizedNeedle) ||
            normalizeSearchText(newPhoto.caption).includes(normalizedNeedle);

          if (matchesFilter) {
            albumPhotos.unshift(newPhoto);
          }

          activePhotoIndex = 0;
          renderFilmStrip();
          updateSearchResultText();
        }

        showHomeGalleryStatus('Imagine încărcată cu succes în galerie.', 'success');
      } catch (error) {
        const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Eroare la upload.';
        showHomeGalleryStatus(message, 'error');
      } finally {
        if (homeGallerySubmitButton instanceof HTMLButtonElement) {
          homeGallerySubmitButton.disabled = false;
          homeGallerySubmitButton.textContent = 'Optimizează și încarcă';
        }
      }
    });

    // ── Muzică romantică de fundal ────────────────────────────────────────────
    (function () {
      const bgSection = document.getElementById('momente-reale');
      if (!bgSection) return;

      // Creează butonul direct pe body (evită orice stacking context)
      const bgFab = document.createElement('button');
      bgFab.id = 'bg-music-fab';
      bgFab.className = 'bg-music-fab';
      bgFab.type = 'button';
      bgFab.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
      bgFab.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Muzică romantică de fundal');
      bgFab.innerHTML = '<span class="bg-music-note" aria-hidden="true">♪</span><span class="bg-music-label">Muzică</span>';
      document.body.appendChild(bgFab);

      const BG_BPM = 58;
      const BG_BEAT = 60 / BG_BPM;

      // Progresie romantică Am-F-C-G, 3 voci: [bass, middle, melody]
      const BG_VOICES = [
        [110.00, 164.81, 440.00], // Am beat 1
        [110.00, 220.00, 523.25], // Am beat 2
        [110.00, 261.63, 659.25], // Am beat 3
        [110.00, 220.00, 523.25], // Am beat 4
        [ 87.31, 130.81, 349.23], // F  beat 1
        [ 87.31, 174.61, 440.00], // F  beat 2
        [ 87.31, 220.00, 523.25], // F  beat 3
        [ 87.31, 174.61, 440.00], // F  beat 4
        [130.81, 196.00, 523.25], // C  beat 1
        [130.81, 261.63, 659.25], // C  beat 2
        [130.81, 329.63, 784.00], // C  beat 3
        [130.81, 261.63, 659.25], // C  beat 4
        [ 98.00, 146.83, 392.00], // G  beat 1
        [ 98.00, 196.00, 493.88], // G  beat 2
        [ 98.00, 246.94, 587.33], // G  beat 3
        [ 98.00, 196.00, 493.88], // G  beat 4
      ];

      let bgCtx = null;
      let bgMaster = null;
      let bgDelay = null;
      let bgPlaying = false;
      let bgNextTime = 0;
      let bgBeatIdx = 0;
      let bgLoopTimer = null;
      let bgSectionVisible = false;
      let bgStartedOnce = false;

      const bgPlayNote = (freq, startT, dur, vel) => {
        if (!bgCtx || !bgMaster) return;
        const osc  = bgCtx.createOscillator();
        const osc2 = bgCtx.createOscillator();
        const gain = bgCtx.createGain();
        const filt = bgCtx.createBiquadFilter();
        osc.type  = 'sine';     osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq,      startT);
        osc2.type = 'triangle'; osc2.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq * 2, startT);
        filt.type = 'lowpass';
        filt.frequency.setValueAtTime(2400, startT);
        filt.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(700, startT + dur);
        gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, startT);
        gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(vel, startT + 0.05);
        gain.gain.setValueAtTime(vel, startT + dur * 0.5);
        gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, startT + dur);
        osc.connect(filt); osc2.connect(filt);
        filt.connect(gain);
        gain.connect(bgMaster);
        if (bgDelay) gain.connect(bgDelay);
        osc.start(startT);  osc.stop(startT + dur + 0.12);
        osc2.start(startT); osc2.stop(startT + dur + 0.12);
      };

      const bgSchedule = () => {
        if (!bgPlaying || !bgCtx) return;
        while (bgNextTime < bgCtx.currentTime + 4.0) {
          const voices = BG_VOICES[bgBeatIdx % BG_VOICES.length];
          const t = bgNextTime;
          // Arpeggio staggerat: bass → middle → melody (60ms apart)
          bgPlayNote(voices[0], t,        BG_BEAT * 0.88, 0.052);
          bgPlayNote(voices[1], t + 0.06, BG_BEAT * 0.78, 0.036);
          bgPlayNote(voices[2], t + 0.12, BG_BEAT * 0.72, 0.062);
          bgNextTime += BG_BEAT;
          bgBeatIdx++;
        }
        bgLoopTimer = window.setTimeout(bgSchedule, 300);
      };

      const bgInit = () => {
        if (bgCtx) return true;
        const AC = window.AudioContext || /** @type {any} */ (window).webkitAudioContext;
        if (!AC) return false;
        bgCtx = new AC();
        bgMaster = bgCtx.createGain();
        bgMaster.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, bgCtx.currentTime);
        // Delay pentru profunzime (efect reverb simplu)
        bgDelay = bgCtx.createDelay(2);
        const bgFb  = bgCtx.createGain();
        const bgDry = bgCtx.createGain();
        bgDelay.delayTime.value = 0.42;
        bgFb.gain.value  = 0.22;
        bgDry.gain.value = 0.18;
        bgDelay.connect(bgFb);
        bgFb.connect(bgDelay);
        bgDelay.connect(bgDry);
        bgDry.connect(bgMaster);
        bgMaster.connect(bgCtx.destination);
        return true;
      };

      const bgStart = () => {
        if (!bgInit()) return;
        if (bgCtx.state === 'suspended') bgCtx.resume().catch(() => {});
        if (bgPlaying) return;
        bgPlaying = true;
        bgStartedOnce = true;
        bgNextTime = bgCtx.currentTime + 0.3;
        bgSchedule();
        bgMaster.gain.cancelScheduledValues(bgCtx.currentTime);
        bgMaster.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, bgCtx.currentTime);
        bgMaster.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.46, bgCtx.currentTime + 3);
        bgUpdateFab();
      };

      const bgStop = () => {
        if (!bgPlaying) return;
        bgPlaying = false;
        if (bgLoopTimer) { window.clearTimeout(bgLoopTimer); bgLoopTimer = null; }
        if (bgMaster && bgCtx) {
          bgMaster.gain.cancelScheduledValues(bgCtx.currentTime);
          bgMaster.gain.setValueAtTime(bgMaster.gain.value, bgCtx.currentTime);
          bgMaster.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, bgCtx.currentTime + 2);
        }
        bgUpdateFab();
      };

      const bgUpdateFab = () => {
        bgFab.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(bgPlaying));
        bgFab.classList.toggle('is-playing', bgPlaying);
        const lbl = bgFab.querySelector('.bg-music-label');
        if (lbl) lbl.textContent = bgPlaying ? 'Pauză' : 'Muzică';
      };

      bgFab.addEventListener('click', () => { if (bgPlaying) bgStop(); else bgStart(); });
      bgFab.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
        if (event.key === 'Enter' || event.key === ' ') { event.preventDefault(); bgFab.click(); }
      });

      // Arată/ascunde FAB și pornire automată la prima interacțiune
      const bgObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
        entries.forEach((entry) => {
          bgSectionVisible = entry.isIntersecting;
          if (entry.isIntersecting) {
            bgFab.classList.add('is-visible');
            if (!bgStartedOnce) {
              window.setTimeout(() => { if (bgSectionVisible) bgStart(); }, 900);
            }
          } else {
            bgFab.classList.remove('is-visible');
            if (bgPlaying) bgStop();
          }
        });
      }, { threshold: 0.05 });
      bgObserver.observe(bgSection);

      // Pornire automată la primul click/touch pe pagină dacă secțiunea e vizibilă
      const bgOnFirst = () => { if (bgSectionVisible && !bgStartedOnce) bgStart(); };
      document.addEventListener('click',    bgOnFirst, { once: true });
      document.addEventListener('touchend', bgOnFirst, { once: true });
    })();
  </script>

  <style is:global>
    /* Cormorant Garamond se încarcă async via <link preload> în <head> */

    /* ─── Buton muzică romantică de fundal (JS-created DOM) ── */
    .bg-music-fab {

      bottom: 1.5rem;
      right: 1.5rem;
      z-index: 9999;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.45rem;
      padding: 0.55rem 1rem 0.55rem 0.8rem;
      border-radius: 9999px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(14, 6, 24, 0.94), rgba(38, 12, 55, 0.94));
      border: 1px solid rgba(232, 50, 90, 0.42);
      box-shadow: 0 4px 22px rgba(232, 50, 90, 0.22), 0 2px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);
      color: #fce4ed;
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: 0.07em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      cursor: pointer;
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(5rem) scale(0.8);
      pointer-events: none;
      transition: opacity 420ms ease, transform 420ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), background 180ms ease, border-color 180ms ease, box-shadow 180ms ease;
      user-select: none;
      -webkit-user-select: none;
    }
    .bg-music-fab.is-visible { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) scale(1); pointer-events: auto; }
    .bg-music-fab:hover { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(232, 50, 90, 0.28), rgba(180, 28, 62, 0.22)); border-color: rgba(232, 50, 90, 0.78); box-shadow: 0 6px 30px rgba(232, 50, 90, 0.38), 0 2px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55); transform: translateY(-2px) scale(1.05); }
    .bg-music-fab.is-playing { border-color: rgba(232, 50, 90, 0.72); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(232, 50, 90, 0.18), 0 6px 28px rgba(232, 50, 90, 0.38), 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5); }
    .bg-music-note { font-size: 1.05rem; line-height: 1; flex-shrink: 0; display: inline-block; }
    .bg-music-fab.is-playing .bg-music-note { animation: bgNoteBounce 1.8s ease-in-out infinite; }
    @keyframes bgNoteBounce { 0%, 100% { transform: scale(1) rotate(0deg); } 30% { transform: scale(1.28) rotate(-12deg); } 70% { transform: scale(0.86) rotate(8deg); } }
    .bg-music-label { min-width: 3.2rem; text-align: left; }
    @media (max-width: 480px) { .bg-music-fab { bottom: 1rem; right: 1rem; font-size: 0.65rem; padding: 0.46rem 0.75rem 0.46rem 0.65rem; } }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .bg-music-fab.is-playing .bg-music-note { animation: none; } }

    /* ─── Lightbox base (mutat din globals.css — folosit doar pe această pagină) ── */
    .photo-lightbox {

    /* Cardul — bloc simplu vertical, fără flexbox */

    /* Etaj 1 — fotografia (button lightbox trigger) */
    .cc-photo {

    .section-title {

      border-radius: 9999px;
      background: rgba(23, 33, 67, 0.8);
      color: #f0f6ff;
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      padding: 0.4rem 0.76rem;
      transition: background 180ms ease, border-color 180ms ease;
    }

    .lightbox-demo-sound-btn:hover {
      background: rgba(35, 49, 96, 0.92);
      border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.62);
    }

    .lightbox-size-selector {
      margin: 0.3rem auto 0;
      width: min(92vw, 560px);
      text-align: center;
    }

    .lightbox-size-btn {
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.32);
      border-radius: 9999px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      color: #eef5ff;
      font-size: 0.66rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      padding: 0.32rem 0.66rem;
      transition: background 180ms ease, border-color 180ms ease;
    }

    .lightbox-size-btn:hover {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16);
      border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5);
    }

    .lightbox-audio-note {
      margin: 0 0 0.35rem;
      color: #d9e9ff;
      font-size: 0.76rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .lightbox-audio {
      width: 100%;
      height: 38px;
      border-radius: 9999px;
      outline: 0;
    }

    @keyframes vertical-unfold {
      from {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: scaleY(0.08);
      }
      to {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: scaleY(1);
      }
    }

    @keyframes lightbox-fade-in {
      from {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: scale(1.03);
        filter: saturate(0.8) blur(3px);
      }
      to {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: scale(1);
        filter: saturate(1) blur(0px);
      }
    }

    @keyframes lightbox-fade-out {
      from {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: scale(1);
        filter: saturate(1) blur(0px);
      }
      to {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: scale(0.95);
        filter: saturate(0.7) blur(3px);
      }
    }

    @keyframes photoLeave {
      from { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); filter: blur(0px); }
      to { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.88); filter: blur(4px); }
    }

    @keyframes photoEnter {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.88); filter: blur(4px); }
      to { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); filter: blur(0px); }
    }

    @keyframes albumReturn {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.97) translateY(10px); }
      to { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
    }

    .gallery-stage-fade {
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(12px);
      animation: galleryStageFadeIn 620ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) forwards;
    }

    @keyframes galleryStageFadeIn {
      0% {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: translateY(12px);
      }
      100% {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translateY(0);
      }
    }

    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      .cinematic-lightbox[open] .lightbox-image-shell,
      .gallery-stage-fade {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: none;
        animation: none;
      }

      .lightbox-fireworks-canvas {
        display: none;
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 900px) {
      .lightbox-image-shell {
        height: var(--lightbox-shell-height-mobile);
      }

      .cinematic-lightbox {
        padding-top: 3.5rem;
      }

      .cinematic-lightbox .lightbox-image {
        max-height: var(--lightbox-image-max-height-mobile);
        max-width: var(--lightbox-image-max-width-desktop);
      }

      .film-thumb {
        width: 160px;
      }

      .film-strip-arrow {
        width: 2.2rem;
        height: 2.2rem;
        font-size: 1.5rem;
      }
    }

    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      .bg-music-fab.is-playing .bg-music-note { animation: none; }
    }
  </style>
</BaseLayout>
```

### src/pages/muzica-non-stop.astro
```astro
---
import BaseLayout from '../layouts/BaseLayout.astro';
import BackButton from '../components/BackButton.astro';
import audioCatalog from '../data/audio-catalog.generated.json';
import playlistPresets from '../data/audio-playlist-presets.json';

const pageTitle = 'Muzică de Petrecere Non-Stop | Streaming Audio';
const pageDescription = 'Ascultă Muzică de Petrecere Non-Stop și alege instant playlistul: Pop, Manele sau Populară. Intră în vibe-ul potrivit pentru eveniment!';
const pageOgImage = '/images/og-default-1200x630.jpg';

const configuredR2BaseUrl = import.meta.env.PUBLIC_R2_MUSIC_BASE_URL?.trim() || '';
const hasConfiguredR2BaseUrl = configuredR2BaseUrl.length > 0;
const r2AudioBaseUrl = configuredR2BaseUrl.replace(/\/$/, '');
const defaultArtist = 'Formația Florentina Pană';

const sourceCategories = Array.isArray(audioCatalog?.categories) ? audioCatalog.categories : [];
const hasCatalogTracks = sourceCategories.some((category) => Array.isArray(category.songs) && category.songs.length > 0);

const fallbackCategories = [
  {
    id: 'selectie-generala',
    title: 'Selecție Generală',
    songs: [],
  },
];

const categories = hasCatalogTracks ? sourceCategories : fallbackCategories;

const encodePathSegments = (rawPath: string) =>
  rawPath
    .split('/')
    .map((segment) => encodeURIComponent(segment))
    .join('/');

const resolveSongUrl = (filePath: string) => {
  const encodedPath = encodePathSegments(filePath);
  return hasConfiguredR2BaseUrl
    ? `${r2AudioBaseUrl}/${encodedPath}`
    : `/Audio/${encodedPath}`;
};

let currentIndex = 0;
const masterPlaylist = categories.flatMap((category) =>
  category.songs.map((song) => {
    const index = currentIndex++;
    const normalizedGenres = Array.isArray(song.genres) && song.genres.length > 0 ? song.genres : ['petrecere'];
    return {
      ...song,
      songIndex: index,
      categoryId: category.id,
      categoryTitle: category.title,
      genres: normalizedGenres,
      url: resolveSongUrl(song.file),
      cover_art_url: '/images/sigla-fp-band-110.webp',
    };
  })
);

const categoriesWithIndexes = categories.map((category) => ({
  ...category,
  songs: category.songs.map((song) => {
    const indexedSong = masterPlaylist.find((item) => item.file === song.file && item.categoryId === category.id);
    return {
      ...song,
      songIndex: indexedSong?.songIndex ?? -1,
      genres: indexedSong?.genres ?? (Array.isArray(song.genres) ? song.genres : ['petrecere']),
    };
  }),
}));

const providedPresets = Array.isArray(playlistPresets?.presets) ? playlistPresets.presets : [];
const normalizedPresets = providedPresets.length > 0
  ? providedPresets
  : [
      {
        key: 'master',
        label: 'Master Playlist',
        description: 'Selecția completă pentru toți clienții',
        includeGenres: [],
      },
    ];

const presetsWithTracks = normalizedPresets
  .map((preset) => {
    const requiredGenres = Array.isArray(preset.includeGenres) ? preset.includeGenres : [];
    const songs = requiredGenres.length === 0
      ? masterPlaylist
      : masterPlaylist.filter((song) => song.genres.some((genre) => requiredGenres.includes(genre)));

    return {
      ...preset,
      songs,
    };
  })
  .filter((preset) => preset.songs.length > 0);

const presetsFallback = presetsWithTracks.length > 0
  ? presetsWithTracks
  : [
      {
        key: 'master',
        label: 'Master Playlist',
        description: 'Selecția completă pentru toți clienții',
        includeGenres: [],
        songs: masterPlaylist,
      },
    ];

const defaultPresetKey = presetsFallback.some((preset) => preset.key === playlistPresets.defaultPresetKey)
  ? playlistPresets.defaultPresetKey
  : presetsFallback[0]?.key || 'master';

const musicPlaylistSchema = {
  '@context': 'https://schema.org',
  '@type': 'MusicPlaylist',
  name: 'Muzică de Petrecere Non-Stop',
  description: 'Master playlist cu piese pentru petreceri și evenimente, redat non-stop.',
  numTracks: masterPlaylist.length,
  track: masterPlaylist.slice(0, 60).map((song) => ({
    '@type': 'MusicRecording',
    name: song.name,
    byArtist: {
      '@type': 'MusicGroup',
      name: song.artist || defaultArtist,
    },
    url: song.url,
  })),
};
---

<BaseLayout title={pageTitle} description={pageDescription} ogImage={pageOgImage}>
  <Fragment slot="head">
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/amplitudejs@5.3.2/dist/amplitude.min.js" defer></script>

  </Fragment>

  <section class="relative overflow-hidden bg-black py-16 sm:py-20">
    <div class="absolute inset-0 bg-[radial-gradient(circle_at_top,#d4a01733,transparent_62%),linear-gradient(to_bottom,#090909,#100a03_60%,#0a0a0a)]"></div>

    <div class="section-container relative z-10">
      <div class="mb-6">
        <BackButton href="/" label="Acasă" />
      </div>

      <div class="mb-8 mx-auto max-w-5xl rounded-3xl border border-amber-400/25 bg-gradient-to-br from-[#1d1208]/95 via-[#120c06]/95 to-[#221307]/95 p-5 shadow-[0_16px_60px_rgba(0,0,0,0.45)] sm:p-8">
        <div class="space-y-4">
          <p class="text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-amber-200/80">Playlist Personalizat</p>

          </div>
          <p id="active-preset-description" class="text-sm text-cyan-100/85"></p>
          <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
            <label class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-white/80">
              <input id="radio-mode-toggle" type="checkbox" class="h-4 w-4 accent-amber-400" checked />

            </label>
            <button
              id="stream-start-btn"

              class="inline-flex items-center rounded-full border border-amber-300/45 bg-amber-500/15 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.08em] text-amber-100 transition hover:bg-amber-500/25"
            >

          </div>
          <p id="stream-status" class="text-xs text-white/60" aria-live="polite"></p>
        </div>

        <div class="mt-6 grid gap-8 md:grid-cols-[1.2fr_0.8fr] md:items-start">
          <div class="space-y-4">
            <p class="text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-amber-300/90">Player Activ</p>
            <p class="text-2xl font-semibold text-white" data-amplitude-song-info="name" data-amplitude-main-song-info="true">Selectează o piesă</p>
            <p class="text-white/60" data-amplitude-song-info="artist" data-amplitude-main-song-info="true">{defaultArtist}</p>

            <div class="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
              <button type="button" class="amplitude-prev inline-flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-white/20 bg-white/10 text-white transition hover:border-amber-400/70 hover:text-amber-200" aria-label="Piesa anterioară">
                <svg class="h-5 w-5" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" aria-hidden="true"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M11 19L2 12l9-7v14zM22 19l-9-7 9-7v14z"/></svg>
              </button>

              <button type="button" class="amplitude-play-pause amplitude-paused inline-flex h-14 w-14 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-amber-400/60 bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-100 transition hover:bg-amber-500/30" data-amplitude-main-play-pause="true" aria-label="Play/Pause">
                <svg class="amplitude-play-icon h-7 w-7" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M8 5v14l11-7z"/></svg>
              </button>

              <button type="button" class="amplitude-next inline-flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-white/20 bg-white/10 text-white transition hover:border-amber-400/70 hover:text-amber-200" aria-label="Piesa următoare">
                <svg class="h-5 w-5" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" aria-hidden="true"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M13 19l9-7-9-7v14zM2 19l9-7-9-7v14z"/></svg>

              <button id="random-play-btn" type="button" class="inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-cyan-300/40 bg-cyan-500/15 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.08em] text-cyan-100 transition hover:bg-cyan-500/25" aria-label="Redă o piesă random">

                data-amplitude-main-song-info="true"

                loading="lazy"

            <div class="rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-black/25 p-4">
              <p class="text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-white/65">Ascultate Recent</p>
              <div id="recent-tracks" class="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                <p class="text-sm text-white/55">Nu există încă istoric de ascultare pe acest browser.</p>

      <h1 class="font-['Oswald'] text-4xl font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.06em] text-white sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl">
        Muzică de Petrecere Non-Stop

      <p class="mt-3 max-w-2xl text-lg leading-relaxed text-white/75 sm:text-xl">
        Muzică de petrecere pentru clienții care vor atmosferă, ritm și continuitate fără pauze.
      </p>
      <p class="mt-3 max-w-3xl text-sm text-amber-200/80 sm:text-base">
        Tu setezi playlistul pentru client: Master, Pop, Manele sau Populară. Preseturile se personalizează din fișierul de configurare.
      </p>

      {!hasConfiguredR2BaseUrl && (
        <p class="mt-4 max-w-3xl rounded-xl border border-amber-400/35 bg-amber-500/10 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-amber-100/90">
          Playerul folosește momentan biblioteca locală din <strong>/public/Audio/</strong> până conectezi bucket-ul R2.
        </p>
      )}

  </section>

  <section class="bg-[#0b0b0b] py-10 sm:py-14">
    <div class="section-container">
      <h2 class="font-['Oswald'] text-3xl uppercase tracking-[0.08em] text-white sm:text-4xl">Repertoriu pe Categorii</h2>
      <p class="mt-2 max-w-2xl text-white/70">Clientul vede doar piesele din playlistul activat de tine, iar fiecare Play comută instant playerul global.</p>

      <div class="mt-5 grid gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-white/5 p-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
        <label class="space-y-2">
          <span class="text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-white/70">Caută piesă</span>
          <input
            id="track-search"
            type="search"
            placeholder="Ex: Hora, Dans, Petrecere"
            class="w-full rounded-lg border border-white/15 bg-black/30 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-white placeholder:text-white/45 focus:border-amber-400/70 focus:outline-none"
          />

        <label class="space-y-2">
          <span class="text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-white/70">Filtrează categorie</span>

            id="category-filter"
```
