  50% {
    transform: scaleY(1.18);
    opacity: 1;
  }
}

#top-menu-panel nav.has-active [data-nav-link]:not(.is-active)::after {
  opacity: 0 !important;
}

/* Pe mobil, butoanele inactive rămân lizibile */
#top-menu-panel nav.has-active .nav-link-mobile:not(.is-active) {
  opacity: 0.68;
  filter: none;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.72) !important;
  border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
}

#top-menu-panel nav.has-active [data-nav-link]:not(.is-active):hover {
  opacity: 1;
  filter: brightness(1.02) saturate(1);
}

#top-menu-panel nav [data-nav-link].is-active {
  filter: brightness(1.25) saturate(1.4);
  border: 2px solid var(--teal, #0BBCD6);
  transition: opacity 350ms ease, filter 350ms ease;
}

#top-menu-panel nav [data-nav-link].is-active::after {
  opacity: 1;
  box-shadow:
    0 0 16px rgba(11, 188, 214, 0.4),
    0 0 32px rgba(11, 188, 214, 0.2);
}

/* Fără text-shadow și fără glow în meniul de sus */
/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
#top-menu-panel .left-side-link {
  text-shadow: none;
}

#top-menu-panel [data-nav-link] {
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.45),
    0 5px 0 var(--btn-shadow-color, #333),
    0 6px 14px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);
}

#top-menu-panel [data-nav-link]:hover {
  /* glow-ul vine din ::after (opacity) — fără animare box-shadow */
}

/* body.top-menu-expanded #continut padding-top rules removed:
 * panoul de meniu este acum position:fixed, nu mai afectează layoutul,
 * deci #continut nu mai trebuie decalat. Decalajul cauzase flash-ul de cer. */

.skip-link {
  position: absolute;
  top: -48px;
  left: 12px;
  z-index: 60;
  border-radius: 0.75rem;
  padding: 0.5rem 0.9rem;
  color: #0a0a0a;
  background-color: var(--focus);
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  transition: top 180ms ease;
}

.skip-link:focus {
  top: 10px;
}

#acasa {
  position: relative;
}

.kicker {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  border: 1px solid rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.3);
  border-radius: 9999px;
  background: rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.12);
  padding: 0.35rem 0.75rem;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--gold);
}

.btn-solid,
.btn-outline {
  transition: background-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease;
  position: relative;
}

.btn-solid,
.btn-outline,
.btn-whatsapp,
.left-side-link {
  min-height: 44px;
  min-width: 44px;
}

.btn-solid {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  border-radius: 9999px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.55);
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FFD166 0%, #F5A623 48%, #C47F12 100%);
  color: #0C080F;
  text-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
  font-size: 1rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.07em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: 0.78rem 1.6rem;
  text-decoration: none;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 209, 102, 0.25) inset, 0 0 24px rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.32), 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
}

.btn-outline {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  border-radius: 9999px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.45);
  background: rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.07);
  color: var(--title);
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
  font-size: 1rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.07em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: 0.78rem 1.6rem;
  text-decoration: none;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.15) inset, 0 0 12px rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.12), 0 4px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25);
  transition: border-color 180ms ease, background-color 180ms ease;
  position: relative;
}

/* Glow compozitat pe hover — ::after cu opacity */
.btn-solid::after,
.btn-outline::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: -3px;
  border-radius: 9999px;
  pointer-events: none;
  opacity: 0;
  box-shadow: 0 0 32px rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.5), 0 8px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
  transition: opacity 180ms ease;
  will-change: opacity;
}

.btn-solid:hover::after,
.btn-outline:hover::after {
  opacity: 1;
}

.btn-outline:hover {
  border-color: rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.75);
  background: rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.13);
}

.btn-whatsapp {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  border-radius: 9999px;
  border: 1px solid #7affb58c;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2fdc81 0%, #1cbf6a 100%);
  color: #072615;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  padding: 0.72rem 1.15rem;
  text-decoration: none;
  box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(47, 220, 129, 0.26);
  transition: transform 160ms ease, filter 160ms ease;
  position: relative;
}

.btn-whatsapp::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: -3px;
  border-radius: 9999px;
  pointer-events: none;
  opacity: 0;
  box-shadow: 0 14px 34px rgba(47, 220, 129, 0.45);
  transition: opacity 180ms ease;
  will-change: opacity;
}

.btn-whatsapp-icon {
  display: inline-grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 1.1rem;
  height: 1.1rem;
}

.btn-whatsapp-icon svg {
  width: 1.1rem;
  height: 1.1rem;
}

.btn-whatsapp:hover {
  transform: translateY(-1px);
  filter: saturate(1.08) brightness(1.03);
}

.btn-whatsapp:hover::after {
  opacity: 1;
}

.btn-whatsapp:focus-visible {
  outline: 3px solid var(--focus);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

.btn-solid:focus-visible,
.btn-outline:focus-visible,
summary:focus-visible,
details:focus-visible {
  outline: 3px solid var(--focus);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

.nav-label {
  display: inline-block;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
}

.no-scrollbar {
  scrollbar-width: none;
}

.no-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar {
  display: none;
}

.section-head {
  max-width: 62ch;
  margin-inline: auto;
  /* centrează blocul header indiferent de containerul părinte */
  text-align: center;
  /* axă unică — kicker, h1/h2 și paragraful subordonat */
}

.section-head>* {
  margin-inline: auto;
  /* fiecare copil rămâne centrat pe axa headerului */
}

.section-title {
  margin: 0.5rem auto 0;
  /* centrare consistentă chiar și fără text-wrap balance */
  color: var(--title);
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 3.5vw, 2.6rem);
  line-height: 1.15;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  text-wrap: balance;
}

.section-copy {
  margin: 1rem auto 0;
  /* paragraful header-ului rămâne pe axa centrată */
  color: var(--body);
  font-size: clamp(0.92rem, 1.3vw, 1.05rem);
  line-height: 1.75;
  max-width: 58ch;
}

/* quality-*, signature-*, brand-marquee-*, wide-photo-slot*, home-top-stack,
   video-slot-*, video-stage-card, comments-stage-glass, video-divider-*,
   section-divider-*, mobile-sticky-cta, trust-* → CSS mort eliminat.
   video-embed-* → mutat în video/[slug].astro
   form-*, input-glass → mutat în contact.astro */

.glass-card:hover,
.glass-card:focus-within {
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(187, 134, 252, 0.34) inset, 0 0 26px rgba(187, 134, 252, 0.25), 0 18px 36px rgba(8, 9, 18, 0.52);
}

.glass-card {
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 1rem;
  background: rgba(8, 16, 42, 0.80);
  padding: 1rem;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.10) inset, 0 16px 34px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
}


@media (max-width: 1023px) {

  .top-header .social-btn--prominent,
  .top-header .social-strip-mobile {
    display: none !important;
  }

  .top-header {
    overflow: visible !important;
  }

  .top-header .top-menu-panel {
    position: fixed !important;
    inset: 0 !important;
    top: 0 !important;
    left: 0 !important;
    right: 0 !important;
    bottom: 0 !important;
    width: 100vw !important;
    height: 100dvh !important;
    max-width: 100vw !important;
    max-height: 100dvh !important;
    z-index: 3300 !important;
    background: #07162c !important;
    backdrop-filter: none !important;
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: none !important;
    overflow-y: auto !important;
    overscroll-behavior: contain !important;
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
  }

  .top-header:not(.menu-open) .top-menu-panel {
    display: none !important;
    opacity: 0 !important;
    visibility: hidden !important;
    pointer-events: none !important;
  }

  .top-header.menu-open .top-menu-panel {
    display: block !important;
    opacity: 1 !important;
    visibility: visible !important;
    pointer-events: auto !important;
    transform: none !important;
  }

  .section-title {
    font-size: clamp(1.25rem, 5.8vw, 1.8rem);
    line-height: 1.2;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   MOBIL — LIZIBILITATE TEXT PE FUNDAL CER ALBASTRU
   SkyBackground are gradient #0b1e5e → #2272d4 (zonă centrală
   foarte luminoasă). Textele plutitoare în afara cardurilor
   (.section-title, .section-copy, .kicker, paragrafe) ajungeau
   sub 4.5:1 contrast → senzație că „scrisul nu are luminozitate".
   Soluție: text-shadow dark + brighten body/muted DOAR pe mobil.
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (max-width: 767px) {

  /* Textul „plutitor" (NU în carduri) primește haloul subtil de umbră
     care creează separare optică pe fundal albastru luminos. */
  .section-title,
  .section-h2,
  .section-copy,
  .kicker,
  main p,
  main h2,
  main h3 {
    text-shadow:
      0 1px 2px rgba(3, 8, 22, 0.65),
      0 0 16px rgba(3, 8, 22, 0.35);
  }

  /* În interiorul cardurilor cu fundal solid NU avem nevoie de shadow */
  .glass-card .section-title,
  .glass-card .section-copy,
  .glass-card p,
  .glass-card h2,
  .glass-card h3,
  .hp-card p,
  .hp-card h2,
  .hp-card h3,
  article p,
  article h2,
  article h3 {
    text-shadow: none;
  }

  /* Brighten textul secundar pentru a depăși 4.5:1 pe albastru */
  :root {
    --body: #E8E2D6;
    /* mai luminos decât #CEC6BA */
    --muted: #C4B8A4;
    /* mai luminos decât #9A8A78 */
  }
}

@media (max-width: 767px) {

  html.mobile-menu-open,
  body.mobile-menu-open,
  body.mobile-menu-open .page-shell,
  body.mobile-menu-open main#continut {
    overflow: hidden !important;
    overscroll-behavior: none !important;
    touch-action: none !important;
  }

  .top-menu-toggle-label {
    display: none;
  }

  .top-menu-toggle {
    width: 44px;
    min-width: 44px;
    padding-inline: 0;
    border-radius: 0.85rem;
  }

  /* Overlay full-screen pentru meniul mobil */
  .top-menu-panel {
    display: block !important;
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    z-index: 1200;
    padding: 1.1rem 1rem 1.25rem;
    background:
      radial-gradient(circle at 10% 10%, rgba(11, 188, 214, 0.24), transparent 28%),
      radial-gradient(circle at 86% 14%, rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.22), transparent 24%),
      radial-gradient(circle at 50% 82%, rgba(111, 76, 255, 0.18), transparent 30%),
      linear-gradient(160deg, #051225 0%, #07162c 36%, #0b1f41 100%) !important;
    opacity: 0;
    isolation: isolate;
    overflow-y: auto;
    overscroll-behavior: contain;
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
    backdrop-filter: none !important;
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: none !important;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
    box-shadow: 0 18px 42px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);
    transform: scale(1.015);
    visibility: hidden;
    pointer-events: none;
    transition:
      opacity 240ms ease,
      transform 240ms ease,
      visibility 0ms linear 240ms;
  }

  .top-menu-panel::before,
  .top-menu-panel::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: auto;
    pointer-events: none;
    border-radius: 999px;
    filter: blur(18px);
    opacity: 0.9;
  }

  .top-menu-panel::before {
    top: 3rem;
    left: -1.5rem;
    width: 8rem;
    height: 8rem;
    background: rgba(11, 188, 214, 0.24);
    box-shadow: 0 0 52px rgba(11, 188, 214, 0.34);
  }

  .top-menu-panel::after {
    right: -1.2rem;
    bottom: 3rem;
    width: 7rem;
    height: 7rem;
    background: rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.2);
    box-shadow: 0 0 48px rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.28);
  }

  .top-header.menu-open .top-menu-panel {
    transform: scale(1);
    opacity: 1;
    visibility: visible;
    pointer-events: auto;
    background:
      radial-gradient(circle at 10% 10%, rgba(11, 188, 214, 0.24), transparent 28%),
      radial-gradient(circle at 86% 14%, rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.22), transparent 24%),
      radial-gradient(circle at 50% 82%, rgba(111, 76, 255, 0.18), transparent 30%),
      linear-gradient(160deg, #051225 0%, #07162c 36%, #0b1f41 100%) !important;
    backdrop-filter: none !important;
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: none !important;
    transition:
      opacity 220ms ease,
      transform 220ms ease,
      visibility 0ms linear 0ms;
  }

  /* Instant open — fără animație la page load / navigare */
  .top-header.menu-instant .top-menu-panel {
    transition: none !important;
  }

  /* CLOSE via scroll = very slow fade-out discret — TREBUIE SĂ FIE DUPĂ menu-open pt specificitate */
  .top-header.scroll-closing .top-menu-panel {
    transform: scale(1.01) !important;
    opacity: 0 !important;
    visibility: hidden !important;
    pointer-events: none !important;
    transition:
      opacity 280ms ease,
      transform 280ms ease,
      visibility 0ms linear 280ms;
  }

  .top-header.scroll-closing .nav-mobile-grid .nav-link-mobile {
    opacity: 0 !important;
    transform: scale(0.96) !important;
    transition: opacity 600ms ease-out, transform 600ms ease-out;
  }

  /* Butoanele mobile — vizibile instant, fără animații */
  .nav-mobile-grid .nav-link-mobile {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: none;
  }

  .top-menu-panel .nav-desktop-bar {
    display: none !important;
  }

  .top-menu-panel .mobile-overlay-close {
    display: inline-flex;
  }

  .top-menu-panel .mobile-overlay-content {
    display: flex;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    width: 100%;
    min-height: 100%;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: flex-start;
    gap: 0.9rem;
    padding-top: 4.15rem;
  }

  .top-menu-panel .nav-mobile-grid {
    display: flex !important;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 0.72rem;
    padding: 0 0 0.5rem;
    width: 100%;
  }

  .nav-link-desktop {
    display: none !important;
  }

  .nav-link-mobile {
    display: inline-flex !important;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    width: min(88vw, 25rem);
    min-height: 56px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(117, 226, 255, 0.42);
    border-radius: 0.9rem;
    background:
      linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(11, 188, 214, 0.17), rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.14)),
      rgba(5, 18, 37, 0.94) !important;
    color: #f8fdff !important;
    text-shadow: none !important;
    box-shadow:
      inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18),
      0 10px 22px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.52),
      0 0 0 1px rgba(11, 188, 214, 0.08),
      0 0 24px rgba(11, 188, 214, 0.14);
    font-size: 1.04rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    padding: 0.7rem 0.9rem;
    text-align: center;
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: visible;
    max-width: 100%;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    line-height: 1.2;
  }

  .nav-link-mobile .nav-label {
    color: #f8fdff !important;
    text-shadow:
      0 1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28),
      0 0 14px rgba(11, 188, 214, 0.12);
  }

  .nav-link-mobile:hover {
    border-color: rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.85) !important;
    box-shadow:
      inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22),
      0 10px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.56),
      0 0 0 1px rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.28),
      0 0 30px rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.18);
  }

  /* Butonul activ pe mobil — cyan border + forțează vizibilitate */
  .nav-link-mobile.is-active {
    opacity: 1 !important;
    transform: none !important;
    background:
      linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(11, 188, 214, 0.32), rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.2)),
      rgba(5, 18, 37, 0.98) !important;
    border: 2px solid rgba(245, 208, 130, 0.9) !important;
    color: #fff3c6 !important;
    text-shadow: none !important;
    box-shadow:
      inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2),
      0 12px 26px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.58),
      0 0 0 1px rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.28),
      0 0 34px rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.22),
      0 0 26px rgba(11, 188, 214, 0.18);
  }

  .top-menu-panel audio {
    display: none;
  }

  /* PERF: glow pulsant prin ::after + opacity (compozitat), nu box-shadow */
  .nav-link-mobile.is-active::after {
    opacity: 1;
    box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(6, 214, 255, 0.3), 0 0 24px rgba(6, 214, 255, 0.15);
  }

  @keyframes activeGlowPulse {

    0%,
    100% {
      opacity: 0.6;
    }

    50% {
      opacity: 1;
    }
  }

  body.mobile-menu-open .nav-link-mobile.is-active {
    background: #07162c !important;
    border-color: #dfb05b !important;
    color: #fff0c5 !important;
    text-shadow: none !important;
  }

  body.mobile-menu-open .nav-link-mobile.is-active::after {
    animation: activeGlowPulse 2.4s ease-in-out infinite;
    box-shadow:
      0 0 18px rgba(223, 176, 91, 0.5),
      0 0 36px rgba(223, 176, 91, 0.25);
  }

  .mobile-menu-backdrop {
    display: none !important;
    z-index: 1199;
  }

  .mobile-overlay-close {
    position: absolute;
    top: 1rem;
    right: 1rem;
    z-index: 2;
    width: 46px;
    height: 46px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
    background: rgba(7, 18, 44, 0.98);
    color: #ffffff;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: 1.35rem;
    line-height: 1;
  }

  .mobile-overlay-content {
    min-height: 100%;
    width: 100%;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: flex-start;
    gap: 1rem;
    padding-top: 4.8rem;
    padding-bottom: 1.2rem;
  }

  .mobile-overlay-logo {
    width: min(56vw, 180px);
    height: auto;
    object-fit: contain;
    border-radius: 0.9rem;
    box-shadow: 0 10px 26px rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.28);
    margin-bottom: 0.2rem;
  }

  .mobile-overlay-content .menu-review-wrap {
    padding: 0.45rem 0 0;
  }

  .mobile-overlay-content .menu-review-btn {
    max-width: 18rem;
    width: min(88vw, 18rem);
  }

  body.mobile-menu-open .mob-swipe-hints,
  body.mobile-menu-open .quick-dock,
  body.mobile-menu-open [data-floating-whatsapp] {
    display: none !important;
    pointer-events: none !important;
  }

  .hamburger-btn {
    min-width: 116px;
    padding-inline: 0.95rem;
  }

  .hamburger-btn .hamburger-icon {
    font-size: 0.84rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.09em;
  }

  .btn-solid,
  .btn-outline,
  .btn-whatsapp,
  [data-comment-submit] {
    min-height: 46px;
    padding-top: 0.68rem;
    padding-bottom: 0.68rem;
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .btn-solid {
    animation: none !important;
  }
}

.card-soft,
.chip-pill,
.btn-primary,
.btn-ghost,
.section-kicker,
.section-description {
  all: unset;
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {

  *,
  *::before,
  *::after {
    animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
    animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
    transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;
    scroll-behavior: auto !important;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   ANIMAȚII — doar hover effects active
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

/* ── Scroll/Hero/CTA: clase noop (rămân în HTML, fără efect) ── */
.anim-on-scroll,
.anim-on-scroll.anim-d1,
.anim-on-scroll.anim-d2,
.anim-on-scroll.anim-d3,
.anim-on-scroll.anim-d4,
.anim-on-scroll.anim-d5,
.anim-on-scroll.anim-d6,
.anim-on-scroll.anim-d7,
.anim-on-scroll.anim-d8,
.anim-on-scroll.is-visible,
.anim-hero-load,
.anim-cta-pulse {
  /* noop */
}

/* ── Imagine hover scale — carduri și galerii ── */
.anim-img-hover {
  transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  will-change: transform;
}

.anim-img-hover:hover {
  transform: scale(1.04);
}

/* ── Card hover lift — efect ușor pe carduri ── */
.anim-card-hover {
  transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    box-shadow 0.3s ease;
}

.anim-card-hover:hover {
  transform: translateY(-3px);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   TEXT REVEAL — Fade-in & Slide-up (declanșat de IntersectionObserver)
   Elementele primesc .text-reveal → starea inițială invizibilă.
   Când IO adaugă .is-visible → animație compozitată (transform + opacity).
   Delay-ul „cascadă" vine din --reveal-delay setat inline de JS.
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.text-reveal {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(24px);
  transition:
    opacity 0.65s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    transform 0.65s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  transition-delay: var(--reveal-delay, 0ms);
  will-change: opacity, transform;
}

.text-reveal.is-visible {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translateY(0);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   TEXT GOLD GRADIENT — gradient auriu/champagne pe text
   Contrast AA asigurat pe fundal #0C080F:
   #FFD700 → 10.4:1, #FFE8A0 → 13.9:1, #F5A623 → 7.5:1
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.text-gold-gradient {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FFD700 0%, #FFE8A0 45%, #F5A623 100%);
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  background-clip: text;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
  /* Fallback pt browsere vechi: culoare aurie dacă background-clip nu merge */
  color: var(--gold);
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .text-reveal {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: none;
    transition: none;
  }
}

/* ── MOBIL: eliminăm slide-up (translateY) la text-reveal ──
   Pe telefon, dacă utilizatorul scrolează lent și se oprește în dreptul
   unui titlu, animația de translateY(24px → 0) era percepută ca un
   „salt al paginii cu câțiva milimetri în sus". Păstrăm doar fade-in,
   fără mișcare verticală — eliminăm complet senzația de jump. */
@media (max-width: 767px) {
  .text-reveal {
    transform: none;
    transition: opacity 0.45s ease-out;
    transition-delay: var(--reveal-delay, 0ms);
  }

  .text-reveal.is-visible {
    transform: none;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   MOBIL — SWIPE LAYOUT  (≤ 767px)
   Desktop rămâne complet neschimbat. Toate regulile de mai jos
   sunt exclusiv pentru ecrane mici (telefon).
   Breakpoint: 767px (nu 1023px) — "Versiunea Desktop" din browser
   simulează ~980px, deci la 768-1023px trebuie layout desktop.
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

/* Elementele noi sunt invizibile pe desktop */
.mob-nav,
.mob-swipe-hints {
  display: none;
}

/* Sidebar-only elements + nav icons — ascunse sub 1024px */
@media (max-width: 1023px) {

  .sidebar-brand,
  .sidebar-spacer,
  .sidebar-social,
  .sidebar-copy,
  .sidebar-review-btn {
    display: none !important;
  }

  .left-side-link .nav-icon {
    display: none !important;
  }
}

/* Desktop-only — ascunde butonul de recenzie din meniu (vizibil în sidebar) */
@media (min-width: 1025px) {
  .menu-review-wrap {
    display: none !important;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 767px) {

  /* ── 0. Siguranță globală imagini mobil — previne overflow orizontal ── */
  img,
  video,
  picture,
  canvas,
  svg {
    max-width: 100%;
  }

  /* ── 1. Header-ul fix rămâne vizibil, cu hamburger ── */
  .top-header {
    display: block !important;
    z-index: 2200 !important;
    isolation: isolate;
  }

  .top-header.menu-open {
    z-index: 2300 !important;
  }

  .top-header .top-menu-panel {
    z-index: 2400 !important;
  }

  /* ── 2. Dispare meniul lateral clasic ── */
  .left-side-menu {
    display: none !important;
  }
}

/* ── Buton apreciere în meniu ── */
.menu-review-wrap {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 0.75rem 1rem 0.5rem;
}

.menu-review-btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  flex-direction: row;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0.7rem;
  padding: 0.6rem 1.4rem;
  border-radius: 2rem;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #c8890a 0%, #F5A623 55%, #f7c060 100%);
  color: #1a0a00;
  text-decoration: none;
  font-family: inherit;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.45), 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
  transition: transform 200ms ease, box-shadow 200ms ease;
}

.menu-review-btn:hover,
.menu-review-btn:focus-visible {
  transform: scale(1.05) translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.65), 0 3px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
}

.menu-review-btn:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid #fff;
  outline-offset: 3px;
}

.menu-review-stars {
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  color: #5c3300;
  text-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4);
  line-height: 1;
}

.menu-review-text {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: flex-start;
  line-height: 1.2;
}

.menu-review-main {
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  color: #1a0a00;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.menu-review-sub {
  font-size: 0.63rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: #3d1c00;
  opacity: 0.85;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

/* Pe mobil: lățime completă, centrat, layout vertical */
@media (max-width: 767px) {
  .menu-review-wrap {
    padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem 0.75rem;
  }

  .menu-review-btn {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 18rem;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.25rem;
  }

  .menu-review-text {
    align-items: center;
  }

  .menu-review-sub {
    white-space: normal;
    text-align: center;
  }
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   BLOC MOBIL/TABLETĂ (≤ 1024px) — reguli !important care resetează
   layout-ul vertical pe ecrane mici. Înainte erau orfane (fără @media)
   și suprascriau și desktop-ul, distrugând Flexbox-ul. Acum sunt
   închise corect în media query, deci desktop-ul (≥1025px) păstrează
   Flexbox-ul curat: sidebar sticky 280px + main flex:1 + hero centrat.
   ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (max-width: 1024px) {

  /* ── 3. Layout shell — fără padding lateral, block simplu ── */
  .layout-content-shell {
    display: block !important;
    padding-inline: 0 !important;
    overflow: visible !important;
  }

  /* ── 4. Body shell — overflow intern permis ──
     overflow-x: clip (nu hidden) ca body să NU devină scroll container
     pe mobil. Altfel iOS/Android dau scroll body în loc de html, iar
     window.scrollY rămâne 0 (rupe scroll-spy + PTR din mobile-swipe.js). */
  .page-shell {
    overflow-x: clip !important;
    overflow-y: visible !important;
  }

  /* ── 5. Main = container vertical (scroll normal prin body/window) ──
         Toate paginile folosesc layout vertical pe mobil.
         Homepage adaugă min-height pe secțiuni și swipe orizontal JS.
         Nu mai există layout orizontal cu scroll-snap ca bază. ── */
  main#continut {
    display: block !important;
    overflow: visible !important;
    scroll-snap-type: none !important;
    overscroll-behavior: auto !important;
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling: auto !important;
    scrollbar-width: none !important;
    -ms-overflow-style: none !important;
    padding: 0 !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
    width: 100% !important;
    max-width: 100% !important;
    height: auto !important;
    min-height: unset !important;
    max-height: none !important;
    border-radius: 0 !important;
    border: none !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;
    backdrop-filter: none !important;
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: none !important;
    background: transparent !important;
    isolation: auto !important;
    padding-top: calc(var(--mob-nav-h, 72px) + 0.5rem) !important;
    padding-bottom: 2rem !important;
  }

  main#continut::-webkit-scrollbar {
    display: none !important;
  }

  /* ── 6. Fiecare <section> = bloc vertical cu scroll normal ── */
  main#continut>section {
    flex: unset !important;
    width: 100% !important;
    max-width: 100% !important;
    height: auto !important;
    min-height: unset !important;
    max-height: none !important;
    overflow: visible !important;
    overscroll-behavior: auto !important;
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling: auto !important;
    scroll-snap-align: none !important;
    scroll-snap-stop: unset !important;
    touch-action: auto !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
    border-radius: 0 !important;
    box-sizing: border-box !important;
    /* Padding lateral simetric (≥ 20px) + ritm vertical uniform pe mobil */
    padding-top: 0 !important;
    padding-bottom: var(--section-gap-y) !important;
    padding-left: var(--container-pad-x) !important;
    padding-right: var(--container-pad-x) !important;
  }

  /* ── Hero Acasă — conținut aliniat sus, nu centrat vertical ── */
  main#continut>section#acasa.hero-stage {
    justify-content: flex-start !important;
    padding-top: calc(var(--mob-nav-h, 72px) + 1rem) !important;
  }

  main#continut>section::-webkit-scrollbar {
    width: 0 !important;
  }

  /* ── 7. Nav plutitor înlocuit de hamburger menu din header ── */
  .mob-nav {
    display: none !important;
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    z-index: 100;
    overflow: visible;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg,
        rgba(4, 6, 18, 0.98) 0%,
        rgba(4, 6, 18, 0.96) 84%,
        rgba(4, 6, 18, 0.80) 100%);
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    padding: 0.45rem 0.5rem 0.45rem;
  }

  .mob-nav-track {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.35rem;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
  }

  .mob-nav-btn {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    white-space: nowrap;
    text-decoration: none;
    border-radius: 9999px;
    font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
    font-size: max(0.7rem, 14px);
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    padding: 0.34rem 0.65rem;
    min-height: 48px;
    min-width: 48px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07);
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
    transition:
      background 200ms ease,
      border-color 200ms ease,
      color 200ms ease,
      box-shadow 200ms ease;
  }

  .mob-nav-btn.is-active {
    background: rgba(6, 214, 255, 0.16);
    border-color: rgba(6, 214, 255, 0.60);
    color: #7ef8ff;
    box-shadow:
      0 0 14px rgba(6, 214, 255, 0.32),
      inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18);
  }

  /* ── 8. Săgeți swipe stânga / dreapta — ascunse implicit, vizibile doar pe homepage ── */
  .mob-swipe-hints {
    display: none !important;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  .mob-arrow {
    position: fixed;
    /* svh = small viewport height — NU se schimbă când bara URL a browserului mobil
       se ascunde/apare la scroll, deci săgeata nu mai sare cu câțiva milimetri. */
    top: 50svh;
    transform: translateY(-50%);
    z-index: 2605;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    width: 2.15rem;
    min-width: 44px;
    height: 4.6rem;
    min-height: 44px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
    background: rgba(8, 20, 44, 0.46);
    color: rgba(225, 236, 255, 0.62);
    cursor: pointer;
    pointer-events: auto;
    touch-action: manipulation;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    transition:
      opacity 300ms ease,
      background 200ms ease,
      color 200ms ease;
  }

  .mob-arrow--prev {
    left: max(2px, env(safe-area-inset-left));
    border-left: none;
    border-radius: 0 1.25rem 1.25rem 0;
  }

  .mob-arrow--next {
    right: max(2px, env(safe-area-inset-right));
    border-right: none;
    border-radius: 1.25rem 0 0 1.25rem;
  }

  .mob-arrow.is-hidden {
    opacity: 0 !important;
    pointer-events: none !important;
  }

  /* Hint animat — pulsare săgeată dreapta, ciclic, ca să sugereze
     gestul de "tragere" (peek-and-tug). 3 pulsări apoi pauză 4s. */
  @keyframes arrowBounceRight {

    0%,
    70%,
    100% {
      transform: translateY(-50%) translateX(0);
    }

    10%,
    30%,
    50% {
      transform: translateY(-50%) translateX(-10px);
    }

    20%,
    40%,
    60% {
      transform: translateY(-50%) translateX(0);
    }
  }

  .mob-arrow--next.hint-pulse,
  .mob-arrow--prev.hint-pulse {
    animation: arrowBounceRight 6s ease-in-out 1s infinite both;
    background: rgba(6, 214, 255, 0.18) !important;
    color: rgba(126, 248, 255, 0.95) !important;
    border-color: rgba(6, 214, 255, 0.45) !important;
  }

  /* Săgeata "prev" face oglindă — pulse spre dreapta */
  @keyframes arrowBounceLeft {

    0%,
    70%,
    100% {
      transform: translateY(-50%) translateX(0);
    }

    10%,
    30%,
    50% {
      transform: translateY(-50%) translateX(10px);
    }

    20%,
    40%,
    60% {
      transform: translateY(-50%) translateX(0);
    }
  }

  .mob-arrow--prev.hint-pulse {
    animation-name: arrowBounceLeft;
  }

  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .mob-arrow.hint-pulse {
      animation: none !important;
    }
  }

  .mob-arrow:hover,
  .mob-arrow:focus-visible {
    background: rgba(6, 214, 255, 0.14);
    color: rgba(126, 248, 255, 0.9);
  }

  /* ── 9. Footer compact pe mobil ── */
  footer {
    min-height: auto !important;
    padding-block: 1rem !important;
  }

  /* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     HOMEPAGE MOBIL — secțiuni full-height, swipe orizontal între pagini.
     Baza (mai sus) e deja vertical; aici adăugăm doar ce diferă:
     min-height pe secțiuni, overflow-x:clip, touch-action:pan-y,
     padding mai mare, și săgețile de navigare.
  ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

  body.is-homepage main#continut>section {
    min-height: auto !important;
    overflow-x: clip !important;
    overflow-y: visible !important;
    touch-action: pan-y !important;
    padding-top: 1.1rem !important;
    padding-bottom: 1.1rem !important;
    padding-left: var(--container-pad-x) !important;
    padding-right: var(--container-pad-x) !important;
  }

  body.is-homepage main#continut>section#acasa.hero-stage {
    justify-content: flex-start !important;
    padding-top: calc(var(--mob-nav-h, 72px) + 1rem) !important;
  }

  /* Secțiunile cu conținut compact pe homepage — nu forța min-height 100dvh,
     doar cât conținut au (altfel apar spații mari cu doar fundalul vizibil). */
  body.is-homepage main#continut>section.hp-seo-section,
  body.is-homepage main#continut>section.hp-early-booking,
  body.is-homepage main#continut>section.hp-highlights {
    min-height: unset !important;
    padding-top: 1.5rem !important;
    padding-bottom: 1.5rem !important;
  }

  /* Săgețile swipe sunt vizibile pe TOATE paginile mobil */
  .mob-swipe-hints {
    display: block !important;
  }

  /* Vizibilitatea individuală e controlată de JS prin .is-hidden */
  .mob-arrow--prev,
  .mob-arrow--next {
    display: flex !important;
  }

  .mob-arrow.is-hidden {
    display: none !important;
  }

}

/* ← închide @media (max-width: 1024px) — restul fișierului e desktop */

/* ── Layout flex desktop — sidebar sticky în flux, main fluid ──
   Vechea regulă „mirror margin-right 220px" a fost eliminată: layout-ul
   este acum un Flexbox real (sidebar 280px + main flex:1), nu mai există
   margin-left/calc-uri, deci conținutul rămâne aliniat natural. */

/* ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   Premium polish 2026 — look modern unificat + UX micro-motion
   (override-uri la final pentru consistență globală)
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

:root {
  --card-radius: 1.25rem;
  --card-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
  --card-bg: rgba(8, 16, 38, 0.56);
  --card-shadow: 0 14px 38px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.34);
  --premium-cyan: #0bbcd6;
  --premium-gold: #ffd166;
}

body::before {
  content: '';
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: -1;
  pointer-events: none;
  opacity: 0.34;
  background:
    radial-gradient(42rem 28rem at 12% 14%, rgba(11, 188, 214, 0.12), transparent 70%),
    radial-gradient(36rem 26rem at 90% 8%, rgba(255, 209, 102, 0.12), transparent 72%),
    radial-gradient(36rem 24rem at 84% 88%, rgba(255, 130, 96, 0.08), transparent 74%);
  animation: ambient-drift 16s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
}

#continut>section {
  position: relative;
  border-radius: var(--card-radius);
  border-color: var(--card-border);
  background: var(--card-bg);
  box-shadow: var(--card-shadow);
  transition: border-color 260ms ease, box-shadow 260ms ease, transform 260ms ease;
}

#continut>section::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  border-radius: inherit;
  opacity: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(115deg,
      transparent 0%,
      transparent 38%,
      rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14) 48%,
      rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04) 58%,
      transparent 68%,
      transparent 100%);
  transform: translateX(-32%);
  transition: opacity 260ms ease, transform 420ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  #continut>section:hover {
    border-color: rgba(11, 188, 214, 0.28);
    box-shadow: 0 18px 46px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.38), 0 0 0 1px rgba(11, 188, 214, 0.10) inset;
  }

  #continut>section:hover::before {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateX(0);
  }
}

.top-header {
  background:
    linear-gradient(120deg, rgba(8, 18, 42, 0.95), rgba(6, 14, 35, 0.92)),
    radial-gradient(circle at 85% 12%, rgba(11, 188, 214, 0.12), transparent 42%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 15% 88%, rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.12), transparent 40%) !important;
  backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.25);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.25);
}

.top-menu-panel {
  border-top-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18);
  background:
    linear-gradient(140deg, rgba(6, 14, 32, 0.98), rgba(7, 18, 40, 0.98)),
    radial-gradient(circle at 80% 10%, rgba(11, 188, 214, 0.14), transparent 40%);
}

.header-premium-pill {
  margin-top: 0.28rem;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  border-radius: 9999px;
  padding: 0.1rem 0.48rem;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 209, 102, 0.5);
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255, 209, 102, 0.24), rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.22));
  color: #ffe8b4;
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
  font-size: 0.53rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-shadow: none;
  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25), 0 2px 8px rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.25);
  animation: premium-pill-glow 2.8s ease-in-out infinite;
}

@media (min-width: 1025px) {
  .left-side-menu .left-side-link {
    transition: transform 180ms ease, filter 180ms ease, background-color 180ms ease, border-color 180ms ease;
  }

  .left-side-menu .left-side-link:hover {
    transform: translateX(4px);
    filter: saturate(1.03) brightness(1.04);
  }

  .left-side-menu .left-side-link .nav-icon {
    transition: transform 180ms ease, opacity 180ms ease;
  }

  .left-side-menu .left-side-link:hover .nav-icon {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: scale(1.1);
  }
}

.section-title,
.hp-cinematic-title,
.hp-card-title,
.hero-title-gold {
  text-wrap: balance;
}

.btn-solid,
.btn-outline,
.btn-whatsapp {
  transition: transform 180ms ease, filter 180ms ease, border-color 180ms ease, background-color 180ms ease;
}

@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {

  .btn-solid:hover,
  .btn-outline:hover,
  .btn-whatsapp:hover {
    transform: translateY(-1px);
  }
}

a:focus-visible,
button:focus-visible,
summary:focus-visible,
input:focus-visible,
textarea:focus-visible,
select:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid rgba(255, 241, 118, 0.95);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

/* Mobile ergonomics: text mai aerisit + cards mai lizibile */
@media (max-width: 767px) {

  p,
  li {
    line-height: 1.8;
  }

  #continut>section {
    border-radius: 1rem;
  }
}

@keyframes ambient-drift {
  from {
    transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0) scale(1);
    filter: saturate(1);
  }

  to {
    transform: translate3d(0.5%, -0.8%, 0) scale(1.03);
    filter: saturate(1.06);
  }
}

@keyframes premium-pill-glow {

  0%,
  100% {
    box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25), 0 2px 8px rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.2);
    filter: saturate(1);
  }

  50% {
    box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.32), 0 4px 14px rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.35);
    filter: saturate(1.05);
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  body::before {
    animation: none;
  }

  .header-premium-pill {
    animation: none;
  }

  #continut>section,
  #continut>section::before,
  .left-side-menu .left-side-link,
  .left-side-menu .left-side-link .nav-icon {
    transition: none !important;
  }
}

/* ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   Tipografie globală unitară — lizibilitate + consistență vizuală
   pe toate paginile din conținutul principal.
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
:root {
  --readable-body-size: clamp(1.02rem, 0.38vw + 0.96rem, 1.1rem);
  --readable-heading-1: clamp(2.05rem, 4.9vw, 3.5rem);
  --readable-heading-2: clamp(1.65rem, 3.6vw, 2.62rem);
  --readable-heading-3: clamp(1.32rem, 2.5vw, 1.92rem);
  --luxury-title-a: #fff6dc;
  --luxury-title-b: #ffe08f;
  --luxury-title-c: #f6c655;
}

#continut h1,
#continut h2,
#continut h3 {
  color: var(--title);
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.015em;
  text-shadow:
    0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08),
    0 3px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.56),
    0 0 26px rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.11);
}

@supports ((-webkit-background-clip: text) or (background-clip: text)) {

  #continut h1,
  #continut h2,
  #continut h3 {
    background-image: linear-gradient(170deg, var(--luxury-title-a) 8%, var(--luxury-title-b) 53%, var(--luxury-title-c) 100%);
    -webkit-background-clip: text;
    background-clip: text;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
  }
}

#continut h1 {
  font-size: var(--readable-heading-1);
  line-height: 1.12;
}

#continut h2 {
  font-size: var(--readable-heading-2);
  line-height: 1.18;
}

#continut h3 {
  font-size: var(--readable-heading-3);
  line-height: 1.24;
}

#continut p,
#continut li,
#continut label,
#continut .section-copy,
#continut .section-description,
#continut .hp-seo-text,
#continut .hp-faq-answer {
  font-size: var(--readable-body-size);
  line-height: 1.84;
  color: #e9effa;
  text-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);
}

#continut small,
#continut .text-xs {
  font-size: clamp(0.9rem, 0.3vw + 0.86rem, 0.96rem);
  line-height: 1.65;
}

#continut .btn-solid,
#continut .btn-outline,
#continut .btn-whatsapp,
#continut .hero-cta-primary,
#continut .hero-cta-secondary,
#continut .hp-convert-btn {
  font-size: clamp(0.92rem, 0.25vw + 0.88rem, 1rem);
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
}

@media (max-width: 767px) {

  #continut p,
  #continut li,
  #continut label,
  #continut .section-copy,
  #continut .section-description,
  #continut .hp-seo-text,
  #continut .hp-faq-answer {
    font-size: clamp(1.03rem, 4.05vw, 1.12rem);
    line-height: 1.88;
  }

  #continut .btn-solid,
  #continut .btn-outline,
  #continut .btn-whatsapp,
  #continut .hero-cta-primary,
  #continut .hero-cta-secondary,
  #continut .hp-convert-btn {
    font-size: clamp(0.94rem, 3.5vw, 1.02rem);
  }
}

@media (max-width: 1024px) {

  html.mobile-menu-open,
  body.mobile-menu-open,
  body.mobile-menu-open .page-shell,
  body.mobile-menu-open main#continut {
    overflow: hidden !important;
    overscroll-behavior: none !important;
    touch-action: none !important;
  }

  .top-header.menu-open {
    z-index: 2300 !important;
    isolation: isolate;
    transform: none !important;
  }

  .top-header.menu-open .top-menu-panel {
    position: fixed !important;
    inset: 0 !important;
    z-index: 2400 !important;
    display: block !important;
    opacity: 1 !important;
    visibility: visible !important;
    pointer-events: auto !important;
    background: #07162c !important;
    backdrop-filter: none !important;
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: none !important;
    overflow-y: auto !important;
    overscroll-behavior: contain;
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
  }

  .top-header.menu-open .top-menu-panel .nav-desktop-bar {
    display: none !important;
  }

  .top-header.menu-open .top-menu-panel .mobile-overlay-close,
  .top-header.menu-open .top-menu-panel .mobile-overlay-content,
  .top-header.menu-open .top-menu-panel .nav-mobile-grid,
  .top-header.menu-open .top-menu-panel .nav-link-mobile {
    display: flex !important;
  }

  .top-header.menu-open .top-menu-panel .nav-link-mobile {
    display: inline-flex !important;
  }
}

/* Failsafe: când meniul mobil e deschis, panoul trebuie să acopere TOT viewport-ul */
@media (max-width: 1024px) {

  body.mobile-menu-open .top-header,
  body.mobile-menu-open .top-header.menu-open {
    overflow: visible !important;
    transform: none !important;
    z-index: 3200 !important;
  }

  body.mobile-menu-open #top-menu-panel,
  body.mobile-menu-open .top-header .top-menu-panel,
  body.mobile-menu-open .top-header.menu-open .top-menu-panel {
    position: fixed !important;
    inset: 0 !important;

    left: 0 !important;
    right: 0 !important;
    bottom: 0 !important;
    width: 100vw !important;
    height: 100dvh !important;
    max-width: 100vw !important;
    max-height: 100dvh !important;
    z-index: 3300 !important;
    display: block !important;
    opacity: 1 !important;
    visibility: visible !important;
    pointer-events: auto !important;
    transform: none !important;
    background: #07162c !important;
    backdrop-filter: none !important;
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: none !important;
    overflow-y: auto !important;
    overscroll-behavior: contain !important;
  }

  body.mobile-menu-open #top-menu-panel .nav-desktop-bar {
    display: none !important;
  }

  body.mobile-menu-open #top-menu-panel .mobile-overlay-close,
  body.mobile-menu-open #top-menu-panel .mobile-overlay-content,
  body.mobile-menu-open #top-menu-panel .nav-mobile-grid {
    display: flex !important;
  }

  body.mobile-menu-open #top-menu-panel .nav-link-mobile {
    display: inline-flex !important;
  }
}

### verify.sql
```sql
-- Verificare integritate intre comments.post_id si posts.id

-- 1) Comentarii orfane: post_id care NU exista in posts
SELECT
  c.post_id,
  COUNT(*) AS comentarii_orfane
FROM comments c
LEFT JOIN posts p ON p.id = c.post_id
WHERE p.id IS NULL
GROUP BY c.post_id
ORDER BY comentarii_orfane DESC;

-- 2) Numar de comentarii pentru fiecare postare (inclusiv postarile cu 0 comentarii)
SELECT
  p.id,
  p.titlu,
  p.youtube_id,
  COUNT(c.id) AS total_comentarii
FROM posts p
LEFT JOIN comments c ON c.post_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.id, p.titlu, p.youtube_id
ORDER BY p.id ASC;

-- 3) Rezumat rapid: cate comentarii valide vs orfane exista in total
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS comentarii_valide,
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS comentarii_orfane
FROM comments c
LEFT JOIN posts p ON p.id = c.post_id;

```
